2603.13019.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a transformative workload in cloud clusters, enabling large language models (LLMs) to solve complex problems through interactions with real world. However, unlike traditional RL, agentic RL demands substantial external cloud resources, e.g., CPUs for code execution and GPUs for reward models, that exist outside the primary training cluster. Existing agentic RL framework typically rely on static over-provisioning, i.e., resources are often tied to long-lived trajectories or isolated by tasks, which leads to severe resource inefficiency. We propose the action-level orchestration, and incorporate it into ARL-Tangram, a unified resource management system that enables fine-grained external resource sharing and elasticity. ARL-Tangram utilizes a unified action-level formulation and an elastic scheduling algorithm to minimize action completion time (ACT) while satisfying heterogeneous resource constraints. Further, heterogeneous resource managers are tailored to efficiently support the action-level execution on resources with heterogeneous characteristics and topologies. Evaluation on real-world agentic RL tasks demonstrates that ARL-Tangram improves average ACT by up to 4.3$\times$, speeds up the step duration of RL training by up to 1.5$\times$, and saves the external resources by up to 71.2$\%$. This system has been deployed to support the training of the MiMo series models.
2603.13019.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）已成为云集群中一种具有变革意义的工作负载，使大型语言模型（LLM）能够通过与真实世界交互来解决复杂问题。然而，与传统强化学习不同，智能体强化学习需要大量位于主训练集群之外的外部云资源，例如执行代码所需的 CPU 和运行奖励模型所需的 GPU。现有智能体强化学习框架通常依赖静态超额配置：资源往往被绑定到长时间运行的轨迹，或按任务彼此隔离，造成严重的资源低效。我们提出动作级编排，并将其融入统一资源管理系统 ARL-Tangram，实现外部资源的细粒度共享与弹性调整。ARL-Tangram 使用统一的动作级建模方式和弹性调度算法，在满足异构资源约束的同时，尽量缩短动作完成时间（ACT）。此外，我们针对具有不同特征与拓扑的资源设计异构资源管理器，高效支持动作级执行。在真实智能体强化学习任务上的评估表明，ARL-Tangram 最高将平均动作完成时间改善 4.3 倍，将强化学习训练步骤加速 1.5 倍，并节省 71.2% 的外部资源。该系统已部署用于支持 MiMo 系列模型的训练。
2603.13019.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.14635.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly trained with reinforcement learning in long-horizon, sandboxed environments. Unlike conventional RL, agentic RL couples GPU-intensive rollout engines with stateful environment containers whose actions may produce visible side effects, such as file edits, command execution, and dependency installation. A single trajectory can span many rounds of gen- eration and environment interaction, so a component failure can discard completed work or expose the model to an environment state that is inconsistent with its context. However, existing systems lack efficient and correct recovery mechanisms for this distributed execution model. This paper presents Belayer, an efficient fault-tolerant system for LLM agentic RL training. Belayer handles failures in both rollout engines and environment execution while targeting low failure-free overhead. For scoped worker-local rollout failures, Belayer equips each pre-initialized shadow worker with a selective GPU-state reuse protocol that retains independently owned weights and raw KV-arena allocations after owner and GPU health checks, reinitializes worker-local state, and rebuilds request-specific KV contents from logged token prefixes. For environment failures, Belayer introduces full checkpoint and full restore to jointly capture and restore container file-system and runtime state, and coordinates the recovered environment with the LLM context to preserve prefix consistency. An adaptive policy opportunistically overlaps full-state checkpointing with natural LLM inference bubbles when the predicted interval is long enough. Empirical results show low measured overhead during failure-free training, a worker-recovery-time reduction of up to 42 times faster compared with a full engine cold start, and 1.5 to 3.5 times faster recovery from environment failures.
2608.14635.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过强化学习在长时程、沙箱化环境中接受训练。与常规强化学习不同，智能体强化学习把 GPU 密集型轨迹生成引擎与有状态环境容器耦合起来，而容器中的动作可能产生文件编辑、命令执行、依赖安装等可见副作用。一条轨迹可能跨越多轮生成与环境交互，因此某个组件发生故障，就可能使已完成的工作被丢弃，或使模型面对与自身上下文不一致的环境状态。然而，现有系统缺乏适用于这一分布式执行模型的高效、正确恢复机制。本文提出 Belayer，一个面向 LLM 智能体强化学习训练的高效容错系统。Belayer 同时处理轨迹生成引擎与环境执行中的故障，并力求保持较低的无故障运行开销。针对范围限定在工作进程本地的轨迹生成故障，Belayer 为每个预初始化的影子工作进程配备选择性 GPU 状态复用协议：在检查所有者与 GPU 健康状态后，保留独立拥有的权重和原始 KV 内存区分配，重新初始化工作进程本地状态，并依据记录的 token 前缀重建请求专属的 KV 内容。针对环境故障，Belayer 引入完整检查点与完整恢复机制，联合捕获和恢复容器文件系统及运行时状态，并协调恢复后的环境与 LLM 上下文，以保持前缀一致性。当预测的空闲间隔足够长时，一项自适应策略会利用 LLM 推理过程中自然出现的空泡，机会式地重叠执行完整状态检查点。实证结果表明，无故障训练期间的实测开销较低；相较于完整引擎冷启动，工作进程恢复最高加速 42 倍，环境故障恢复加速 1.5 至 3.5 倍。
2608.14635.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.36899.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training increasingly relies on long-horizon, multi-turn rollouts. As post-training jobs outgrow a single cluster, rollout pools assembled across clusters introduce hardware heterogeneity. Rollout scheduling must serve two stakeholders: the hardware needs high aggregate decode throughput, while each trajectory needs to finish quickly. The tension arises from the memory-bandwidth-bound nature of autoregressive decoding. A large active batch amortizes weight reads for high throughput but leaves each trajectory a smaller bandwidth share and a longer completion time. The scheduling objective is therefore specialization, letting different workers serve different roles. Heterogeneous hardware further enables this specialization. High-bandwidth accelerators favor long-context work, while cost-efficient accelerators sustain large batches. Workload evolution makes this specialization difficult to sustain, and dynamic reassignment faces a circular dependency because a move's benefit depends on subsequent placement decisions. We present CadenceRL, which bypasses this dependency through structural workload reshaping rather than per-move benefit estimation. Pacing replaces long-context trajectories with shorter ones, providing a structurally positive transformation that sustains large active batches for high throughput. When accumulated staleness demands faster completion, concentration directs the residual long-context tail onto high-affinity workers. Late-bound KV preparation stages accumulated prefixes before a destination is selected. On heterogeneous rollout pools, CadenceRL improves decode throughput by up to 48% and reduces P95 trajectory latency by up to 64%. Adding high-bandwidth accelerators reduces tail latency, while adding cost-efficient accelerators increases throughput, without manual routing configuration.
2609.36899.zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练越来越依赖长时程、多轮轨迹生成。当后训练任务规模超出单个集群时，跨集群组建的轨迹生成资源池会引入硬件异构性。轨迹调度需要兼顾两方面：硬件希望获得较高的总体解码吞吐量，而每条轨迹都希望尽快完成。二者的矛盾源于自回归解码受内存带宽限制这一特征。较大的活跃批次可以摊薄权重读取成本、提高吞吐量，却也使每条轨迹获得更少的带宽份额，延长完成时间。因此，调度目标应是让不同工作进程承担不同角色，实现专业化分工。异构硬件进一步提供了这种分工的机会：高带宽加速器适合长上下文任务，而成本高效的加速器适合维持大批次。不断变化的工作负载使这种分工难以持续；动态重新分配还面临循环依赖，因为一次迁移的收益取决于其后的放置决策。我们提出 CadenceRL，通过从结构上重塑工作负载，而非逐次估计迁移收益，绕开这一依赖。“节奏控制”用较短轨迹替换长上下文轨迹，形成结构上有利的变换，以维持较大的活跃批次和较高吞吐量。当累积的陈旧程度要求更快完成时，“集中处理”将剩余的长上下文尾部任务交给适配度高的工作进程。延后绑定的 KV 准备机制则在确定目标工作进程之前，预先准备累积前缀。在异构轨迹生成资源池中，CadenceRL 最高提高 48% 的解码吞吐量，并降低 64% 的 P95 轨迹延迟。加入高带宽加速器可以降低尾部延迟，加入成本高效的加速器则可提高吞吐量，而且无需手动配置路由。
2609.36899.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

chandy-lamport.en: This paper presents an algorithm by which a process in a distributed system determines a global state of the system during a computation. Many problems in distributed systems can be cast in terms of the problem of detecting global states. For instance, the global state detection algorithm helps to solve an important class of problems: stable property detection. A stable property is one that persists: once a stable property becomes true it remains true thereafter. Examples of stable properties are “computation has terminated,” “ the system is deadlocked” and “all tokens in a token ring have disappeared.” The stable property detection problem is that of devising algorithms to detect a given stable property. Global state detection can also be used for checkpointing.
chandy-lamport.zh: 本文提出一种算法，使分布式系统中的一个进程能够在计算进行期间确定该系统的一个全局状态。分布式系统中的许多问题都可以表述为检测全局状态的问题。例如，全局状态检测算法有助于解决一类重要问题：稳定性质检测。稳定性质是能够持续保持的性质，即一旦变为真，此后就始终为真。稳定性质的例子包括“计算已经终止”“系统处于死锁状态”，以及“令牌环中的所有令牌都已消失”。稳定性质检测问题，就是为检测某个给定的稳定性质设计算法。全局状态检测也可以用于创建检查点。
chandy-lamport.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2606.24369.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm, driving the emergence of high-performance RL systems such as veRL for autoregressive large language models (LLMs). In parallel, diffusion-oriented RL algorithms, e.g., DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, have rapidly expanded the scope of RL from language reasoning to diffusion-based visual and flow-based generation. However, efficient RL systems for diffusion generative LLMs remain underexplored. Existing implementations, e.g., veRL-Omni, still rely on colocated execution, which simplifies synchronization but couples rollout and training resources, limits heterogeneous deployment, and constrains independent scaling. To this end, we introduce DigenRL, a disaggregated RL framework for diffusion-based generative LLMs that supports flexible resource allocation, accommodates heterogeneous GPUs, and facilitates efficient task scheduling. To maximally reduce the execution bubbles in the disaggregated architecture, we propose: 1) a generation-axis pipeline (GAP) and time-step parallelism (TSP) in the diffusion architecture to enable finer-grained pipelining between rollout and training; 2) an elastic trainer-assisted generation (TAG) approach to enable the trainer GPU resources to dynamically assist in executing rollout generations; and 3) a tightly one-step constrained asynchronous strategy to further utilize the tail bubble in the pipeline. Extensive experiments are conducted on three hardware testbeds with 16-32 GPUs using HunyuanVideo-13B, Wan2.1-14B, FLUX.1-12B, and QwenImage-20B generative models. Experimental results show that DigenRL achieves 1.56-2.10x throughput improvements over state-of-the-art diffusion RL systems, veRL-Omni and GenRL.
2606.24369.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为主流后训练范式，推动了 veRL 等面向自回归大型语言模型（LLM）的高性能强化学习系统的发展。与此同时，DanceGRPO、FlowGRPO 等面向扩散模型的强化学习算法，迅速将强化学习的范围从语言推理扩展至基于扩散的视觉生成和基于流的生成。然而，面向扩散式生成 LLM 的高效强化学习系统仍缺乏充分研究。现有实现（如 veRL-Omni）仍依赖共置执行，这虽然简化了同步，却使轨迹生成与训练资源相互耦合，限制异构部署，也阻碍二者独立扩展。为此，我们提出 DigenRL，一个面向扩散式生成 LLM 的分离式强化学习框架，支持灵活资源分配、异构 GPU 和高效任务调度。为了尽可能减少分离式架构中的执行空泡，我们提出三项方法：（1）在扩散架构中引入生成轴流水线（GAP）和时间步并行（TSP），实现轨迹生成与训练之间更细粒度的流水处理；（2）采用弹性的训练器辅助生成（TAG）方法，让训练器 GPU 资源动态协助执行轨迹生成；（3）使用严格限制在一步以内的异步策略，进一步利用流水线尾部空泡。我们在三个配备 16–32 个 GPU 的硬件测试平台上，使用 HunyuanVideo-13B、Wan2.1-14B、FLUX.1-12B 和 QwenImage-20B 生成模型开展了广泛实验。结果表明，相较于先进的扩散强化学习系统 veRL-Omni 和 GenRL，DigenRL 的吞吐量提高至 1.56–2.10 倍。
2606.24369.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2604.26256.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a critical paradigm for LLM post-training, yet the rollout phase -- accounting for 50--80% of total step time -- is bottlenecked by skewed generation: long-tailed trajectories indispensable for model performance block the entire training pipeline. Asynchronous training offers a natural remedy by overlapping generation with training, but introduces a fundamental tension between efficiency and algorithmic correctness. We identify three constraints in asynchronous training to preserve convergence: intra-trajectory policy consistency, data integrity, and bounded staleness. Existing approaches fail to intrinsically address the long-tailed trajectory problem, which is further exacerbated by the imbalance characteristic of Mix-of-Experts models, or deviate from the standard RL training formulation, thereby hindering model convergence. Therefore, we propose DORA (Dynamic ORchestration for Asynchronous Rollout), which addresses this challenge through algorithm-system co-design. DORA introduces multi-version streaming rollout, a novel asynchronous paradigm that maintains multiple policy versions concurrently -- simultaneously achieving full bubble elimination without compromising algorithmic constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that our DORA system achieves substantial improvements in throughput -- up to 2--3 times higher than state-of-the-art systems on open-source benchmarks -- without compromising convergence. Furthermore, in large-scale industrial applications with tens of thousands of accelerators, DORA accelerates RL training by 2--4 times compared to synchronous training across various scenarios. The resultant open-source models, LongCat-Flash-Thinking, exhibit competitive performance on complex reasoning benchmarks, matching the capability of most advanced LLMs.
2604.26256.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为 LLM 后训练的重要范式，但占每步总耗时 50–80% 的轨迹生成阶段受制于生成偏斜：对模型性能不可或缺的长尾轨迹会阻塞整个训练流水线。通过重叠生成与训练，异步训练提供了一种自然的解决途径，却也引入效率与算法正确性之间的根本矛盾。我们识别出异步训练中保持收敛所需的三个约束：轨迹内策略一致性、数据完整性和有界陈旧性。现有方法要么无法从根本上解决长尾轨迹问题，而专家混合模型的不均衡特征又会进一步加剧这一问题；要么偏离标准强化学习训练形式，从而妨碍模型收敛。因此，我们提出 DORA（面向异步轨迹生成的动态编排），通过算法与系统协同设计来应对这一挑战。DORA 引入多版本流式轨迹生成这一新型异步范式，同时维护多个策略版本，在不破坏算法约束的前提下彻底消除空泡。实验表明，DORA 在不损害收敛性的情况下显著提高吞吐量，在开源基准上最高达到先进系统的 2–3 倍。此外，在涉及数万个加速器的大规模工业应用中，DORA 在多种场景下相较同步训练实现 2–4 倍强化学习训练加速。由此得到的开源模型 LongCat-Flash-Thinking 在复杂推理基准上展现出有竞争力的性能，达到最先进 LLM 的能力水平。
2604.26256.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

dynarl.en: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) workloads, powering large language models, long-horizon reasoning, and agentic systems, exhibit extreme dynamicity due to heavy-tailed rollouts, irregular multi-turn tool interactions, and time-varying bottlenecks. Static resource allocations in today’s distributed RL systems leave large fractions of compute idle and prolong training. This paper presents DynaRL, the first RL system that dynamically reallocates computation, memory, and communication resources across heterogeneous RL components. DynaRL models the entire RL pipeline with a dynamic hypergraph that serves as a centralized, continuously-evolving control surface. Supported by a unified resource migration interface and context-aware data routing, the scheduler reallocates GPUs from overprovisioned components to the current bottleneck via a combination of a multi-level scheduling algorithm and fine-grained resource migration. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that DynaRL improves end-to-end throughput on math-reasoning and agentic RL workloads by up to 1.98×, with negligible online scheduling overhead.
dynarl.zh: 为大型语言模型、长时程推理和智能体系统提供支持的现代强化学习（RL）工作负载，由于重尾轨迹生成、不规则的多轮工具交互以及随时间变化的瓶颈，表现出极强的动态性。现有分布式强化学习系统的静态资源分配使大量计算资源闲置，并延长训练时间。本文提出 DynaRL，这是首个能够在异构强化学习组件之间动态重新分配计算、内存和通信资源的强化学习系统。DynaRL 使用动态超图对整个强化学习流水线建模，将其作为集中式、持续演化的控制界面。在统一资源迁移接口和上下文感知数据路由的支持下，调度器结合多层级调度算法与细粒度资源迁移，将 GPU 从资源过量配置的组件重新分配给当前瓶颈。全面评估表明，DynaRL 在数学推理与智能体强化学习工作负载上最高提高 1.98 倍端到端吞吐量，在线调度开销则可以忽略。
dynarl.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

gcr.en: System-level GPU checkpoint/restore (C/R) enables several critical features such as elastic scaling, task switching, and fault tolerance, for modern GPU workloads in a unified and application-transparent manner. However, existing approaches present fundamental limitations: they fail to simultaneously achieve low C/R latency and low overhead imposed on normal GPU execution, while also lacking efficient support for incremental checkpointing. We propose GCR, a GPU checkpoint/restore system that addresses all these limitations simultaneously. GCR employs a hybrid C/R scheme through control/data separation to deliver low C/R latency and negligible overhead imposed on normal GPU execution. To efficiently support incremental checkpointing, GCR introduces shadow execution on the CPU to reduce the overhead of dirty buffer identification, utilizing dirty templates for both lightweight CPU shadow execution and identification at a fine-grained instruction level. Our evaluations demonstrate thatGCR reduces GPU checkpointing latency by 72.1% and 63.6% compared to cuda-ckpt (NVIDIA’s official solution) and PhOS (the current state-ofthe-art), respectively, and restoration latency by 54.2% and 87.1%, while imposing negligible overhead (less than 1%). GCR also supports efficient incremental checkpointing, which reduces checkpoint sizes by 86.6% and latency by 43.8%.
gcr.zh: 系统级 GPU 检查点与恢复（C/R）能够以统一且对应用透明的方式，为现代 GPU 工作负载提供弹性扩缩、任务切换和容错等关键能力。然而，现有方法存在根本局限：无法同时实现较低的检查点与恢复延迟，以及对正常 GPU 执行较低的附加开销，也缺乏对增量检查点的高效支持。我们提出 GCR，一个同时解决上述局限的 GPU 检查点与恢复系统。GCR 通过控制与数据分离采用混合式检查点与恢复方案，在降低检查点与恢复延迟的同时，使正常 GPU 执行的附加开销可以忽略。为高效支持增量检查点，GCR 引入 CPU 上的影子执行，以降低识别脏缓冲区的开销，并使用脏写模板同时实现轻量 CPU 影子执行和细粒度指令级识别。评估表明，相较于 NVIDIA 官方方案 cuda-ckpt 和当前先进方案 PhOS，GCR 分别将 GPU 检查点延迟降低 72.1% 和 63.6%，将恢复延迟降低 54.2% 和 87.1%，同时引入的开销可以忽略，低于 1%。GCR 还支持高效增量检查点，将检查点大小减少 86.6%，延迟降低 43.8%。
gcr.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2510.12633.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for Large Language Models (LLMs) is now scaling to large clusters and running for extended durations to enhance model reasoning performance. However, the scalability of existing RL frameworks is limited, as extreme long-tail skewness in RL trajectory generation causes severe GPU underutilization. Current asynchronous RL systems attempt to mitigate this, but they rely on global weight synchronization between the actor and all rollouts, which creates a rigid model update schedule. This global synchronization is ill-suited for the highly skewed and evolving distribution of trajectory generation latency in RL training, crippling training efficiency. Our key insight is that efficient scaling requires breaking this lockstep through trajectory-level asynchrony, which generates and consumes each trajectory independently. We propose Laminar, a scalable and robust RL post-training system built on a fully decoupled architecture. First, we replace global updates with a tier of relay workers acting as a distributed parameter service. This enables asynchronous and fine-grained weight synchronization, allowing rollouts to pull the latest weight anytime without stalling the actor's training loop. Second, a dynamic repack mechanism consolidates long-tail trajectories onto a few dedicated rollouts, maximizing generation throughput. The fully decoupled design also isolates failures, ensuring robustness for long-running jobs. Our evaluation on a 1024-GPU cluster shows that Laminar achieves up to 5.48$\times$ training throughput speedup over state-of-the-art systems, while reducing model convergence time.
2510.12633.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习（RL）后训练正在扩展到大型集群，并持续运行更长时间，以提升模型推理性能。然而，现有强化学习框架的可扩展性有限，因为强化学习轨迹生成中极端的长尾偏斜会造成严重的 GPU 利用率不足。当前异步强化学习系统尝试缓解这一问题，但仍依赖 actor 与所有轨迹生成工作进程之间的全局权重同步，从而形成僵化的模型更新节奏。这种全局同步无法适应强化学习训练中高度偏斜且不断变化的轨迹生成延迟分布，严重损害训练效率。我们的关键洞见是，高效扩展需要通过轨迹级异步打破这种步调锁定，让每条轨迹独立生成和消费。我们提出 Laminar，一个基于完全解耦架构构建、可扩展且稳健的强化学习后训练系统。首先，我们用一层充当分布式参数服务的中继工作进程替代全局更新，实现异步、细粒度的权重同步，使轨迹生成工作进程能够随时拉取最新权重，而不阻塞 actor 的训练循环。其次，动态重新打包机制将长尾轨迹集中到少量专用轨迹生成工作进程上，以最大化生成吞吐量。完全解耦的设计还能够隔离故障，保障长时间运行任务的稳健性。在 1024 个 GPU 的集群上，评估结果显示，Laminar 相较先进系统最高实现 5.48 倍训练吞吐量加速，同时缩短模型收敛时间。
2510.12633.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.08430.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) disaggregates training from rollout, so each policy update must reach the rollout clusters before the next batch. Transferring a full 1T checkpoint for such weight synchronization (refit) takes 87.5 min between two AWS regions. Measurements of BF16 training show that about 1% of weights change their stored values per step. Recent systems exploit this sparsity but fall short on placement, exactness, or efficiency: they reimplement placement rules, assemble full tensors, rebuild values arithmetically, or use a cross-cluster collective, and none fully recovers from mid-refit failures. We present NeMo-DCR (Delta-Compressed Refit), which sends only changes yet is bit-exact: receivers obtain the same parameter and buffer bits as a dense refit. For placement, fixed affine mappings project changes from training shards into the checkpoint's canonical coordinates, residual conversion covers the other changes, and the serving runtime's native loader places all changes in receiver storage. For exactness, compressible XOR masks carry affine changes whose projection and loader preserve stored bits, and overwrites carry the others. Receivers apply both in place, retries overwrite partial writes, and a joint commit binds the policy to the baseline for the next delta. For efficiency, object storage or a relay tree streams payloads during delta construction, without a cross-cluster collective. Even at 3% and 5% change rates, NeMo-DCR refits of 30B-1T models are 12-40$\times$ faster than a transport-only full-checkpoint reference. A 1T relay-tree refit at 3% takes 150 s instead of 87.5 min, making refits practical for cross-cluster agentic RL at trillion-parameter scale.
2610.08430.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）将训练与轨迹生成分离，因此每次策略更新都必须在下一批任务开始前传送到轨迹生成集群。对于这种权重同步，即 refit，在两个 AWS 区域之间传输一个完整的 1T 参数检查点需要 87.5 分钟。对 BF16 训练的测量表明，每一步大约只有 1% 的权重改变了其存储值。近期系统利用了这种稀疏性，但在放置、精确性或效率上仍有不足：它们重新实现放置规则、组装完整张量、通过算术运算重建数值，或使用跨集群集合通信，而且都无法完整恢复 refit 中途发生的故障。我们提出 NeMo-DCR，即增量压缩 refit。它只发送变化，同时保持比特级精确：接收方获得的参数和缓冲区比特与完整 refit 完全相同。对于放置，固定仿射映射将变化从训练分片投影到检查点的规范坐标，对其余变化执行补充转换，再由服务运行时的原生加载器将所有变化放入接收方存储。对于精确性，使用可压缩的 XOR 掩码承载那些投影和加载器均能保持存储比特不变的仿射变化，其余变化则通过覆盖写入传递。接收方原地应用两类变化，重试时覆盖部分写入，并通过联合提交将策略与下一次增量的基线绑定。对于效率，对象存储或中继树在构建增量期间流式传输载荷，无需跨集群集合通信。即使变化率为 3% 和 5%，NeMo-DCR 对 30B–1T 模型的 refit 仍比仅计传输的完整检查点基准快 12–40 倍。在变化率为 3% 时，1T 模型的中继树 refit 从 87.5 分钟缩短到 150 秒，使万亿参数规模的跨集群智能体强化学习权重同步成为可行方案。
2610.08430.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.35158.en: Multi-turn rollout dominates the cost of agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Asynchronous execution and elastic GPU resources can accelerate this stage, but adding rollout replicas yields diminishing returns while training GPUs remain idle between updates. We observe that effective resource use also depends on the prefill--decode (PD) configuration. Both the choice between colocation and disaggregation and the optimal PD ratio vary with the workload, making resource scaling and PD configuration interdependent. Exploiting this opportunity requires selecting effective configurations and realizing their benefits within transient resource-availability windows despite reconfiguration costs. We present PEARL, an asynchronous agentic RL system that coordinates external resource elasticity, temporary reuse of idle training GPUs, and adaptive PD execution. PEARL maintains a unified GPU--worker--role state and uses runtime profiles to predict rollout batch completion time, accounting for environment-induced reductions in decode concurrency. It selects the PD mode and ratio under the current GPU budget and translates each decision into an incremental transition plan that minimizes worker and role changes. Cost-aware switching and borrowing policies suppress transitions with insufficient expected benefit while ensuring timely return of training GPUs. Our evaluation show that PEARL achieves $2.17$--$2.79\times$ the throughput of fixed-resource ROLL across different LLMs. Compared with RLBoost+, throughput improves by up to approximately 26.9\% for Qwen3-8B and 36.3\% for Qwen3-30B-A3B.
2609.35158.zh: 多轮轨迹生成占据了智能体强化学习（RL）的主要成本。异步执行和弹性 GPU 资源可以加速这一阶段，但增加轨迹生成副本的收益会逐渐递减，同时训练 GPU 在两次更新之间仍处于空闲状态。我们观察到，资源的有效利用还取决于预填充—解码（PD）配置。共置与分离执行之间的选择，以及最优预填充—解码资源比例，都会随工作负载变化，因此资源扩缩与 PD 配置相互依赖。要利用这一机会，必须选出有效配置，并在短暂的资源可用窗口内，扣除重配置成本后真正实现收益。我们提出 PEARL，一个协调外部资源弹性、临时复用空闲训练 GPU 以及自适应 PD 执行的异步智能体强化学习系统。PEARL 维护统一的 GPU—工作进程—角色状态，并根据运行时测量预测轨迹生成批次的完成时间，同时考虑环境交互造成的解码并发度下降。它在当前 GPU 预算下选择 PD 模式与资源比例，并将每次决策转换为增量迁移计划，尽量减少工作进程和角色变化。成本感知的切换与借用策略会抑制预期收益不足的迁移，同时确保及时归还训练 GPU。评估显示，在不同 LLM 上，PEARL 的吞吐量达到固定资源 ROLL 的 2.17–2.79 倍。相较于 RLBoost+，Qwen3-8B 的吞吐量最高提高约 26.9%，Qwen3-30B-A3B 最高提高约 36.3%。
2609.35158.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2510.19225.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become essential for unlocking advanced reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). RL workflows involve interleaving rollout and training stages with fundamentally different resource requirements. Rollout typically dominates overall execution time, yet scales efficiently through multiple independent instances. In contrast, training requires tightly-coupled GPUs with full-mesh communication. Existing RL frameworks fall into two categories: co-located and disaggregated architectures. Co-located frameworks fail to address this resource tension by forcing both stages to share the same GPUs. Disaggregated architectures, without modifications of well-established RL algorithms, suffer from resource under-utilization. Meanwhile, preemptible GPU resources, i.e., spot instances on public clouds and spare capacity in production clusters, present significant cost-saving opportunities for accelerating RL workflows, if efficiently harvested for rollout. In this paper, we present RLBoost, a framework for cost-efficient RL training that harvests preemptible GPU resources. Our key insight is that rollout's stateless and embarrassingly parallel nature aligns perfectly with preemptible and often fragmented resources. To efficiently utilize these resources despite frequent and unpredictable availability changes, RLBoost adopts a hybrid architecture with three key techniques: (1) adaptive rollout offload to dynamically adjust workloads on the reserved (on-demand) cluster, (2) pull-based weight transfer that quickly provisions newly available instances, and (3) token-level response collection and migration for efficient preemption handling and continuous load balancing. Extensive experiments show RLBoost increases training throughput by 1.51x-1.97x while improving cost efficiency by 28%-49% compared to using only on-demand GPU resources.
2510.19225.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为释放大型语言模型（LLM）高级推理能力的重要手段。强化学习工作流交替执行轨迹生成和训练，而这两个阶段的资源需求存在根本差异。轨迹生成通常占据总体执行时间的大部分，却能够通过多个独立实例高效扩展；训练则需要通过全互连通信紧密耦合的 GPU。现有强化学习框架分为共置和分离式架构两类。共置框架强制两个阶段共享相同 GPU，无法解决这种资源矛盾；分离式架构若不修改成熟的强化学习算法，则会出现资源利用不足。与此同时，可抢占 GPU 资源，包括公有云竞价实例和生产集群中的剩余容量，如果能被高效用于轨迹生成，就能以显著节省成本的方式加速强化学习工作流。本文提出 RLBoost，一个利用可抢占 GPU 资源实现低成本强化学习训练的框架。我们的关键洞见是，轨迹生成无状态且高度易于并行的性质，与可抢占且经常碎片化的资源非常契合。为应对资源可用性频繁且不可预测的变化，RLBoost 采用混合架构，并引入三项关键技术：（1）自适应轨迹生成卸载，动态调整预留的按需集群上的工作负载；（2）拉取式权重传输，快速启用新获得的实例；（3）token 级响应收集与迁移，高效处理抢占并持续平衡负载。大量实验表明，相较于仅使用按需 GPU 资源，RLBoost 将训练吞吐量提高至 1.51–1.97 倍，成本效率提高 28%–49%。
2510.19225.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2512.22492.en: RL post-training for LLMs has been widely scaled to enhance reasoning and tool-using capabilities. However, RL post-training interleaves training and inference workloads, exposing the system to faults from both sides. Existing fault tolerance frameworks for LLMs target either training or inference, leaving the optimization potential in the asynchronous execution unexplored for RL. Our key insight is role-based fault isolation so the failure in one machine does not affect the others. We treat trainer, rollout, and other management roles in RL training as distinct distributed sub-tasks. Instead of restarting the entire RL task in ByteRobust, we recover only the failed role and reconnect it to living ones, thereby eliminating the full-restart overhead including rollout replay and initialization delay. We present RobustRL, the first comprehensive robust system to handle GPU machine errors for RL post-training Effective Training Time Ratio improvement. (1) \textit{Detect}. We implement role-aware monitoring to distinguish actual failures from role-specific behaviors to avoid the false positive and delayed detection. (2) \textit{Restart}. For trainers, we implement a non-disruptive recovery where rollouts persist state and continue trajectory generation, while the trainer is rapidly restored via rollout warm standbys. For rollout, we perform isolated machine replacement without interrupting the RL task. (3) \textit{Reconnect}. We replace static collective communication with dynamic, UCX-based (Unified Communication X) point-to-point communication, enabling immediate weight synchronization between recovered roles. In an RL training task on a 256-GPU cluster with Qwen3-8B-Math workload under 10\% failure injection frequency, RobustRL can achieve an ETTR of over 80\% compared with the 60\% in ByteRobust and achieves 8.4\%-17.4\% faster in end-to-end training time.
2512.22492.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习后训练已被广泛扩展，以增强推理和工具使用能力。然而，这一过程交错执行训练与推理工作负载，使系统同时面临两方面的故障。现有 LLM 容错框架通常只针对训练或推理，尚未挖掘强化学习异步执行中的优化潜力。我们的关键洞见是基于角色隔离故障，使一台机器的故障不影响其他机器。我们将强化学习训练中的训练器、轨迹生成器及其他管理角色视为不同的分布式子任务。与 ByteRobust 重启整个强化学习任务的做法不同，我们仅恢复失效角色，并将其重新连接到仍在运行的角色，从而消除完整重启的开销，包括轨迹生成重放和初始化延迟。我们提出 RobustRL，这是首个全面处理强化学习后训练中 GPU 机器错误、以改善有效训练时间占比（ETTR）为目标的稳健系统。（1）检测：实现角色感知监控，区分真实故障与角色特有行为，避免误报和延迟检测。（2）重启：针对训练器，实现不中断其他工作的恢复方式，由轨迹生成器保留状态并继续生成轨迹，同时利用轨迹生成工作进程作为温备快速恢复训练器；针对轨迹生成器，则独立替换失效机器，无需中断强化学习任务。（3）重连：用基于 UCX（Unified Communication X）的动态点对点通信替代静态集合通信，使恢复后的角色能够立即同步权重。在一个使用 256 个 GPU、运行 Qwen3-8B-Math 工作负载且故障注入频率为 10% 的强化学习训练任务中，RobustRL 的 ETTR 超过 80%，而 ByteRobust 为 60%；端到端训练时间缩短 8.4%–17.4%。
2512.22492.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

rollart.en: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) trains LLMs through multi-turn interactions with environments, producing workloads that mix compute-bound prefill, bandwidth-bound decoding, CPU-heavy environment execution, and bursty reward evaluation. Existing systems either colocate all stages on a single GPU cluster or decouple them only at a coarse granularity, overlooking hardware heterogeneity and incurring substantial synchronization overhead across stages. We present ROLLART, a system for multi-task agentic RL on disaggregated infrastructure. ROLLARTmaps each pipeline stage to best-fit hardware, routing prefill-heavy tasks to compute-optimized GPUs, decode-heavy tasks to bandwidth-optimized GPUs, and environments to CPU clusters. It decouples rollout at the trajectory level, allowing generation, environment interaction, and reward scoring to proceed independently, so that slow or failed environments never block the others. ROLLARToffloads stateless reward computation to serverless infrastructure and overlaps rollout with training via staleness-bounded asynchronous weight synchronization. Our results demonstrate that ROLLARTeffectively improves training throughput and achieves 1.31–2.05× training time reduction compared to various RL systems. We also evaluated ROLLARTby training a hundreds-of-billions-parameter MoE model for Qoder product on an Alibaba cluster with above 3,000 GPUs, demonstrating its stability and scalability.
rollart.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）通过与环境进行多轮交互来训练 LLM，其工作负载混合了受计算限制的预填充、受带宽限制的解码、CPU 密集型环境执行，以及突发式奖励评估。现有系统要么将所有阶段共置在单个 GPU 集群中，要么只在较粗粒度上将它们解耦，忽略硬件异构性，并产生大量跨阶段同步开销。我们提出 ROLLART，一个面向分离式基础设施的多任务智能体强化学习系统。ROLLART 将流水线中的每个阶段映射到最合适的硬件：将预填充占比较高的任务路由到计算优化型 GPU，将解码占比较高的任务路由到带宽优化型 GPU，将环境执行交给 CPU 集群。它在轨迹级解耦生成过程，使生成、环境交互和奖励评分能够独立推进，从而让缓慢或失效的环境不会阻塞其他环境。ROLLART 将无状态奖励计算卸载到无服务器基础设施，并通过陈旧程度有界的异步权重同步重叠轨迹生成与训练。结果表明，ROLLART 有效提高训练吞吐量，相较多种强化学习系统实现 1.31–2.05 倍训练加速。我们还在阿里巴巴一个拥有超过 3,000 个 GPU 的集群上，使用 ROLLART 为 Qoder 产品训练了一个数千亿参数的 MoE 模型，验证了其稳定性与可扩展性。
rollart.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2605.06534.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) is reshaping LLM post-training, but end-to-end training time is dominated by compute-intensive, multi-turn rollouts whose resource demand varies significantly across training steps. Resource-fixed systems cannot adapt to this variation, while resource-elastic approaches that provision external GPUs on demand suffer from high allocation overhead and limited availability. We observe that serving clusters leave substantial GPU compute and memory idle, and propose cooperative elasticity: sharing already-deployed serving GPUs with rollout workloads to provide on-demand elastic capacity. Realizing this is non-trivial, as it must preserve serving SLOs under bursty traffic while minimizing cross-cluster communication overhead. We present ROSE, a system that realizes cooperative elasticity for agentic RL post-training, comprising three components: (1) an SLO-safe co-serving executor that co-locates heterogeneous serving and rollout models on the same GPUs, dynamically sharing memory and compute while preserving serving SLOs; (2) a cross-cluster weight transfer engine that leverages shard-aware routing and weight sparsity for fast synchronization; and (3) an elastic rollout scheduler that dynamically routes rollouts across dedicated and opportunistic serving GPUs. Experiments across multiple model sizes and cluster scales show that ROSE improves end-to-end throughput by 1.3 - 3.3 x over resource-fixed baselines and reduces rollout time by 1.2 - 1.5 x over resource-elastic baselines, with no serving SLO violations.
2605.06534.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）正在重塑 LLM 后训练，但端到端训练时间主要由计算密集的多轮轨迹生成决定，而其资源需求在不同训练步骤之间变化显著。固定资源系统无法适应这种变化；按需配置外部 GPU 的弹性资源方法则面临较高的分配开销和有限的资源可用性。我们观察到，服务集群中有大量 GPU 计算能力和内存处于空闲状态，因此提出协同弹性：让轨迹生成工作负载共享已经部署的服务 GPU，以提供按需弹性容量。实现这一点并不简单，因为系统必须在突发流量下保障服务等级目标（SLO），同时尽量降低跨集群通信开销。我们提出 ROSE，一个为智能体强化学习后训练实现协同弹性的系统，由三部分组成：（1）保障 SLO 的共同服务执行器，将异构服务模型和轨迹生成模型共置于同一批 GPU，在保障服务 SLO 的同时动态共享内存和计算；（2）跨集群权重传输引擎，利用分片感知路由和权重稀疏性实现快速同步；（3）弹性轨迹生成调度器，在专用 GPU 和机会式借用的服务 GPU 之间动态路由轨迹生成任务。跨多个模型规模和集群规模的实验表明，ROSE 的端到端吞吐量达到固定资源基线的 1.3–3.3 倍，轨迹生成相较弹性资源基线加速 1.2–1.5 倍，并且没有违反服务 SLO。
2605.06534.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

spotcheck.en: Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) cloud platforms rent resources, in the form of virtual machines (VMs), under a variety of contract terms that offer different levels of risk and cost. For example, users may acquire VMs in the spot market that are often cheap but entail significant risk, since their price varies over time based on market supply and demand and they may terminate at any time if the price rises too high. Currently, users must manage all the risks associated with using spot servers. As a result, conventional wisdom holds that spot servers are only appropriate for delay-tolerant batch applications. In this paper, we propose a derivative cloud platform, called SpotCheck, that transparently manages the risks associated with using spot servers for users. SpotCheck provides the illusion of an IaaS platform that offers always-available VMs on demand for a cost near that of spot servers, and supports all types of applications, including interactive ones. SpotCheck’s design combines the use of nested VMs with live bounded-time migration and novel server pool management policies to maximize availability, while balancing risk and cost. We implement SpotCheck on Amazon’s EC2 and show that it i) provides nested VMs to users that are 99.9989% available, ii) achieves nearly 5× cost savings compared to using equivalent types of ondemand VMs, and iii) eliminates any risk of losing VM state.
spotcheck.zh: 基础设施即服务（IaaS）云平台以虚拟机（VM）的形式出租资源，并通过不同合同条款提供不同程度的风险与成本。例如，用户可以在竞价市场获取通常较便宜的虚拟机，但必须承担显著风险：价格会随市场供求变化，一旦价格上涨过高，虚拟机就可能随时终止。目前，用户必须自行管理使用竞价服务器的全部风险。因此，通常认为竞价服务器只适合能够容忍延迟的批处理应用。本文提出一种名为 SpotCheck 的衍生云平台，为用户透明地管理使用竞价服务器的风险。SpotCheck 营造出这样的 IaaS 平台体验：以接近竞价服务器的成本，按需提供始终可用的虚拟机，并支持包括交互式应用在内的所有应用类型。SpotCheck 将嵌套虚拟机、完成时间有界的热迁移以及新型服务器池管理策略相结合，在平衡风险与成本的同时最大化可用性。我们在 Amazon EC2 上实现 SpotCheck，结果表明它能够：（i）向用户提供可用性为 99.9989% 的嵌套虚拟机；（ii）相较使用等价类型的按需虚拟机，实现近 5 倍的成本节省；（iii）消除丢失虚拟机状态的任何风险。
spotcheck.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2601.09083.en: We present Speculative Rollout with Tree-Structured Cache (SRT), a simple, model-free approach to accelerate on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) for language models without sacrificing distributional correctness. SRT exploits the empirical similarity of rollouts for the same prompt across training steps by storing previously generated continuations in a per-prompt tree-structured cache. During generation, the current policy uses this tree as the draft model for performing speculative decoding. To keep the cache fresh and improve draft model quality, SRT updates trees online from ongoing rollouts and proactively performs run-ahead generation during idle GPU bubbles. Integrated into standard RL pipelines (\textit{e.g.}, PPO, GRPO and DAPO) and multi-turn settings, SRT consistently reduces generation and step latency and lowers per-token inference cost, achieving up to 2.08x wall-clock time speedup during rollout.
2601.09083.zh: 我们提出基于树结构缓存的推测式轨迹生成（SRT），这是一种简单、不依赖额外模型的方法，能够在不牺牲分布正确性的前提下，加速语言模型的同策略强化学习。SRT 利用同一提示在不同训练步骤中生成轨迹的经验相似性，将之前生成的续写保存在每个提示各自的树结构缓存中。在生成期间，当前策略将这棵树作为草稿模型执行推测解码。为保持缓存新鲜并提高草稿模型质量，SRT 根据持续生成的轨迹在线更新树，并利用 GPU 空闲空泡主动提前生成。将 SRT 集成到 PPO、GRPO、DAPO 等标准强化学习流水线和多轮场景后，它能够持续降低生成延迟和每步延迟，减少每 token 推理成本，轨迹生成阶段的实际耗时最高加速 2.08 倍。
2601.09083.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2601.12784.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become pivotal for enhancing the capabilities of modern large models. A recent trend is to develop RL systems with a fully disaggregated architecture, which decouples the three RL phases (rollout, reward, and training) onto separate resources and executes them asynchronously. However, two critical data-level concerns arise: (1) asynchronous execution leads to data staleness in trajectories (the data generated by rollout) as the model parameters used in rollout may not be up to date, which impairs RL convergence; and (2) the length variation of trajectories introduces severe data skewness, leading to workload imbalance and degraded system performance. Existing systems fail to address these two concerns in a unified manner. Techniques that tightly control data staleness often constrain effective data skewness mitigation, while aggressive data skewness mitigation tends to exacerbate data staleness. As a result, systems are forced to trade off convergence for performance, or vice versa. To address this, we propose StaleFlow, an RL post-training system that jointly tackles data staleness and skewness. First, to control staleness, StaleFlow introduces a global consistency protocol that tracks the full lifecycle of each trajectory and constrains staleness. Second, to mitigate skewness, StaleFlow re-designs the RL system architecture by constructing data servers for trajectories and parameters to achieve flexible rollout coordination. Subsequently, we develop a suite of staleness-aware, throughput-oriented strategies to enhance system performance. Evaluations show that StaleFlow achieves up to 1.42-2.68$\times$ (1.18-1.91$\times$ on average) higher throughput than state-of-the-art systems, without compromising convergence. Our source code is available: https://github.com/psrl-project/psrl .
2601.12784.zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练已成为增强现代大模型能力的关键。近期的一个趋势是采用完全分离式架构构建强化学习系统，将轨迹生成、奖励计算和训练三个阶段部署到独立资源上，并异步执行。然而，这会引出两个关键的数据层面问题：（1）轨迹生成使用的模型参数可能不是最新版本，因此异步执行会使生成的轨迹数据变陈旧，损害强化学习收敛；（2）轨迹长度差异会造成严重的数据偏斜，导致负载不均衡和系统性能下降。现有系统无法统一解决这两个问题。严格控制数据陈旧性的技术通常会限制有效缓解偏斜的能力，而激进的偏斜缓解又往往加剧数据陈旧性。因此，系统被迫在收敛性与性能之间取舍。为解决这一问题，我们提出 StaleFlow，一个联合处理数据陈旧性与偏斜的强化学习后训练系统。首先，为控制陈旧性，StaleFlow 引入全局一致性协议，跟踪每条轨迹的完整生命周期，并限制其陈旧程度。其次，为缓解偏斜，StaleFlow 重新设计强化学习系统架构，为轨迹和参数构建数据服务器，实现灵活的轨迹生成协调。随后，我们开发了一组感知陈旧程度、面向吞吐量的策略来提升系统性能。评估显示，在不损害收敛性的情况下，StaleFlow 的吞吐量最高达到先进系统的 1.42–2.68 倍，平均达到 1.18–1.91 倍。源代码可通过 https://github.com/psrl-project/psrl 获取。
2601.12784.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2601.12784.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2610.03286.en: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) trains LLM agents through multi-turn interactions with external tool environments. Its multi-turn nature exposes two system-level bottlenecks unaddressed by existing agentic RL frameworks. First, end-to-end training throughput is constrained by the slowest trajectories to complete, yet optimizing per-GPU utilization alone scatters rollout progress across many groups, delaying the completion of enough groups to unblock the next training step. Second, tool sandboxes are statically over-provisioned by their declared memory ceilings, leaving most physical memory stranded while replicating near-identical state across sandboxes launched from the same prompt. We present VenusRL, a fully disaggregated agentic RL system that addresses both bottlenecks. VenusRL's priority-aware action scheduler uses length-prediction heuristics to identify sample groups whose completion is most likely to unblock the next training step, and pushes them ahead of others across batch admission, KV Cache residency, and cross-worker request orchestration. VenusRL's environment resource manager combines a memory-aware admission threshold with a template-keyed page-sharing pool, packing more sandboxes per node while preserving strict memory isolation via write-protected page table entry aliasing and copy-on-write. Across representative agentic RL workloads, VenusRL achieves up to 4.24x end-to-end training speedup over state-of-the-art baselines and reduces environment cost by up to 89%.
2610.03286.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）通过与外部工具环境进行多轮交互来训练 LLM 智能体。其多轮特征暴露出两个尚未被现有框架解决的系统瓶颈。首先，端到端训练吞吐量受最慢完成的轨迹限制，但如果仅优化单个 GPU 的利用率，就会将轨迹生成进展分散到许多样本组，延迟足够多的组完成，进而推迟下一训练步骤的启动。其次，工具沙箱按照声明的内存上限进行静态超额配置，不仅使大量物理内存无法被利用，还会在由同一提示启动的沙箱之间复制几乎相同的状态。我们提出 VenusRL，一个同时解决这两个瓶颈的完全分离式智能体强化学习系统。VenusRL 的优先级感知动作调度器使用长度预测启发式方法，识别其完成最有可能解除下一训练步骤阻塞的样本组，并在批次准入、KV 缓存驻留和跨工作进程请求编排中优先推进这些组。VenusRL 的环境资源管理器将内存感知准入阈值与按模板索引的页面共享池相结合，在每个节点上容纳更多沙箱，同时通过写保护页表项别名和写时复制保持严格的内存隔离。在具有代表性的智能体强化学习工作负载上，VenusRL 相较先进基线最高实现 4.24 倍端到端训练加速，并将环境成本最高降低 89%。
2610.03286.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.00881.en: Large language model agents increasingly act through stateful tools, yet model generation and environment execution remain serialized at every step. As decoding accelerates, tool execution becomes a growing bottleneck. Existing action- or observation-only speculation leaves much of this latency exposed: value is concentrated in a few slow calls, some outcomes emerge only through execution, and longer lookahead typically requires an increasingly unlikely chain of action predictions. We present AOSpec, a lossless framework that co-speculates actions and observations across the full agent-environment loop. Expected Value Decoding (EVD) directs observation speculation toward outcomes with the greatest expected latency benefit, optimizing expected time hidden rather than hit rate. For outcomes only execution can reveal, AOSpec launches latency-critical target actions in isolated forks that contain their effects, while Joint Action-State Verification (JASV) verifies both the action and its origin state against committed execution before reuse. JASV recasts long-horizon action dependency from full-chain prediction into target action-state verification, breaking the lookahead--accuracy tradeoff and unlocking long-range overlap without sacrificing serial semantics. Across Terminal-Bench serving settings spanning four harnesses, five actor models, and five serving speeds, AOSpec outperforms every practical baseline, reducing mean end-to-end latency by 11.8-32.5% and p99 latency by up to 42.8%. Its gains increase as decoding accelerates, and its observation model transfers from Terminal-Bench to SWE-bench Verified without retraining.
2608.00881.zh: 大型语言模型智能体越来越多地通过有状态工具执行动作，但模型生成与环境执行仍在每一步串行进行。随着解码加速，工具执行正成为日益突出的瓶颈。仅推测动作或仅推测观察的现有方法，仍会暴露大量延迟：收益集中在少数慢调用上，某些结果只有实际执行后才会出现，而更长距离的提前推测通常要求一条越来越不可能全部正确的动作预测链。我们提出 AOSpec，一个在完整智能体—环境循环中联合推测动作与观察的无损框架。期望价值解码（EVD）将观察推测引导至预期延迟收益最大的结果，优化的是预期可隐藏的时间，而非命中率。对于只有执行才能揭示的结果，AOSpec 在能够限制副作用范围的隔离分叉中提前启动延迟关键目标动作；在复用结果之前，联合动作—状态验证（JASV）会将动作及其起始状态与已提交执行进行核对。JASV 将长时程动作依赖问题从整条链的预测转化为目标动作—状态验证，打破前瞻距离与准确率之间的权衡，在不损害串行语义的前提下实现长距离重叠。在覆盖四种执行框架、五个 actor 模型和五种服务速度的 Terminal-Bench 服务设置中，AOSpec 优于所有实用基线，将平均端到端延迟降低 11.8%–32.5%，将 p99 延迟最高降低 42.8%。随着解码加速，其收益进一步增加；它的观察模型还可以无需重新训练，直接从 Terminal-Bench 迁移到 SWE-bench Verified。
2608.00881.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.18849.en: An agentic request spends substantial wall-clock time waiting for tools, and its KV cache holds GPU memory the whole time. Serving systems decide whether that cache stays, leaves, or comes back by guessing how long the tool will run, from the tool's name, its history, a duration declared before the call, or the engine's own occupancy. We show that no estimate fixed before a call starts can know its duration, and such estimates may not even rank the calls. Meanwhile, the running tool already holds the answer, but the agent stack together with the tool silences it. We propose that tool calls report their progress explicitly while they run, and we measure what that takes. A census of four public agent corpora finds a readable signal in most tool time once it is revealed, in two strengths: a fraction of the work remaining, or an accurate signal that the end is near. A harness recovers it without changing what the agent sees, at no measurable cost to the agent's benchmark score. At the points where a KV cache decision is made, the reported progress is between several times and an order of magnitude more accurate than the best published predictors, and it stays accurate when the environment changes. Plugged into a production engine through a few small hints, it cuts the p90 time to first token (TTFT) after a tool call by 20.7% (HBM only) and 20.8% (HBM + DRAM) against LRU, close to an oracle. A serving system should not guess what its tools can tell it.
2609.18849.zh: 一个智能体请求会花费大量实际时间等待工具，而其 KV 缓存在整个等待期间持续占用 GPU 内存。服务系统通过猜测工具运行时长，决定缓存应该保留、移出还是重新载入；这些猜测可能依据工具名称、历史记录、调用前声明的时长，或引擎自身的占用情况。我们表明，任何在调用开始前固定下来的估计都无法知道其真实时长，甚至可能无法正确判断各调用的先后长短。与此同时，正在运行的工具本身已经掌握答案，但智能体软件栈和工具却没有将这些信息暴露出来。我们提出让工具调用在运行期间显式报告进度，并测量这样做的要求。对四个公开智能体语料库的普查发现，只要将信号暴露出来，工具执行时间的大部分都存在可读取的进度信号，且有两种强度：剩余工作比例，或准确提示即将结束的信号。执行框架可以在不改变智能体所见内容的前提下恢复这些信息，对智能体基准分数没有可测量的影响。在需要做出 KV 缓存决策的时刻，工具报告的进度比已发表的最佳预测器准确数倍至一个数量级，而且在环境变化时仍保持准确。通过少量提示将其接入生产引擎后，相较 LRU，工具调用结束后的 p90 首 token 延迟（TTFT）在仅使用 HBM 时降低 20.7%，在使用 HBM 与 DRAM 时降低 20.8%，接近拥有完美信息的理想方案。服务系统不应猜测工具能够直接告知的信息。
2609.18849.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2507.01663.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a pivotal technology in the post-training phase of large language models (LLMs). Traditional task-collocated RL frameworks suffer from significant scalability bottlenecks, while task-separated RL frameworks face challenges in managing complex dataflows and resolving resource idling. Furthermore, most existing frameworks are tightly coupled with LLM training or inference engines, making them difficult to support custom-designed engines. To address these challenges, we propose AsyncFlow, an asynchronous streaming RL framework tailored for efficient post-training. Specifically, we introduce a distributed data storage and transfer module that provides panoramic data management and fine-grained scheduling capabilities in a fully streamed manner. This architecture inherently enables automated pipeline overlapping among RL tasks and dynamic load-balancing. Moreover, we propose an asynchronous producer-consumer workflow, which is engineered to minimize computational idleness by strategically deferring the parameter update process within staleness thresholds. Finally, the core capabilities of AsyncFlow are architecturally decoupled from underlying training and inference engines and encapsulated by service-oriented user interfaces, offering a modular and customizable user experience. Extensive experiments demonstrate an average throughput of 1.59x compared to the state-of-the-art baseline. The architecture presented in this work provides actionable insights for designing next-generation RL training systems.
2507.01663.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为大型语言模型（LLM）后训练阶段的一项关键技术。传统的任务共置强化学习框架存在显著的可扩展性瓶颈，而任务分离框架则面临复杂数据流管理和资源闲置问题。此外，大多数现有框架与 LLM 训练或推理引擎紧密耦合，难以支持自定义引擎。为解决这些挑战，我们提出 AsyncFlow，一个专为高效后训练设计的异步流式强化学习框架。具体而言，我们引入分布式数据存储与传输模块，以完全流式的方式提供全局数据管理和细粒度调度能力。这一架构天然支持强化学习各任务之间的自动流水重叠和动态负载均衡。此外，我们提出异步生产者—消费者工作流，在陈旧程度阈值以内有策略地延后参数更新，从而尽量减少计算资源空闲。最后，AsyncFlow 的核心能力在架构上与底层训练、推理引擎解耦，并封装为面向服务的用户接口，提供模块化、可定制的使用体验。大量实验表明，其平均吞吐量达到先进基线的 1.59 倍。本文提出的架构为下一代强化学习训练系统设计提供了可操作的启示。
2507.01663.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2405.16444.en: Large language models (LLMs) often incorporate multiple text chunks in their inputs to provide the necessary contexts. To speed up the prefill of the long LLM inputs, one can pre-compute the KV cache of a text and re-use the KV cache when the context is reused as the prefix of another LLM input. However, the reused text chunks are not always the input prefix, which makes precomputed KV caches not directly usable since they ignore the text's cross-attention with the preceding texts. Thus, the benefits of reusing KV caches remain largely unrealized. This paper tackles just one challenge: when an LLM input contains multiple text chunks, how to quickly combine their precomputed KV caches in order to achieve the same generation quality as the expensive full prefill (i.e., without reusing KV cache)? This challenge naturally arises in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) where the input is supplemented with multiple retrieved texts as the context. We present CacheBlend, a scheme that reuses the precomputed KV caches, regardless prefix or not, and selectively recomputes the KV values of a small subset of tokens to partially update each reused KV cache. In the meantime, the small extra delay for recomputing some tokens can be pipelined with the retrieval of KV caches within the same job, allowing CacheBlend to store KV caches in slower devices with more storage capacity while retrieving them without increasing the inference delay. By comparing CacheBlend with the state-of-the-art KV cache reusing schemes on three open-source LLMs of various sizes and four popular benchmark datasets of different tasks, we show that CacheBlend reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 2.2-3.3x and increases the inference throughput by 2.8-5x from full KV recompute without compromising generation quality. The code is available at https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache .
2405.16444.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的输入通常包含多个文本块，以提供必要的上下文。为加速长输入的预填充，可以预先计算文本的 KV 缓存，并在该文本作为另一个 LLM 输入的前缀而被重复使用时复用缓存。然而，被复用的文本块并不总是输入前缀，其预计算 KV 缓存忽略了该文本与前面文本的跨文本注意力，因此不能直接使用。这使得 KV 缓存复用的潜在收益大多尚未实现。本文聚焦一个问题：当 LLM 输入包含多个文本块时，如何快速组合它们预计算的 KV 缓存，达到与昂贵的完整预填充，即完全不复用 KV 缓存，相同的生成质量？这一挑战自然出现在检索增强生成（RAG）中，因为其输入会补充多个检索文本作为上下文。我们提出 CacheBlend，不论文本是否位于前缀，都复用其预计算 KV 缓存，并选择性地重新计算少量 token 的 KV 值，从而局部更新每个复用缓存。同时，重新计算部分 token 带来的少量额外延迟，可以与同一任务内的 KV 缓存检索形成流水重叠，使 CacheBlend 能够把缓存保存在容量更大、速度更慢的设备上，而在检索时不增加推理延迟。我们在三个不同规模的开源 LLM 和四个覆盖不同任务的常用基准数据集上，将 CacheBlend 与先进 KV 缓存复用方案进行比较。结果显示，相较完整 KV 重计算，CacheBlend 将首 token 延迟（TTFT）缩短 2.2–3.3 倍，将推理吞吐量提高至 2.8–5 倍，同时不损害生成质量。代码可通过 https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache 获取。
2405.16444.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
