2601.22705.en: Batch inference for agentic workloads stresses the GPU key-value (KV) cache in a sustained and cumulative manner, often causing severe throughput degradation well before memory capacity is exhausted. We identify this phenomenon as middle-phase thrashing, a previously under-characterized pathology in which cache efficiency collapses as long-lived agents accumulate state over time. We argue that mitigating this pathology requires moving beyond reactive, request-level cache management to proactive, agent-level admission control. Drawing inspiration from congestion control in distributed systems, we view the KV cache as a shared resource whose efficient utilization depends on feedback-driven regulation. Based on this insight, we present CONCUR, a lightweight control layer that regulates agent admission to bound aggregate cache pressure while preserving execution continuity. CONCUR adapts a cache-aware control algorithm to dynamically adjust the number of active agents using runtime cache signals. Across large models and real-world agent workloads, CONCUR prevents middle-phase thrashing and improves batch inference throughput by up to 4.09x on Qwen3-32B and 1.9x on DeepSeek-V3, while remaining compatible with existing LLM serving systems.
2601.22705.zh: 智能体工作负载的批量推理会持续、累积地对 GPU 键值（KV）缓存施压，往往在内存容量耗尽之前很久就造成严重吞吐量下降。我们将这一现象识别为“中段抖动”：这是一个此前缺乏充分刻画的问题，长时间存活的智能体不断累积状态，最终使缓存效率崩溃。我们认为，要缓解这一问题，必须从被动的请求级缓存管理转向主动的智能体级准入控制。受分布式系统拥塞控制的启发，我们将 KV 缓存视为共享资源，其高效利用取决于反馈驱动的调节。基于这一洞见，我们提出 CONCUR，一个轻量控制层，通过调节智能体准入，在保持执行连续性的同时限制总缓存压力。CONCUR 根据缓存感知控制算法和运行时缓存信号，动态调整活跃智能体数量。在大型模型和真实智能体工作负载上，CONCUR 能够避免中段抖动，在 Qwen3-32B 上最高将批量推理吞吐量提高至 4.09 倍，在 DeepSeek-V3 上提高至 1.9 倍，同时保持与现有 LLM 服务系统兼容。
2601.22705.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2410.01228.en: Large language model (LLM) serving demands low latency and high throughput, but high load variability makes it challenging to achieve high GPU utilization. In this paper, we identify a synergetic but overlooked opportunity to co-serve latency-critical online requests alongside latency-tolerant offline tasks such as model benchmarking. While promising, existing serving systems fail to co-serve them efficiently, as their coarse-grained resource management at the request or iteration level cannot harvest millisecond-level GPU idle cycles without introducing interference that violates online latency objectives. ConServe is a new LLM co-serving system that achieves high throughput and strong online latency guarantees by managing resources at finer granularities. ConServe introduces three techniques: (1) a latency-aware token-level scheduler that precisely sizes offline batches and tokens to fit within online latency objectives; (2) sub-iteration, layer-wise preemption that allows offline tasks to yield to online load spikes; and (3) incremental KV cache management that enables preempting and resuming offline requests at near-zero cost. Evaluations with Llama-3.1 and Qwen-2.5 models on real-world workloads show that ConServe delivers an average of 2.2$\times$ higher throughput and reduces online serving tail latency by 2.9$\times$ on average compared to state-of-the-art systems.
2410.01228.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）服务要求低延迟和高吞吐量，但负载的高度波动使高 GPU 利用率难以实现。本文识别出一个具有协同收益、却被忽视的机会：将延迟敏感的在线请求与模型基准测试等可容忍延迟的离线任务共同服务。尽管这一方向很有前景，现有服务系统却无法高效实现，因为它们在请求级或迭代级进行粗粒度资源管理，无法利用毫秒级 GPU 空闲时段而不引入会违反在线延迟目标的干扰。ConServe 是一个新的 LLM 共同服务系统，通过更细粒度的资源管理实现高吞吐量和严格的在线延迟保障。ConServe 引入三项技术：（1）延迟感知的 token 级调度器，精确确定离线批次与 token 数量，使其符合在线延迟目标；（2）迭代内部的逐层抢占，使离线任务能够为突发在线负载让出资源；（3）增量 KV 缓存管理，使离线请求能够以近乎零成本被抢占和恢复。在真实工作负载上使用 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen-2.5 模型的评估表明，相较先进系统，ConServe 的平均吞吐量提高至 2.2 倍，在线服务尾部延迟平均缩短 2.9 倍。
2410.01228.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.31551.en: Disaggregating the two stages, Prefill and Decode, onto separate GPU pools is now a standard optimization for (text-only) LLM serving. However, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), which add a third phase, Encode, pose new challenges for resource allocation. Encode turns images, video, or audio into embeddings that the language model can consume, yielding a three-stage Encode-Prefill-Decode (EPD) pipeline. Existing frameworks offer only partial answers: text-only PD systems lack Encode, while EPD frameworks expose it as a separate service without regulating downstream request flow. The pipeline also carries a structural resource imbalance: every request enters through Encode before downstream work can begin, yet per-request execution leaves the encode GPU severely underutilized even at high loads, starving the downstream Prefill and Decode workers. Addressing this, we reposition Encode as the control point of the EPD pipeline, exposing three tightly coupled dimensions: when work enters downstream, where prefill executes, and how the GPU is shared. We instantiate this in EAServe across two co-designed layers. Its runtime manages load-adaptive micro-batching, rate-controlled partial offload to a co-resident prefill worker, and dynamic SM partitioning for predictable co-location. The configuration layer, Hybrid Auto Selection (HAS), navigates the joint space of GPU allocation, encode batch size, and offload ratio by pruning unbalanced allocations with per-stage capacity profiling and refining the remainder through TPE-based Bayesian optimization. Evaluated on three MLLM architectures spanning image, video, and audio, EAServe delivers up to 4.3x and 1.7x higher goodput than NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM, respectively, under identical SLO constraints, sustains more balanced and higher GPU utilization across the EPD pipeline, and reaches near-optimal configurations faster than baseline search methods.
2609.31551.zh: 将预填充和解码两个阶段分离到不同 GPU 资源池，现已成为纯文本 LLM 服务的标准优化方式。然而，多模态 LLM（MLLM）增加了编码这一第三阶段，带来新的资源分配挑战。编码将图像、视频或音频转换成语言模型可以使用的嵌入，形成编码—预填充—解码（EPD）三阶段流水线。现有框架只给出了部分解决方案：纯文本 PD 系统缺少编码阶段，而 EPD 框架虽然将编码暴露为独立服务，却不调节下游请求流。该流水线还存在结构性资源不均衡：每个请求都必须先经过编码，下游才能开始工作；但逐请求执行即使在高负载下也使编码 GPU 利用率严重不足，导致下游预填充和解码工作进程缺少输入。为解决这一问题，我们将编码重新定位为 EPD 流水线的控制点，显式联合处理三个紧密耦合的维度：何时将工作送入下游、在哪里执行预填充，以及如何共享 GPU。我们通过两个协同设计的层次，将这一思路实现为 EAServe。运行时负责负载自适应微批处理、以受控速率向同驻预填充工作进程部分卸载工作，以及支持可预测共置的动态 SM 分区。配置层“混合自动选择”（HAS）在 GPU 分配、编码批量大小和卸载比例的联合空间内搜索：利用各阶段容量测量剪除不均衡分配，再通过基于 TPE 的贝叶斯优化细化其余候选。在覆盖图像、视频和音频的三种 MLLM 架构上评估表明，在相同 SLO 约束下，EAServe 的有效吞吐量最高分别达到 NVIDIA Dynamo 和 vLLM 的 4.3 倍和 1.7 倍；整个 EPD 流水线的 GPU 利用率更高且更均衡，寻找近最优配置也比基线搜索方法更快。
2609.31551.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.19822.en: LLM agents are evolving from a single model calling tools to planners that orchestrate multiple expert models whose capabilities live in distinct weights. This shift breaks a hidden assumption of today's serving systems: that the working set of models fits in GPU memory. On the memory-constrained GPUs typical of private and edge deployments, naive whole-model swapping serializes weight transfer with computation and, without host-backed KV restoration, discards session state at a switch. We present JointServe, a serving system that treats weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects competing for one unified memory budget. JointServe exploits three structural properties of agent workloads (directed calls, gapped execution, and dual-state residency) to prepare models before they are called: an intent signal parsed from the caller's own output stream triggers prefetch during generation, partial k* residency reduces switching to incremental layers, and a preemptive transfer scheduler protects live-session KV with a guaranteed bandwidth share. A carve-out control step adjusts the weight/KV allocation as workload demands change. Evaluations show that JointServe reduces session completion time by 21.7% over the strongest whole-model swap baseline and stays usable in a crash regime where every whole-model swap baseline fails to finish (a 46-fold gap). On replayed SWE-bench, tau-bench, and OSWorld traces, it cuts session completion time by up to 49% and lifts SLO attainment from 2.8-24.5% to 76.8-100%.
2610.19822.zh: LLM 智能体正从单模型调用工具，发展为协调多个专家模型的规划器，而各专家的能力存储在不同权重中。这一转变打破了当今服务系统的一个隐含假设：工作集中的所有模型都能装入 GPU 内存。在私有和边缘部署中常见的内存受限 GPU 上，朴素的整模型换入换出会使权重传输与计算串行化；如果没有由主机内存支持的 KV 恢复机制，还会在切换时丢弃会话状态。我们提出 JointServe，一个将权重分片和 KV 块视为驻留对象、使二者竞争同一内存预算的服务系统。JointServe 利用智能体工作负载的三个结构特征——有向调用、存在执行间隙以及双状态驻留——在模型被调用前提前做好准备：从调用方自身的输出流中解析出的意图信号，在生成期间触发预取；部分 k* 驻留将模型切换缩小为增量层的迁移；可抢占传输调度器则为活跃会话 KV 提供有保障的带宽份额。资源划分控制步骤会随着工作负载需求变化，调整权重与 KV 的内存分配。评估表明，相较最强的整模型换入换出基线，JointServe 将会话完成时间降低 21.7%；在所有整模型换入换出基线均无法完成、差距达到 46 倍的崩溃区域，它仍能正常运行。在回放的 SWE-bench、tau-bench 和 OSWorld 轨迹上，它最高将会话完成时间降低 49%，并将 SLO 达标率从 2.8%–24.5% 提高到 76.8%–100%。
2610.19822.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.03335.en: Concurrent multi-agent workflows expose future dependencies and serving-state requirements while running on heterogeneous GPU pools with time-varying load, model residency, and resource availability. The logical workflow defines the required computation, whereas its physical scheduling units, model-lifecycle actions, resource ordering, and placement must be selected according to the observed pool state. We present a prediction-guided runtime that uses workflow forecasts to construct and optimize a physical execution graph. Predictor estimates device-specific activation latency, peak memory, and model-loading cost, then propagates these predictions through workflow dependencies to forecast activation readiness and future model demand. Constructor builds semantics-preserving fusion and model-lifecycle alternatives, while Scheduler jointly optimizes their selection, placement, and execution order based on the live pool state. Across a workload spanning three workflow scenarios on a heterogeneous GPU pool, our system reduces end-to-end makespan and overall p95 completion latency under burst arrivals by up to 36.8% and 25.9%, respectively, over state-of-the-art workflow schedulers. It also saves up to 24.63 GPU-s per completed session.
2609.03335.zh: 并发的多智能体工作流会暴露未来依赖和服务状态需求，同时运行于负载、模型驻留情况和资源可用性不断变化的异构 GPU 资源池上。逻辑工作流定义所需计算，而物理调度单元、模型生命周期操作、资源执行顺序和放置位置，则必须根据观测到的资源池状态选择。我们提出一种预测引导的运行时，利用工作流预测构建并优化物理执行图。预测器估计特定设备上的激活执行延迟、峰值内存和模型加载成本，再沿工作流依赖传播这些预测，以推断激活何时就绪，以及未来的模型需求。构造器生成保持语义的融合方案和模型生命周期备选方案，调度器则依据资源池的实时状态，联合优化方案选择、放置和执行顺序。在异构 GPU 资源池上，针对涵盖三类工作流场景的负载，我们的系统在突发到达条件下，相较先进工作流调度器，最高将端到端总完成时间降低 36.8%，将总体 p95 完成延迟降低 25.9%。每个完成的会话还可最高节省 24.63 GPU·秒。
2609.03335.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2507.07966.en: We introduce a full-stack framework that scales up reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) to long videos, leveraging reinforcement learning. We address the unique challenges of long video reasoning by integrating three critical components: (1) a large-scale dataset, LongVideo-Reason, comprising 104K long video QA pairs with high-quality reasoning annotations across diverse domains such as sports, games, and vlogs; (2) a two-stage training pipeline that extends VLMs with chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning (CoT-SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL); and (3) a training infrastructure for long video RL, named Multi-modal Reinforcement Sequence Parallelism (MR-SP), which incorporates sequence parallelism and a vLLM-based engine tailored for long video, using cached video embeddings for efficient rollout and prefilling. In our experiments, LongVILA-R1-7B achieves strong performance on video benchmarks, reaching 65.1% and 71.1% accuracy on VideoMME without and with subtitles, respectively, and consistently outperforming LongVILA-7B across multiple benchmarks. Moreover, LongVILA-R1-7B supports processing up to 8,192 video frames per video, and configurable FPS settings. Notably, our MR-SP system achieves up to 2.1x speedup on long video RL training. In addition, we release our training system for public availability that supports RL training on various modalities (video, text, and audio), various models (VILA and Qwen series), and even image and video generation models. On a single A100 node (8 GPUs), it supports RL training on hour-long videos (e.g., 3,600 frames).
2507.07966.zh: 我们提出一个全栈框架，利用强化学习将视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力扩展到长视频。为应对长视频推理的独特挑战，我们整合了三个关键组件：（1）大规模数据集 LongVideo-Reason，包含 104K 个长视频问答对，并提供覆盖体育、游戏、视频日志等不同领域的高质量推理标注；（2）两阶段训练流水线，通过思维链监督微调（CoT-SFT）和强化学习（RL）增强 VLM；（3）名为多模态强化序列并行（MR-SP）的长视频强化学习训练基础设施，集成序列并行和为长视频定制的 vLLM 引擎，并使用缓存的视频嵌入实现高效轨迹生成与预填充。在实验中，LongVILA-R1-7B 在视频基准上表现强劲，在 VideoMME 无字幕和有字幕设置下分别达到 65.1% 和 71.1% 的准确率，并在多个基准上持续优于 LongVILA-7B。此外，LongVILA-R1-7B 支持每个视频最多处理 8,192 帧，并支持可配置的帧率设置。值得关注的是，MR-SP 系统在长视频强化学习训练中最高实现 2.1 倍加速。我们还公开发布训练系统，支持视频、文本和音频等多种模态，VILA 和 Qwen 系列等多种模型，甚至支持图像与视频生成模型的强化学习训练。在单个 A100 节点、共 8 个 GPU 上，该系统可以对时长一小时的视频，例如 3,600 帧，进行强化学习训练。
2507.07966.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2606.12688.en: We are entering a new era of composite model architectures that integrate diverse components such as vision encoders, language backbones, diffusion and flow heads, audio codecs, action generators, and world-model predictors. Such architectures underpin a broad class of multimodal models, including unified multimodal models, omni models, speech-language models, vision-language-action policies, and world models. However, existing model serving frameworks were built on narrow assumptions about model structure, making them ill-suited to accommodate this new architectural diversity. Here we present M*, a universal serving system for efficient serving of composite AI models. M* represents models as dataflow graphs, processing requests spanning diverse modalities and tasks as traversals over these graphs. The core insight is a modular abstraction that supports arbitrary composition of model components, flexible placement onto a physical cluster, and model-agnostic optimizations within a distributed runtime. We call this abstraction the Walk Graph and show how it can concisely capture composite models from a broad range of families. We instantiate M* on representative models and find that it achieves, on average, 20% lower end-to-end latency than vLLM-Omni for text-to-image workloads on BAGEL, while delivering up to 2.9x lower real-time factor and 2.7x higher throughput for text-to-speech workloads on Qwen3-Omni. M* also outperforms the V-JEPA 2-AC rollout baseline for robotic planning by up to 12.5x. Thus, our work paves the road towards more efficient serving of complex models with minimal developer effort.
2606.12688.zh: 我们正进入复合模型架构的新时代，这类架构整合视觉编码器、语言骨干网络、扩散与流模型头、音频编解码器、动作生成器和世界模型预测器等多种组件。它们支撑着广泛的多模态模型，包括统一多模态模型、全模态模型、语音语言模型、视觉语言动作策略，以及世界模型。然而，现有模型服务框架建立在对模型结构的狭窄假设之上，难以适应这种新的架构多样性。本文提出 M*，一个高效服务复合 AI 模型的通用服务系统。M* 将模型表示为数据流图，把跨越不同模态和任务的请求处理为在这些图上的遍历。其核心洞见是模块化抽象，支持模型组件的任意组合、在物理集群上的灵活放置，以及分布式运行时内部与具体模型无关的优化。我们将这一抽象称为 Walk Graph，并展示它如何简洁地表达广泛模型家族中的复合模型。我们在代表性模型上实现 M*，发现它在 BAGEL 文生图工作负载上的平均端到端延迟比 vLLM-Omni 低 20%；在 Qwen3-Omni 文本转语音工作负载上，实时因子最高降低至原来的 1/2.9，吞吐量最高提高至 2.7 倍。在机器人规划中，M* 相较 V-JEPA 2-AC 轨迹生成基线最高实现 12.5 倍性能提升。因此，我们的工作为以极少的开发者投入实现复杂模型的高效服务铺平了道路。
2606.12688.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.32395.en: The KV cache of a transformer entangles every token's representation with its entire prefix: a passage encoded once cannot be reused under a different prefix or removed without recomputing everything after it, so exact cache reuse is limited to shared prefixes. We present SMem, an architecture whose context representation is a cache by construction. A block-local encoder maps each block to memory rows independently of other blocks, and a reader conditions generation on their union through cross-attention. For every parameter setting, memory composes exactly at fixed block indices, deleting a block is an exact $O(b)$ update for $b$-token blocks, and the memory state is independent of the edit path. At $4\times$ the training context, under the shared recipe, SMem retrieves planted needles beyond any trained-length window (exact match 0.14-0.28 at distances of 31 and 63 blocks), where learned-position, RoPE, and Block-Attention-style transformers all score at most 0.02. A fully cached context is served by computing one block alone at a near-constant 3.1-6.2 ms, whereas cold prefill grows with context; batched decode stores 34-38% fewer KV rows and runs 1.4-1.7$\times$ faster when bandwidth-bound; and deletion beats suffix recomputation by 8.5$\times$ at 512 blocks and 452$\times$ at 4096 blocks (32-256$\times$ the trained length, probing the cost model rather than a served regime). The cost is a perplexity gap of -4.7% to +2.8% (negative favors SMem) against a parameter-matched transformer with the same positional scheme, at 160M-1.5B on FineWeb-Edu across two recipes and a learning-rate search. SMem also composes with RoPE: at 160M and 410M the composite matches or leads the matched transformer and closes 29-59% of SMem's gap to a RoPE transformer. Dropping prefix entanglement thus keeps perplexity comparable while making the cache exactly composable and editable.
2609.32395.zh: Transformer 的 KV 缓存将每个 token 的表示与其完整前缀耦合在一起：一段文本编码一次后，既无法在不同前缀下直接复用，也无法在不重算其后全部内容的情况下删除，因此精确缓存复用仅限于共享前缀。我们提出 SMem，一种从结构上就使上下文表示成为缓存的架构。块内编码器独立于其他块，将每个块映射为若干记忆行；读取器则通过交叉注意力，以这些记忆行的并集为条件进行生成。对于任意参数设置，在固定块索引下记忆都能精确组合；对于含 b 个 token 的块，删除一个块是精确的 O(b) 更新，而且最终记忆状态与编辑路径无关。在相同训练方案下，将上下文扩展到训练长度的 4 倍时，SMem 能够在任何训练长度窗口之外检索人为植入的信息：在相距 31 和 63 个块时，精确匹配得分为 0.14–0.28，而学习式位置编码、RoPE 和 Block-Attention 风格 Transformer 的得分均不超过 0.02。对于完整缓存的上下文，服务时只需计算一个块，耗时近乎恒定，为 3.1–6.2 毫秒，而冷启动预填充开销随上下文增长。批量解码存储的 KV 行减少 34%–38%，在带宽受限时加速 1.4–1.7 倍；删除操作在 512 个块时比后缀重算快 8.5 倍，在 4096 个块时快 452 倍。这两个设置对应训练长度的 32–256 倍，用于探查成本模型，而非实际服务区间。其代价是：在 FineWeb-Edu 上，对 160M–1.5B 模型采用两种训练方案并搜索学习率后，与参数量相同、位置编码方案相同的 Transformer 相比，困惑度差距为 −4.7% 至 +2.8%，其中负值表示 SMem 更优。SMem 还可以与 RoPE 组合：在 160M 和 410M 规模下，组合模型持平或优于匹配的 Transformer，并弥合了 SMem 相对 RoPE Transformer 差距的 29%–59%。因此，去除与前缀的耦合，既能保持相近困惑度，又能让缓存具备精确组合和编辑能力。
2609.32395.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2407.00079.en: Mooncake is the serving platform for Kimi, a leading LLM service provided by Moonshot AI. It features a KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates the prefill and decoding clusters. It also leverages the underutilized CPU, DRAM, and SSD resources of the GPU cluster to implement a disaggregated cache of KVCache. The core of Mooncake is its KVCache-centric scheduler, which balances maximizing overall effective throughput while meeting latency-related Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Unlike traditional studies that assume all requests will be processed, Mooncake faces challenges due to highly overloaded scenarios. To mitigate these, we developed a prediction-based early rejection policy. Experiments show that Mooncake excels in long-context scenarios. Compared to the baseline method, Mooncake can achieve up to a 525% increase in throughput in certain simulated scenarios while adhering to SLOs. Under real workloads, Mooncake's innovative architecture enables Kimi to handle 75% more requests.
2407.00079.zh: Mooncake 是 Moonshot AI 旗下领先 LLM 服务 Kimi 的服务平台。它采用以 KVCache 为中心的分离式架构，将预填充集群与解码集群分开。它还利用 GPU 集群中利用不足的 CPU、DRAM 和 SSD 资源，实现分离式 KVCache 缓存。Mooncake 的核心是以 KVCache 为中心的调度器，在满足延迟相关服务等级目标（SLO）的同时，尽量最大化总体有效吞吐量。与假设所有请求都会得到处理的传统研究不同，Mooncake 面临高度过载场景带来的挑战。为缓解这一问题，我们开发了基于预测的提前拒绝策略。实验表明，Mooncake 在长上下文场景中表现出色。与基线方法相比，它在某些模拟场景中可在遵守 SLO 的同时，最高提高 525% 的吞吐量。在真实工作负载中，Mooncake 的创新架构使 Kimi 能够多处理 75% 的请求。
2407.00079.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2603.18897.en: LLM-powered agents execute tasks through a sequential loop of model generation and tool execution. Today's serving systems serialize this loop, leaving tool latency exposed on the task critical path. This paper presents PASTE, a tool-aware agent-serving system that predicts concrete future tool invocations from recurring agent patterns and executes them speculatively while the LLM is still generating. PASTE isolates speculative results until confirmed by the LLM and jointly schedules tool execution and returning LLM sessions to avoid shifting bottlenecks to the GPU. Across deep research, coding, and scientific-agent workloads, PASTE reduces average task completion time by 43.5% and lowers observed tool latency by 1.8x.
2603.18897.zh: LLM 驱动的智能体通过模型生成与工具执行交替组成的顺序循环来完成任务。当前服务系统将这一循环串行化，使工具延迟直接暴露在任务关键路径上。本文提出 PASTE，一个具备工具感知能力的智能体服务系统。它从反复出现的智能体行为模式中预测具体的未来工具调用，并在 LLM 仍在生成时推测性地执行这些调用。PASTE 会隔离推测结果，直到它们得到 LLM 确认，并联合调度工具执行与返回的 LLM 会话，以避免将瓶颈转移到 GPU。在深度研究、编程和科学智能体工作负载上，PASTE 将平均任务完成时间降低 43.5%，将观测到的工具延迟缩短 1.8 倍。
2603.18897.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2505.04021.en: Inference providers must maintain availability for many LLMs, including low-volume but essential models, making resource efficiency increasingly important as token prices fall. Analysis of production traces reveals a dynamic bursty-group pattern in which sets of models become active together and shift over time; existing space- and time-sharing approaches lack principled mechanisms to adapt to this variability, forcing trade-offs between SLO adherence and efficiency. We observe that elastic memory allocation can unify spatial and temporal sharing. Based on this insight, we have developed Prism, a memory-centric LLM co-serving framework that applies memory ballooning to reclaim memory across models and support both forms of sharing under a single scheme. Prism's balloon driver, referred to as kvcached, has been open-sourced at https://github.com/ovg-project/kvcached , and deployed in production environments across 10K+ GPUs.
2505.04021.zh: 推理服务提供商必须保证大量 LLM 的可用性，其中也包括访问量较低但不可或缺的模型；随着 token 价格下降，资源效率变得越来越重要。对生产轨迹的分析揭示出一种动态的突发组模式：一组模型会同时活跃，而且这些组随时间变化。现有空间共享和时间共享方法缺乏有原则的机制来适应这种变化，迫使系统在 SLO 达标与效率之间取舍。我们观察到，弹性内存分配可以统一空间共享和时间共享。基于这一洞见，我们开发了 Prism，一个以内存为中心的 LLM 共同服务框架，利用内存气球机制在模型之间回收内存，并在同一方案下支持这两种共享形式。Prism 的气球驱动称为 kvcached，已通过 https://github.com/ovg-project/kvcached 开源，并部署于覆盖 10K+ 个 GPU 的生产环境中。
2505.04021.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2505.04021.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2509.24381.en: Large multimodal models (LMMs) typically employ an encoding module to transform multimodal data inputs into embeddings, which are then fed to language models for further processing. However, efficiently serving LMMs remains highly challenging due to the inherent complexity of their inference pipelines. Traditional serving engines co-locate the encoding module and the language model, leading to significant resource interference and tight data dependency. Recent studies have alleviated this issue by disaggregating the encoding module from the model, following a design style of prefill-decode disaggregation. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to fully exploit parallelism both within individual requests (intra-request) and across multiple requests (inter-request). To overcome the limitation, we propose REDServe, an LMM inference system that efficiently orchestrates intra- and inter-request pipelines. REDServe is designed to reduce low latency and maximize parallelism at both intra- and inter-request granularities. Built on the disaggregated architecture of the encoding module and language model, REDServe adopts a fine-grained scheduling method that overlaps multimodal encoding with the forward computation of the language model within a single request. For inter-request pipeline, REDServe leverages schedulable tokens and token budgets to balance computational loads across micro-batches. Combined with chunked prefill, this enables a novel scheduling strategy that coordinates the execution of intra- and inter-request pipelines. Experimental evaluations on representative LMMs show that REDServe achieves substantial latency reduction of up to 66% while improving throughput by up to 109%, significantly outperforming existing serving approaches.
2509.24381.zh: 大型多模态模型（LMM）通常使用编码模块，将多模态输入转换为嵌入，再送入语言模型继续处理。然而，推理流水线固有的复杂性，使高效服务 LMM 仍然非常困难。传统服务引擎将编码模块与语言模型共置，导致显著资源干扰和紧密的数据依赖。近期研究借鉴预填充—解码分离的设计风格，将编码模块从模型中分离，缓解了这一问题。但这些方法未能充分利用单个请求内部和多个请求之间的并行性。为克服这一限制，我们提出 REDServe，一个高效编排请求内与请求间流水线的 LMM 推理系统。REDServe 旨在降低延迟，并在这两个粒度上最大化并行性。基于编码模块与语言模型的分离式架构，REDServe 采用细粒度调度，在单个请求内重叠多模态编码与语言模型前向计算。对于请求间流水线，REDServe 利用可调度 token 和 token 预算，平衡不同微批次的计算负载。与分块预填充结合后，这形成了一种协调请求内和请求间流水线执行的新调度策略。在代表性 LMM 上的实验表明，REDServe 最高降低 66% 的延迟，同时最高提高 109% 的吞吐量，显著优于现有服务方式。
2509.24381.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.15186.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region keep histories that omit it. Reuse without repair is exact up to four documents and degrades at sixteen, where suffix repair recovers 98-100%. Faithful repair re-encodes most of the context, so in a single-request L40S study SAFE-KV's operating rule serves every workload by full prefill. SAFE-KV thus establishes the causal-state contract for non-prefix reuse and a validated repair mechanism that meets it.
2610.15186.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）会在许多请求中重复使用相同文档，因此非前缀 KV 缓存复用很有吸引力。然而，缓存的文档状态并不是可以任意复用的文本：它是受上下文条件约束的因果状态，其键和值取决于计算时使用的前缀、位置和先前文档。我们以针对完全相同提示执行的完整预填充为参照，将非前缀 KV 复用表述为保持行为的问题，并提出 SAFE-KV：从选定的起始文档开始，重新编码其因果后缀，以修复组合后的缓存。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，受前缀条件约束的缓存组合仅能保留 HotpotQA-500 中 47.2% 和 2Wiki-500 中 37.8% 的完整预填充答案。采用风险引导 K2 选择的 SAFE-KV，在供体复制协议下分别恢复至 99.8% 和 98.4%，实际执行后缀前向计算时则达到 100.0% 和 98.4%。仅修复文档本身或固定窗口的方法恢复得少得多，因为修复区域之后的文档状态，仍保留着遗漏该区域的历史。不加修复的复用在最多四篇文档时保持精确，但在十六篇文档时退化；后缀修复可将其恢复至 98%–100%。忠实修复需要重新编码大部分上下文，因此在单请求 L40S 研究中，SAFE-KV 的运行规则对每个工作负载都选择完整预填充。由此，SAFE-KV 确立了非前缀复用的因果状态契约，以及经验证满足该契约的修复机制。
2610.15186.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2312.07104.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for complex tasks that require multiple generation calls, advanced prompting techniques, control flow, and structured inputs/outputs. However, efficient systems are lacking for programming and executing these applications. We introduce SGLang, a system for efficient execution of complex language model programs. SGLang consists of a frontend language and a runtime. The frontend simplifies programming with primitives for generation and parallelism control. The runtime accelerates execution with novel optimizations like RadixAttention for KV cache reuse and compressed finite state machines for faster structured output decoding. Experiments show that SGLang achieves up to 6.4x higher throughput compared to state-of-the-art inference systems on various large language and multi-modal models on tasks including agent control, logical reasoning, few-shot learning benchmarks, JSON decoding, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and multi-turn chat. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang
2312.07104.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于需要多次生成调用、高级提示技术、控制流和结构化输入输出的复杂任务。然而，对这类应用进行编程和执行的高效系统仍然不足。我们提出 SGLang，一个高效执行复杂语言模型程序的系统。SGLang 由前端语言和运行时组成。前端通过生成和并行控制原语简化编程；运行时则利用新的优化加速执行，包括用于 KV 缓存复用的 RadixAttention，以及用于加速结构化输出解码的压缩有限状态机。在多种大型语言模型和多模态模型上，针对智能体控制、逻辑推理、少样本学习基准、JSON 解码、检索增强生成流水线和多轮对话等任务的实验表明，SGLang 相较先进推理系统最高实现 6.4 倍吞吐量。代码已通过 https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang 公开。
2312.07104.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2312.07104.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2311.15566.en: The high computational and memory requirements of generative large language models (LLMs) make it challenging to serve them cheaply. This paper aims to reduce the monetary cost for serving LLMs by leveraging preemptible GPU instances on modern clouds, which offer accesses to spare GPUs at a much cheaper price than regular instances but may be preempted by the cloud at any time. Serving LLMs on preemptible instances requires addressing challenges induced by frequent instance preemptions and the necessity of migrating instances to handle these preemptions. This paper presents SpotServe, the first distributed LLM serving system on preemptible instances. Several key techniques in SpotServe realize fast and reliable serving of generative LLMs on cheap preemptible instances. First, SpotServe dynamically adapts the LLM parallelization configuration for dynamic instance availability and fluctuating workload, while balancing the trade-off among the overall throughput, inference latency and monetary costs. Second, to minimize the cost of migrating instances for dynamic reparallelization, the task of migrating instances is formulated as a bipartite graph matching problem, which uses the Kuhn-Munkres algorithm to identify an optimal migration plan that minimizes communications. Finally, to take advantage of the grace period offered by modern clouds, we introduce stateful inference recovery, a new inference mechanism that commits inference progress at a much finer granularity and allows SpotServe to cheaply resume inference upon preemption. We evaluate on real spot instance preemption traces and various popular LLMs and show that SpotServe can reduce the P99 tail latency by 2.4 - 9.1x compared with the best existing LLM serving systems. We also show that SpotServe can leverage the price advantage of preemptive instances, saving 54% monetary cost compared with only using on-demand instances.
2311.15566.zh: 生成式大型语言模型（LLM）对计算与内存的高需求，使低成本服务难以实现。本文旨在利用现代云平台的可抢占 GPU 实例降低 LLM 服务的货币成本。这类实例以远低于常规实例的价格提供闲置 GPU，但云平台可能随时将其抢占。在可抢占实例上服务 LLM，需要处理频繁实例抢占，以及为应对抢占而必须进行实例迁移所带来的挑战。本文提出 SpotServe，这是首个运行在可抢占实例上的分布式 LLM 服务系统。SpotServe 通过若干关键技术，在廉价可抢占实例上实现快速、可靠的生成式 LLM 服务。首先，SpotServe 针对动态变化的实例可用性和波动工作负载，自适应调整 LLM 并行配置，同时权衡总体吞吐量、推理延迟和货币成本。其次，为尽量降低动态重新并行化中的实例迁移成本，它将迁移任务建模为二分图匹配问题，使用 Kuhn–Munkres 算法寻找通信量最小的最优迁移计划。最后，为利用现代云平台提供的宽限期，我们引入有状态推理恢复机制，以更细粒度提交推理进展，使 SpotServe 能够在抢占后低成本恢复推理。使用真实竞价实例抢占轨迹和多种常用 LLM 的评估表明，相较最佳现有 LLM 服务系统，SpotServe 将 P99 尾部延迟缩短 2.4–9.1 倍。我们还表明，SpotServe 能够利用可抢占实例的价格优势，相较仅使用按需实例节省 54% 的货币成本。
2311.15566.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2510.18586.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in complex multi-agent applications that rely on external function calls. This workload creates severe performance challenges for the KV Cache: spatial contention leads to the eviction of critical agents' caches and temporal underutilization leaves the cache of agents stalled on long-running function calls idling in GPU memory. We present TokenCake, a KV-Cache-centric serving framework that bridges this gap by co-optimizing scheduling and memory management through an agent-aware design. TokenCake's Temporal Scheduler employs an event-driven, opportunistic policy to proactively offload idle KV Caches during function calls and uses predictive uploading to hide data transfer latency. TokenCake's Spatial Scheduler uses dynamic memory partitioning, guided by a hybrid priority metric combining graph structure and runtime state, to reserve GPU memory for critical-path agents. Our evaluation on representative multi-agent benchmarks shows that TokenCake reduces end-to-end latency by up to 47.06% in memory-constrained settings and improves effective GPU utilization by 16.9 percentage points compared to vLLM. TokenCake is publicly available at https://github.com/pkulemonade/TokenCake .
2510.18586.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在依赖外部函数调用的复杂多智能体应用中。这类工作负载给 KV 缓存带来严重性能挑战：空间竞争会导致关键智能体的缓存被驱逐，而时间上的利用不足则使等待长时间函数调用的智能体，其缓存闲置在 GPU 内存中。我们提出 TokenCake，一个以 KV 缓存为中心的服务框架，通过智能体感知设计联合优化调度和内存管理，解决这一问题。TokenCake 的时间调度器采用事件驱动、机会式策略，在函数调用期间主动卸载空闲 KV 缓存，并通过预测性回传隐藏数据传输延迟。TokenCake 的空间调度器使用动态内存分区，并由结合图结构与运行时状态的混合优先级指标引导，为关键路径上的智能体预留 GPU 内存。在代表性多智能体基准上的评估表明，在内存受限设置下，TokenCake 最高将端到端延迟降低 47.06%；相较 vLLM，有效 GPU 利用率提高 16.9 个百分点。TokenCake 已通过 https://github.com/pkulemonade/TokenCake 公开。
2510.18586.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2510.18586.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2309.06180.en: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4$\times$ with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
2309.06180.zh: 要实现大型语言模型（LLM）的高吞吐量服务，必须一次批量处理足够多的请求。然而，现有系统难以做到这一点，因为每个请求的键值缓存（KV 缓存）占用大量内存，而且会动态增长和缩小。低效管理会因内存碎片和冗余复制浪费大量空间，从而限制批次大小。为解决这一问题，我们提出 PagedAttention，一种受操作系统经典虚拟内存与分页技术启发的注意力算法。在此基础上，我们构建了 LLM 服务系统 vLLM，实现：（1）KV 缓存内存几乎零浪费；（2）在请求内部和请求之间灵活共享 KV 缓存，进一步减少内存用量。评估表明，在相同延迟水平下，vLLM 相较 FasterTransformer、Orca 等先进系统，将常用 LLM 的吞吐量提高至 2–4 倍。序列越长、模型越大、解码算法越复杂，改进就越显著。vLLM 的源代码已通过 https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm 公开。
2309.06180.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2309.06180.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2610.09307.en: Interaction with intelligent systems is expanding beyond text-centric chatbots and coding agents. Speech-native assistants, visual generation and editing, world-model environments, and robot action loops require models that emit text, audio, images, video, and actions. These models differ in execution pattern: multi-stage autoregressive omni and TTS pipelines, iterative diffusion or flow-matching generators, and longer-lived world-model or robot loops that carry state across steps. As a result, serving is no longer a single text decode loop, but a heterogeneous multi-stage workflow with cross-stage transfer, streaming, and session-shaped interaction. Existing inference stacks are typically optimized for one architecture family. LLM servers deepen autoregressive scheduling and KV management, while diffusion stacks deepen denoising and parallel generation. Neither provides a shared control plane for pipelines that emit speech, pixels, or actions through separate generators, so production deployments often fall back to ad-hoc composition across disjoint runtimes. We present vLLM-Omni, a unified serving runtime for omni-modality generation. vLLM-Omni organizes each workload as a multi-stage pipeline under a single orchestrator that admits requests, advances them across stages, and demultiplexes streaming outputs. Specialized engines and stage replicas provide compute; a connector carries heavy payloads on the data plane; and session-oriented control supports long-lived duplex, world-model, and robot workloads. This report covers the architecture (stage-level KV paths, replica pools, multi-hardware platforms, and efficiency stack) and OpenAI-compatible and OpenPI APIs for omni, TTS, image/video, world-model, robot, and duplex workloads. We evaluate on the multimodal nightly CI on H100 (TTS and MiniCPM-o on H200), focused on Qwen3-Omni.
2610.09307.zh: 人与智能系统的交互正超越以文本为中心的聊天机器人和编程智能体。原生语音助手、视觉生成与编辑、世界模型环境，以及机器人动作循环，都需要能够输出文本、音频、图像、视频和动作的模型。这些模型的执行模式各不相同：既有多阶段自回归全模态与文本转语音流水线，也有迭代式扩散或流匹配生成器，还有跨步骤携带状态、存续时间更长的世界模型或机器人循环。因此，服务不再是单一文本解码循环，而是包含跨阶段传输、流式处理和会话式交互的异构多阶段工作流。现有推理软件栈通常只针对一个架构家族优化：LLM 服务器深耕自回归调度与 KV 管理，扩散软件栈则深耕去噪和并行生成。二者都没有为通过不同生成器输出语音、像素或动作的流水线提供共享控制平面，因此生产部署往往退回到跨独立运行时的临时拼接。我们提出 vLLM-Omni，一个面向全模态生成的统一服务运行时。vLLM-Omni 将每种工作负载组织成由统一编排器管理的多阶段流水线；编排器负责请求准入、推动请求跨阶段前进，以及对流式输出进行解复用。专用引擎和阶段副本提供计算能力，连接器在数据平面上传输大体量载荷，面向会话的控制则支持长时间运行的双工、世界模型和机器人工作负载。本报告介绍其架构，包括阶段级 KV 通路、副本池、多硬件平台和效率优化栈，以及面向全模态、文本转语音、图像与视频、世界模型、机器人和双工工作负载的 OpenAI 兼容 API 与 OpenPI API。我们在 H100 上的多模态每日持续集成环境中开展评估，重点关注 Qwen3-Omni；文本转语音和 MiniCPM-o 则在 H200 上评估。
2610.09307.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2604.09073.en: Diffusion model deployment has been suffering from high energy consumption and inference latency despite its superior performance in visual generation tasks. Dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) offers a promising solution to exploit the potential of the underlying accelerators. However, existing approaches often lead to either limited efficiency gains or degraded output quality because they overlook the inherent fault tolerance of the diffusion model. Therefore, in this paper, we propose DRIFT, a novel algorithmarchitecture co-optimization framework that harnesses the fault tolerance for efficient and reliable diffusion model inference. We first perform a comprehensive resilience analysis on representative diffusion models. Building on these observations, we introduce a fine-grained, resilience-aware DVFS strategy that selectively protects error-sensitive network blocks and timesteps, and a rollback algorithm-based fault tolerance (ABFT) mechanism that adaptively corrects only critical errors by reverting to previous timesteps. We further optimize offloading intervals and reorganize data layouts to reduce memory overhead. Experiments across diverse models and datasets show that DRIFT can achieve on average 36% energy savings through voltage underscaling or 1.7x speedup via overclocking while maintaining generation quality.
2604.09073.zh: 尽管扩散模型在视觉生成任务中表现优异，其部署仍受高能耗和高推理延迟困扰。动态电压与频率调整（DVFS）为挖掘底层加速器潜力提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，现有方法忽略了扩散模型固有的容错能力，往往只能带来有限效率收益，或导致输出质量下降。因此，本文提出 DRIFT，一个新的算法—架构协同优化框架，利用这种容错能力实现高效、可靠的扩散模型推理。我们首先对代表性扩散模型进行全面的鲁棒性分析。在这些观察的基础上，我们引入细粒度、感知错误耐受能力的 DVFS 策略，选择性保护对错误敏感的网络块和时间步；同时提出基于回滚的算法级容错（ABFT）机制，通过回退到之前的时间步，自适应地仅纠正关键错误。我们进一步优化卸载间隔并重组数据布局，以减少内存开销。在多种模型与数据集上的实验表明，在保持生成质量的同时，DRIFT 通过低电压运行平均节省 36% 能耗，或通过超频实现 1.7 倍加速。
2604.09073.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2604.04335.en: Diffusion models have emerged as the prevailing approach for text-to-image (T2I) and text-to-video (T2V) generation, yet production platforms must increasingly serve both modalities on shared GPU clusters while meeting stringent latency SLOs. Co-serving such heterogeneous workloads is challenging: T2I and T2V requests exhibit vastly different compute demands, parallelism characteristics, and latency requirements, leading to significant SLO violations in existing serving systems. We present GENSERVE, a co-serving system that leverages the inherent predictability of the diffusion process to optimize serving efficiency. A central insight is that diffusion inference proceeds in discrete, predictable steps and is naturally preemptible at step boundaries, opening a new design space for heterogeneity-aware resource management. GENSERVE introduces step-level resource adaptation through three coordinated mechanisms: intelligent video preemption, elastic sequence parallelism with dynamic batching, and an SLO-aware scheduler that jointly optimizes resource allocation across all concurrent requests. Experimental results show that GENSERVE improves the SLO attainment rate by up to 44% over the strongest baseline across diverse configurations.
2604.04335.zh: 扩散模型已成为文生图（T2I）和文生视频（T2V）的主流方法，但生产平台越来越需要在共享 GPU 集群上同时服务这两种模态，并满足严格的延迟 SLO。共同服务这类异构工作负载十分困难：T2I 与 T2V 请求在计算需求、并行特征和延迟要求上存在巨大差异，导致现有服务系统出现大量 SLO 违约。我们提出 GENSERVE，一个利用扩散过程固有可预测性来优化服务效率的共同服务系统。其核心洞见是，扩散推理以离散、可预测的步骤推进，并且天然可以在步骤边界被抢占，从而为异构感知资源管理打开新的设计空间。GENSERVE 通过三种相互协调的机制引入步骤级资源自适应：智能视频抢占、结合动态批处理的弹性序列并行，以及联合优化所有并发请求资源分配的 SLO 感知调度器。实验表明，在多种配置下，GENSERVE 相较最强基线最高将 SLO 达标率提高 44%。
2604.04335.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2509.04719.en: The widespread adoption of diffusion models for image generation necessitates efficient parallel inference to manage their substantial computational overhead. However, current parallel inference paradigms primarily target homogeneous clusters, often failing to maintain high efficiency in realistic, heterogeneous multi-GPU environments where hardware disparities and fluctuating background workloads cause severe straggler effects. This paper introduces Orchestra, a robust framework that orchestrates fine-grained parallelism across both temporal and spatial dimensions to harmonize computational loads in such settings. Temporally, Orchestra employs a novel computation-aware step allocator using a tiered step reduction strategy, intelligently pruning denoising steps on slower devices after warmup phases and execution synchronization. Spatially, Orchestra performs an elastic patch parallelism mechanism which adaptively adjusts the spatial workload intensity by assigning non-uniform image patches tailored to GPUs according to their computational capability. Extensive experiments on load-imbalanced and heterogeneous clusters validate Orchestra's efficacy in mitigating performance bottlenecks. Compared to patch parallelism, a state-of-the-art diffusion inference framework, our method reduces end-to-end latency by up to 45% and significantly boosts resource utilization on heterogeneous GPUs.
2509.04719.zh: 扩散模型在图像生成中的广泛应用，要求高效并行推理以应对其显著计算开销。然而，当前并行推理范式主要面向同构集群，往往无法在真实的异构多 GPU 环境中保持高效率；硬件差异和波动的后台工作负载会引发严重的拖尾效应。本文提出 Orchestra，一个稳健的框架，在时间与空间两个维度编排细粒度并行，以平衡这类环境中的计算负载。在时间维度，Orchestra 使用一种新的计算感知步骤分配器，采用分层步数缩减策略，在预热阶段与执行同步之后，智能裁剪较慢设备上的去噪步骤。在空间维度，Orchestra 采用弹性块并行机制，根据 GPU 的计算能力，为其分配非均匀图像块，自适应调整空间工作负载强度。在负载不均衡和异构集群上的广泛实验验证了 Orchestra 缓解性能瓶颈的有效性。相较先进的扩散推理块并行框架，该方法最高降低 45% 的端到端延迟，并显著提高异构 GPU 的资源利用率。
2509.04719.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2503.06923.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) have revolutionized high-fidelity image and video synthesis, yet their computational demands remain prohibitive for real-time applications. To solve this problem, feature caching has been proposed to accelerate diffusion models by caching the features in the previous timesteps and then reusing them in the following timesteps. However, at timesteps with significant intervals, the feature similarity in diffusion models decreases substantially, leading to a pronounced increase in errors introduced by feature caching, significantly harming the generation quality. To solve this problem, we propose TaylorSeer, which firstly shows that features of diffusion models at future timesteps can be predicted based on their values at previous timesteps. Based on the fact that features change slowly and continuously across timesteps, TaylorSeer employs a differential method to approximate the higher-order derivatives of features and predict features in future timesteps with Taylor series expansion. Extensive experiments demonstrate its significant effectiveness in both image and video synthesis, especially in high acceleration ratios. For instance, it achieves an almost lossless acceleration of 4.99$\times$ on FLUX and 5.00$\times$ on HunyuanVideo without additional training. On DiT, it achieves $3.41$ lower FID compared with previous SOTA at $4.53$$\times$ acceleration. %Our code is provided in the supplementary materials and will be made publicly available on GitHub. Our codes have been released in Github: https://github.com/Shenyi-Z/TaylorSeer
2503.06923.zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）革新了高保真图像与视频合成，但其计算需求仍高得难以支持实时应用。为解决这一问题，已有研究提出特征缓存：保存之前时间步的特征，并在后续时间步复用，以加速扩散模型。然而，当时间步间隔较大时，扩散模型的特征相似性会显著下降，使特征缓存引入的误差明显增大，严重损害生成质量。为此，我们提出 TaylorSeer，首先表明可以根据先前时间步的特征值预测未来时间步的特征。基于特征随时间步缓慢且连续变化这一事实，TaylorSeer 使用差分方法近似特征的高阶导数，再利用泰勒级数展开预测未来特征。大量实验显示，它在图像和视频合成中都显著有效，在高加速比下尤其如此。例如，无需额外训练，它在 FLUX 上实现近乎无损的 4.99 倍加速，在 HunyuanVideo 上实现 5.00 倍加速。在 DiT 上，以 4.53 倍加速运行时，其 FID 比此前最先进方法低 3.41。代码在补充材料中提供，并将于 GitHub 公开；代码已在 GitHub 发布，可通过 https://github.com/Shenyi-Z/TaylorSeer 获取。
2503.06923.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2503.06923.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2606.10135.en: Interactive video world models commonly convert bidirectional video generators into causal autoregressive systems through control fine-tuning, autoregressive training, causal initialization, and few-step distillation. This pipeline is costly, while frozen causal histories accumulate errors that degrade long-horizon fidelity and controllability. We present BiWM, the first open-source full-stack training framework for bidirectional autoregressive video world models. BiWM retains full attention within each generated chunk and requires only two stages: camera/action-control fine-tuning and few-step Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD). Both stages converge within a few hundred optimizer steps on 8 H200 GPUs. The framework supports Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, HunyuanVideo-1.5-TI2V-8B, and LTX-2.3-22B, together with real-world camera control, pluggable long-history compression, and optional low-bit deployment. Supervised and forward-KL anchors mitigate DMD mode collapse and preserve scene dynamics. BiWM provides a compact, reproducible path from pretrained bidirectional video models to interactive, controllable, and efficient world models.
2606.10135.zh: 交互式视频世界模型通常需要经过控制微调、自回归训练、因果初始化和少步蒸馏，将双向视频生成器转换为因果自回归系统。这条流水线成本很高，而且被冻结的因果历史会累积错误，削弱长时程保真度和可控性。我们提出 BiWM，首个面向双向自回归视频世界模型的开源全栈训练框架。BiWM 在每个生成片段内部保留完整注意力，并且仅需两个阶段：相机与动作控制微调，以及少步分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）。这两个阶段都能在 8 个 H200 GPU 上，仅用数百个优化器步骤收敛。该框架支持 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、Wan2.2-TI2V-5B、HunyuanVideo-1.5-TI2V-8B 和 LTX-2.3-22B，同时支持真实世界相机控制、可插拔的长历史压缩，以及可选的低比特部署。监督锚点和前向 KL 锚点能够缓解 DMD 模式坍塌，并保留场景动态。BiWM 为将预训练双向视频模型转化为交互式、可控且高效的世界模型，提供了一条紧凑、可复现的路径。
2606.10135.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.32540.en: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.
2609.32540.zh: 少步自回归视频扩散通过将长视频划分为时间片段，再逐片段生成来完成合成，每个片段只经过一小段去噪阶段序列。为了记住已经生成的片段，先前方法会额外执行前向计算，重建干净或噪声较少的键值（KV）缓存；这些计算只构建缓存，并不推进输出潜变量。然而，每次去噪前向本身已经计算了当前片段的执行中 KV。我们提出 FlashForward，直接复用这些缓存，避免昂贵的、仅用于更新缓存的模型前向计算。当前片段完成一个去噪阶段后，其对应阶段的缓存就已可供下一片段使用。因此，为每个阶段分配一个 GPU，就能让不同片段同时占据不同阶段。这种提前可用性会付出质量代价：按阶段匹配的历史含有噪声，导致片段之间出现外观和运动漂移。为弥补这一问题，FlashForward 在对应区域生成之前，先产生稀疏的辅助干净锚点潜变量，用双侧条件稳定生成轨迹。这两类记忆作用于不同时间尺度：稀疏的干净锚点 KV 提供粗粒度、长程的双侧结构引导，而稠密的阶段匹配历史保留细粒度、近期的演化信息。使用最多四个 GPU，在 1.3B 和 14B 骨干模型、480p 与 720p 分辨率下生成帧率为 16 FPS、时长不少于 20 秒的视频时，FlashForward 比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69 倍，比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92 倍。在 VBench 上，480p 的 1.3B 模型取得更高得分，并在更长时长下保持稳定，表明 FlashForward 能以快得多的生成速度，生成时长为 20 秒、35 秒和 65 秒的高质量、时间一致视频。
2609.32540.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2602.10825.en: Autoregressive models, often built on Transformer architectures, represent a powerful paradigm for generating ultra-long videos by synthesizing content in sequential chunks. However, this sequential generation process is notoriously slow. While caching strategies have proven effective for accelerating traditional video diffusion models, existing methods assume uniform denoising across all frames-an assumption that breaks down in autoregressive models where different video chunks exhibit varying similarity patterns at identical timesteps. In this paper, we present FlowCache, the first caching framework specifically designed for autoregressive video generation. Our key insight is that each video chunk should maintain independent caching policies, allowing fine-grained control over which chunks require recomputation at each timestep. We introduce a chunkwise caching strategy that dynamically adapts to the unique denoising characteristics of each chunk, complemented by a joint importance-redundancy optimized KV cache compression mechanism that maintains fixed memory bounds while preserving generation quality. Our method achieves remarkable speedups of 2.38 times on MAGI-1 and 6.7 times on SkyReels-V2, with negligible quality degradation (VBench: 0.87 increase and 0.79 decrease respectively). These results demonstrate that FlowCache successfully unlocks the potential of autoregressive models for real-time, ultra-long video generation-establishing a new benchmark for efficient video synthesis at scale. The code is available at https://github.com/mikeallen39/FlowCache .
2602.10825.zh: 自回归模型通常基于 Transformer 架构，通过顺序合成内容片段，为超长视频生成提供了一种强大范式。然而，这种顺序生成过程以速度缓慢著称。缓存策略已被证明能够有效加速传统视频扩散模型，但现有方法假设所有帧采用一致的去噪过程；这一假设在自回归模型中并不成立，因为不同视频片段即使处于相同时间步，也表现出不同的相似性模式。本文提出 FlowCache，首个专门面向自回归视频生成的缓存框架。我们的关键洞见是，每个视频片段都应维护独立的缓存策略，从而细粒度控制每个时间步中哪些片段需要重计算。我们引入逐片段缓存策略，动态适应各片段独特的去噪特征，并辅以联合优化重要性与冗余度的 KV 缓存压缩机制，在保持生成质量的同时将内存限制在固定边界内。该方法在 MAGI-1 上实现 2.38 倍加速，在 SkyReels-V2 上实现 6.7 倍加速，质量变化可忽略，VBench 分别提高 0.87 和降低 0.79。这些结果表明，FlowCache 成功释放了自回归模型用于实时、超长视频生成的潜力，为大规模高效视频合成建立了新的基准。代码可通过 https://github.com/mikeallen39/FlowCache 获取。

2605.09681.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models adopt a streaming generation framework, enabling long-horizon video generation with real-time responsiveness, as exemplified by the Self Forcing training paradigm. However, existing AR video diffusion models still suffer from significant attention complexity and severe memory overhead due to the redundant key-value (KV) caches across historical frames, which limits scalability. In this paper, we tackle this challenge by introducing KV cache compression into autoregressive video diffusion. We observe that attention heads in mainstream AR diffusion models exhibit markedly distinct attention patterns and functional roles that remain stable across samples and denoising steps. Building on our empirical study of head-wise functional specialization, we divide the attention heads into two categories: static heads, which focus on transitions across autoregressive chunks and intra-frame fidelity, and dynamic heads, which govern inter-frame motion and consistency. We then propose Forcing-KV, a hybrid KV cache compression strategy that performs structured static pruning for static heads and dynamic pruning based on segment-wise similarity for dynamic heads. While maintaining output quality, our method achieves a generation speed of over 29 frames per second on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU along with 30% cache memory reduction, delivering up to 1.35x and 1.50x speedups on LongLive and Self Forcing at 480P resolution, and further scaling to 2.82x speedup at 1080P resolution. Code and demo videos are provided at https://zju-jiyicheng.github.io/Forcing-KV-Page .
2605.09681.zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型采用流式生成框架，实现具有实时响应能力的长时程视频生成，Self Forcing 训练范式就是其中的代表。然而，历史帧之间冗余的键值（KV）缓存，使现有 AR 视频扩散模型仍面临显著的注意力计算复杂度和严重内存开销，限制了可扩展性。本文通过将 KV 缓存压缩引入自回归视频扩散来应对这一挑战。我们观察到，主流 AR 扩散模型中的注意力头呈现出明显不同的注意力模式和功能角色，而且这些差异在不同样本和去噪步骤中保持稳定。基于对逐头功能专门化的实证研究，我们将注意力头分为两类：静态头关注自回归片段之间的过渡和帧内保真度；动态头控制帧间运动与一致性。随后，我们提出 Forcing-KV，一种混合 KV 缓存压缩策略：对静态头采用结构化静态剪枝，对动态头采用基于分段相似度的动态剪枝。在保持输出质量的同时，该方法在单个 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上实现超过每秒 29 帧的生成速度，并减少 30% 的缓存内存；在 480P 分辨率下，对 LongLive 和 Self Forcing 分别最高实现 1.35 倍和 1.50 倍加速，并在 1080P 下进一步达到 2.82 倍加速。代码和演示视频可通过 https://zju-jiyicheng.github.io/Forcing-KV-Page 获取。

2610.36729.en: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.
2610.36729.zh: 交互式世界生成要求模型遵循连续发出的命令，同时保留相关历史和动作后果。我们提出 Hy-Nomas，一个以 8B 扩散模型为骨干的视频世界模型，支持跨多轮交互的自由形式文本指令和连续相机控制。它以当前输入和缓存历史为条件，生成可变长度的视频片段。我们的核心设计将结构化视频描述与动作感知因果注意力对齐：描述性上下文在不同片段之间保持可访问，而动作指令则被限制在其预期作用的时间窗口内。视觉语言提示增强器（PE）将用户请求和多模态交互历史转换为下一片段的结构化条件。多阶段课程逐步引入因果生成、文本交互、相机控制，以及基于模型生成历史的训练，随后进行扩散蒸馏。在人工评估中，Hy-Nomas 优于现有世界模型。我们发布模型权重、代码和基准，并提供轻量适配流程，以支持交互式世界生成的可复现研究。
2610.36729.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2607.07534.en: We present LingBot-World 2.0 (also known as LingBot-World-Infinity), an advanced iteration of LingBot-World featuring four distinct upgrades. (1) Our model achieves an unbounded interaction horizon while maintaining consistent output quality, benefiting from a carefully crafted causal pretraining paradigm. (2) Through distilling a real-time variant from the base model, our system guarantees rapid response time, sufficient to drive 720p video streams at 60 fps. (3) Compared to the previous version, this update introduces highly diverse interactive elements, comprising a broader spectrum of actions (e.g., attacking, archery, spell-casting, and shooting) alongside a richer variety of text-driven events. (4) We pioneer the integration of an agentic harness within the domain of world modeling, wherein a pilot agent is tasked with planning and executing character behaviors, while a director agent is responsible for synthesizing novel environmental elements as the scene progresses. Additionally, to facilitate a shared experience, we develop an interface that permits multiple players to simultaneously immerse themselves in this vivid world simulator. We pair our primary 14B model with a lightweight 1.3B counterpart, which supports effortless deployment on a single GPU.
2607.07534.zh: 我们提出 LingBot-World 2.0，也称为 LingBot-World-Infinity，这是 LingBot-World 的升级版本，包含四项显著改进。（1）得益于精心设计的因果预训练范式，模型在保持稳定输出质量的同时，实现了无界交互时长。（2）通过从基础模型蒸馏实时变体，系统能够保证快速响应，足以驱动 720p、60 fps 的视频流。（3）相比此前版本，本次更新引入了更加丰富的交互元素，包括范围更广的动作，如攻击、射箭、施法和射击，以及更多样的文本驱动事件。（4）我们率先在世界建模领域引入智能体执行框架：驾驶员智能体负责规划与执行角色行为，导演智能体则随着场景推进合成新的环境元素。此外，为支持共享体验，我们开发了一个允许多名玩家同时沉浸于这一生动世界模拟器的接口。除主要的 14B 模型外，我们还配备了轻量的 1.3B 版本，可轻松部署在单个 GPU 上。
2607.07534.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2606.05773.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies operate in a closed loop in real-world robot tasks: a robot observes the scene, executes an action chunk, and conditions its next decision on the resulting observation. However, most existing world models for robot action evaluation are limited to open-loop prediction along pre-collected action trajectories. This prevents them from supporting closed-loop VLA evaluation, where each action chunk must be conditioned on the observation generated by the previous execution. To address this gap, we propose PiL-World, a chunk-wise world model designed for policy-in-the-loop VLA evaluation. Given the current observation and the action trajectory rolled out by a VLA policy, PiL-World generates multi-view future observations that are consistent with the VLA rollout and match the image inputs required by the policy. By alternating between VLA inference and world-model prediction, PiL-World enables closed-loop evaluation without real robot execution at every step. To improve rollout fidelity, PiL-World conditions video generation on action-derived visual control from head-view robot motion and latent histories that encode task execution context, while jointly predicting complementary multi-view observations. Beyond successful teleoperated demonstrations, it also learns from failed execution trajectories, helping the imagined rollouts better match the distribution of real policy executions. We evaluate PiL-World on three real dual-arm manipulation tasks. PiL-World generates imagined rollouts that are highly consistent with real robot executions. More importantly, compared with the baseline, it reduces the error between VLA success rates measured in real-world rollouts and those estimated through closed-loop world-model evaluation from 63.2% to 12.0%.
2606.05773.zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）策略在真实机器人任务中以闭环方式运行：机器人观察场景、执行一段动作，再根据执行产生的观察做出下一次决策。然而，现有用于机器人动作评估的世界模型大多仅能沿预先采集的动作轨迹进行开环预测。这使它们无法支持闭环 VLA 评估，因为在闭环中，每个动作片段都必须以之前执行所生成的观察为条件。为填补这一空白，我们提出 PiL-World，一个专为策略在环 VLA 评估设计的逐片段世界模型。给定当前观察和 VLA 策略生成的动作轨迹，PiL-World 生成与该轨迹一致、且符合策略所需图像输入格式的多视角未来观察。通过交替执行 VLA 推理与世界模型预测，PiL-World 无需每一步都操作真实机器人，即可开展闭环评估。为提高轨迹预测的保真度，PiL-World 使用从头部视角机器人运动中得到、由动作导出的视觉控制，以及编码任务执行上下文的潜在历史，作为视频生成条件，同时联合预测互补的多视角观察。除了成功的遥操作演示，它还从失败执行轨迹中学习，使想象轨迹更接近真实策略执行的分布。我们在三个真实双臂操作任务上评估 PiL-World。它生成的想象轨迹与真实机器人执行高度一致。更重要的是，相较基线，真实环境轨迹测得的 VLA 成功率与闭环世界模型评估估计值之间的误差，从 63.2% 降至 12.0%。
2606.05773.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.38597.en: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) often rely on separate visual representations for understanding and generation, increasing visual context length and complicating integration with established vision-language pretraining pipelines. Recent advances in pixel-space modeling offer an encoder-free alternative, but extending this paradigm from images to videos is non-trivial: video understanding and generation adopt different temporal representations, leaving the design of a unified visual interface an open question. We present PixelUMM, an encoder-free model for unified image and video understanding and generation directly in pixel space. PixelUMM represents images as spatial patches and videos as spatiotemporal tubelets, connecting raw pixels to a shared multimodal backbone through single-layer linear projections. Its Mixture-of-Transformers architecture combines shared attention with task-specific parameters and extends clean-pixel prediction to video generation, jointly supporting autoregressive text prediction and pixel-space flow matching. Experiments show that PixelUMM achieves competitive performance across image and video understanding and generation tasks. We further conduct empirical studies of key design choices, including decoder design and spatial-temporal patch size, providing insights for future pixel-space unified multimodal models.
2609.38597.zh: 统一多模态模型（UMM）往往为理解与生成使用不同的视觉表示，这既增加了视觉上下文长度，也使其难以融入成熟的视觉语言预训练流水线。近期像素空间建模的进展提供了无需编码器的替代方案，但将这一范式从图像扩展到视频并不简单：视频理解与生成采用不同的时间表示，因此如何设计统一视觉接口仍是开放问题。我们提出 PixelUMM，一个直接在像素空间中统一图像与视频理解、生成的无编码器模型。PixelUMM 将图像表示为空间块，将视频表示为时空小管块，并通过单层线性投影把原始像素接入共享多模态骨干。其混合 Transformer 架构将共享注意力与任务专属参数结合，并将干净像素预测扩展到视频生成，同时支持自回归文本预测和像素空间流匹配。实验表明，PixelUMM 在图像与视频理解、生成任务上都取得了有竞争力的性能。我们还对解码器设计、时空块大小等关键设计选择开展实证研究，为未来像素空间统一多模态模型提供启示。
2609.38597.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2511.07399.en: Generative models are reshaping the live-streaming industry by redefining how content is created, styled, and delivered. Previous image-based streaming diffusion models have powered efficient and creative live streaming products but have hit limits on temporal consistency due to the foundation of image-based designs. Recent advances in video diffusion have markedly improved temporal consistency and sampling efficiency for offline generation. However, offline generation systems primarily optimize throughput by batching large workloads. In contrast, live online streaming operates under strict service-level objectives (SLOs): time-to-first-frame must be minimal, and every frame must meet a per-frame deadline with low jitter. Besides, scalable multi-GPU serving for real-time streams remains largely unresolved so far. To address this, we present StreamDiffusionV2, a training-free pipeline for interactive live streaming with video diffusion models. StreamDiffusionV2 integrates an SLO-aware batching scheduler and a block scheduler, together with a sink-token--guided rolling KV cache, a motion-aware noise controller, and other system-level optimizations. Moreover, we introduce a scalable pipeline orchestration that parallelizes the diffusion process across denoising steps and network layers, achieving near-linear FPS scaling without violating latency guarantees. The system scales seamlessly across heterogeneous GPU environments and supports flexible denoising steps (e.g., 1--4), enabling both ultra-low-latency and higher-quality modes. Without TensorRT or quantization, StreamDiffusionV2 renders the first frame within 0.5s and attains 58.28 FPS with a 14B-parameter model and 64.52 FPS with a 1.3B-parameter model on four H100 GPUs, making state-of-the-art generative live streaming practical and accessible--from individual creators to enterprise-scale platforms.
2511.07399.zh: 生成模型正在重塑直播行业，重新定义内容的创作、风格化和交付方式。此前基于图像的流式扩散模型推动了高效、富有创意的直播产品，但其图像式设计基础使时间一致性受到限制。近期视频扩散的进展显著改善了离线生成的时间一致性和采样效率。然而，离线生成系统主要通过对大规模工作负载进行批处理来优化吞吐量；实时在线流式服务则面临严格的服务等级目标（SLO）：首帧时间必须尽可能短，每一帧都必须以低抖动满足逐帧截止时间。此外，面向实时流的可扩展多 GPU 服务仍大体未获解决。为此，我们提出 StreamDiffusionV2，一个无需训练、基于视频扩散模型的交互式直播流水线。StreamDiffusionV2 整合 SLO 感知批处理调度器、块调度器、由汇聚 token 引导的滚动 KV 缓存、运动感知噪声控制器，以及其他系统级优化。我们还引入可扩展流水线编排，在去噪步骤和网络层两个维度并行扩散过程，在不违反延迟保障的前提下实现近线性的帧率扩展。该系统可在异构 GPU 环境中无缝扩展，并支持灵活的去噪步数，例如 1–4 步，从而同时提供超低延迟和较高质量两种模式。无需 TensorRT 或量化，StreamDiffusionV2 即可在 0.5 秒内渲染首帧；使用四个 H100 GPU 时，14B 参数模型达到 58.28 FPS，1.3B 参数模型达到 64.52 FPS，使从个人创作者到企业级平台都能实际使用先进的生成式直播。
2511.07399.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2605.30351.en: Long-rollout causal video diffusion has converged on a fixed-size sliding-window KV cache, with recent progress innovating within this layout by changing which tokens occupy the window or how their positions are encoded. The per-head KV layout itself, a dominant contributor to streaming memory and latency, has been mostly left unchanged. In this paper, we present the first study of Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) in video diffusion. VideoMLA replaces per-head keys and values with a shared low-rank content latent and a shared decoupled 3D-RoPE positional key, reducing per-token KV memory by 92.7% at every cached layer. We further investigate why MLA succeeds in video diffusion even though the spectral assumption often used to motivate it in language models does not hold: pretrained video attention is not low-rank, with 99%-energy effective rank far above any practical latent dimension. VideoMLA retains quality at compression ratios where direct spectral approximation would predict large reconstruction error. We show that the MLA bottleneck, rather than the pretrained spectrum, determines the effective rank: both spectral and random initialization occupy nearly the full rank budget from initialization, and training preserves this budget while adapting within it. On VBench, VideoMLA matches short-horizon streaming video diffusion baselines, achieves the best overall score at long horizons among evaluated methods, and improves throughput by 1.23x on a single B200.
2605.30351.zh: 长轨迹因果视频扩散逐渐采用固定大小的滑动窗口 KV 缓存。近期进展主要在这一布局内部创新，改变哪些 token 占据窗口，或如何编码它们的位置。然而，作为流式内存占用和延迟主要来源之一的逐头 KV 布局本身，大多保持不变。本文首次研究多头潜在注意力（MLA）在视频扩散中的应用。VideoMLA 用共享低秩内容潜变量和共享、解耦的 3D-RoPE 位置键，替代逐头的键和值，使每个缓存层的每 token KV 内存减少 92.7%。我们进一步研究：尽管语言模型中常用来解释 MLA 的谱假设在这里不成立，MLA 为何仍能在视频扩散中奏效？预训练视频注意力并非低秩，其保留 99% 能量所需的有效秩远高于任何实用潜在维度。直接谱近似会预测某些压缩比导致较大重建误差，但 VideoMLA 在这些压缩比下仍能保持质量。我们表明，决定有效秩的是 MLA 瓶颈，而不是预训练谱：无论谱初始化还是随机初始化，从初始化起就几乎用满秩预算；训练在保持这一预算的同时，在预算内部进行适配。在 VBench 上，VideoMLA 持平短时程流式视频扩散基线，在所评估方法中取得长时程最佳总体得分，并在单个 B200 上将吞吐量提高至 1.23 倍。
2605.30351.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.34606.en: Leveraging the paradigm of autoregressive diffusion, text-conditioned interactive video world models aim to simulate temporally coherent environments guided by textual instructions. While enabling low-latency, long-duration generation is pivotal for embodied AI and simulation-based planning, current frameworks primarily rely on sliding-window mechanisms to bound computational complexity. However, this approach inherently sacrifices historical context, undermining the long-range interactive capabilities. Conversely, maintaining a full-history cache remains computationally prohibitive and memory-intensive: the quadratic complexity of attention leads to excessive computational overhead, while the linear growth of the KV cache inevitably leads to GPU memory saturation. To overcome these limitations, we propose WorldAttention, a system-oriented attention architecture that achieves high efficiency through the co-design of specialized attention kernels and hierarchical KV cache management. First, we introduce Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA), which integrates linear global attention supplemented with head-adaptive sparse attention. Additionally, we design a Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV) that organizes historical KV pairs into semantically indexed pages across multi-tier memory, enabling fine-grained retrieval and controlled GPU residency. These two designs are supported by tailored kernels to effectively translate their theoretical efficiency into real-world performance. Extensive experiments on VBench-Long and InterVBench demonstrate that WorldAttention consistently surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving subject consistency scores of 0.9472 on VBench-Long and 0.9668 on InterVBench, respectively.
2609.34606.zh: 采用自回归扩散范式、以文本为条件的交互式视频世界模型，旨在依据文本指令模拟时间连贯的环境。实现低延迟、长时间生成，对具身智能和基于模拟的规划至关重要，但现有框架主要依赖滑动窗口机制来限制计算复杂度。这种方式天然会牺牲历史上下文，削弱长程交互能力。反过来，保留完整历史缓存又会带来难以承受的计算和内存成本：注意力的平方复杂度造成过高计算开销，KV 缓存的线性增长则不可避免地耗尽 GPU 内存。为克服这些限制，我们提出 WorldAttention，一个面向系统的注意力架构，通过专用注意力算子与分层 KV 缓存管理的协同设计实现高效率。首先，我们引入混合稀疏注意力（HSA），将线性全局注意力与按头自适应的稀疏注意力结合。其次，我们设计分层 KV 缓存（HKV），在多级内存中将历史 KV 对组织成按语义索引的页面，实现细粒度检索和受控的 GPU 驻留。这两项设计均由定制算子支持，将理论效率有效转化为实际性能。在 VBench-Long 和 InterVBench 上的大量实验表明，WorldAttention 持续优于先前先进方法，其主体一致性得分分别达到 0.9472 和 0.9668。
2609.34606.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2605.22718.en: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a training-free framework with two components: World Retrieval and World Compression. World Retrieval stores evicted KV-cache chunks in GPU/CPU memory and selectively retrieves scene-relevant chunks via camera/ action correspondence, inserting them back into the native attention window without re-encoding. World Compression prunes redundant tokens within each chunk via key-key similarity to an anchor frame, halving per-chunk storage to fit 2x more history under a fixed budget. On Matrix-Game-2.0 and LingBot- World-Fast, WorldKV matches or exceeds full-KV memory fidelity at roughly 2x the throughput, and is competitive with memory-trained baselines without any fine-tuning. Project Page: https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/WorldKV/
2605.22718.zh: 自回归视频扩散模型已经实现了实时、以动作为条件的世界生成。然而，如何维持一个持久世界，使重新访问以前见过的视角时得到一致内容，仍是开放问题。完整 KV 缓存注意力能够保留这种一致性，却无法满足实时约束，因为内存占用和注意力成本随轨迹长度线性增长。滑动窗口推理恢复了吞吐量，却丢弃了长期一致性。我们提出 WorldKV，一个无需训练的框架，包括世界检索和世界压缩两个组件。世界检索将被驱逐的 KV 缓存片段保存在 GPU 或 CPU 内存中，通过相机与动作对应关系选择性检索与场景相关的片段，并将其重新插入原生注意力窗口，无需重新编码。世界压缩依据各 token 的键与锚点帧键之间的相似度，裁剪片段内的冗余 token，将每个片段的存储减半，从而在固定预算下容纳 2 倍历史。在 Matrix-Game-2.0 和 LingBot-World-Fast 上，WorldKV 以大约 2 倍吞吐量达到或超过完整 KV 的记忆保真度；无需任何微调，也能与针对记忆进行训练的基线竞争。项目页面见 https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/WorldKV/ 。
2605.22718.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
