2607.10389.en: A persistent interactive world model keeps its running state resident on the GPU that serves it: a multi-gigabyte attention cache, almost all of it rewritten at every generation step. That state cannot be recomputed in interactive time or approximated without changing the world, so a live session pins its device. The pin is a scheduling problem. WorldMove moves a live session under one guarantee: the destination is bit-identical to the source, or nothing is installed. It relocates the cache in 18.8 ms same-node, 101x faster than save/load. It holds a checksum-verified 92.1-94.8 Gb/s on a 100 Gb fabric. At that rate the cache fits inside one interactive block. Migrating an actively generating session, it converges at a block boundary and the destination continues the world bit for bit. An admissibility condition decides each move. The move must complete inside the readout horizon, over bandwidth that covers the state plus its dirty rate. Lifted to a fleet schedulability test, it governed a consolidation loop that executed 48 of 48 migrations bit-identical across two providers. Two constraints are structural. Bit-exactness survives only inside a controlled configuration of one GPU architecture, so moving the state is the only way to preserve it exactly in interactive time. Verification cannot hide inside the wire on this fabric. Receive-path checksums stall the transport at protocol timescales under fan-in, and unscheduled incast silently collapses a receiver while every delivered byte stays correct. An incast-aware admission controller holds zero misses to 1.4x offered load and sheds overload as rejects. A lossless GPU codec widens the admission gate to fabrics raw motion cannot use. We exercise the serving loop and the mover separately, each end to end. Their composition on one fabric is unbuilt. Exact-state elasticity is a joint scheduling problem over transport and verification.
2607.10389.zh: 持久化交互式世界模型将运行状态驻留在为其提供服务的 GPU 上：这是一份数 GB 的注意力缓存，几乎全部内容都会在每个生成步骤中被重写。若要在交互式时间尺度内重新计算该状态，或在不改变世界的前提下近似它，都不可行，因此活跃会话会被固定在其设备上。这种固定本质上是调度问题。WorldMove 在一项保障下迁移活跃会话：目标端与源端比特完全相同，否则不安装任何状态。它在同一节点内仅用 18.8 毫秒迁移缓存，比保存与加载快 101 倍。在 100 Gb 网络上，它维持了经过校验和验证的 92.1–94.8 Gb/s 传输速率；以此速率，缓存迁移能够在一个交互块的时间内完成。迁移一个正在生成的会话时，它在块边界收敛，随后目标端逐比特一致地继续生成世界。每次迁移都由准入条件决定：迁移必须在读出时间窗口内完成，且可用带宽必须覆盖状态传输及其脏写速率。将这一条件扩展为整个资源池的可调度性测试后，它指导了一条整合循环，在两个供应商的环境中完成 48 次迁移，48 次均保持比特一致。有两个约束是结构性的。首先，比特精确性只能在同一种 GPU 架构的受控配置中保持，因此，迁移状态是在交互式时间内精确保留状态的唯一途径。其次，在这种网络上，验证无法被隐藏在传输之中：在多对一汇聚下，接收路径校验和会以协议时间尺度阻塞传输；未经调度的汇聚流量会使接收端悄然崩溃，即使每个已交付字节仍然正确。感知汇聚流量的准入控制器在最高 1.4 倍输入负载下保持零违约，并通过拒绝请求卸去过载。一种无损 GPU 编解码器进一步扩展了可准入范围，使原始状态直接搬运无法使用的网络也能承载迁移。我们分别对服务循环和迁移器进行了端到端验证，但尚未实现二者在同一网络上的组合。精确状态弹性是一个需要联合调度传输与验证的问题。
2607.10389.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.35529.en: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.
2610.35529.zh: 交互式世界模型将历史片段的 KV 保留为检索记忆，以使重新访问的地点保持一致。在单台消费级机器上，即一个 RTX 4090、32 GiB 主机内存和一块 NVMe SSD，具有这种记忆的长会话会遇到两道瓶颈。第一道是容量：Matrix-Game 2.0 的 KV 在 bf16 下生成 45 秒视频后就会耗尽主机内存，在 int4 下则为 2.8 分钟。第二道是模型 4.3 分钟的位置范围限制。我们表明，这类记忆受容量而非带宽限制；而且由于相机位姿是输入，其访问集合在计算开始之前就已确定。基于这些观察建立的解析模型，能够将内存溢出点预测到一个片段以内，并在留出配置上正确区分零停顿与非零停顿。在该模型指导下，WorldPager 将 int4 KV 保存在 GPU、DRAM 和 NVMe 分层存储中，而非重新计算；依据外推位姿预取每个片段的记忆，缓存未命中时也不等待，并在后台写回。据我们所知，这是首个将交互式世界模型的 KV 记忆放入 NVMe 层，并实现零停顿预取的系统。结合无需训练的位置处理，它能够以约每秒 9.5 帧的速度，连续生成 37.5 分钟视频，全程零停顿且主机内存保持恒定。在封存测试集上，int4 存储没有可测量的质量损失；在长间隔重访中，它会使图像质量降低约 1 个 MUSIQ 点。
2610.35529.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.07408.en: We study visual persistence in interactive video world models. These models rely on a Key-Value (KV) cache as a growing visual memory to carry forward previously generated frames. However, we find that models can no longer reliably address stored content once rollouts extend beyond the training horizon, because temporal Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) offsets then fall outside the range seen during training and the model struggles to retrieve the relevant visual information through attention. Moreover, naively compressing the cache in the RoPE-rotated space corrupts memory by averaging together incompatible positional phases. To address this, we propose WorldTrace, a training-free memory framework for long-horizon visual persistence. WorldTrace keeps compressed memory addressable by assigning each summary slot a distinct, in-distribution virtual position. Within this addressable cache, we study two memory compression approaches: WorldTrace-Field compresses history for temporal coherence, while WorldTrace-Landmark stores verbatim scene traces at detected transitions for episodic recall. We further introduce LoopBench, a benchmark evaluating whether a compressed cache can reconstruct a previously visited scene after a long detour. WorldTrace-Field improves temporal consistency by +15.5%, and WorldTrace-Landmark improves episodic recall by +19.5% on LoopBench, extending visually persistent generation without retraining.
2608.07408.zh: 我们研究交互式视频世界模型中的视觉持久性。这类模型依赖不断增长的键值（KV）缓存作为视觉记忆，以延续之前生成的帧。然而，我们发现，当生成轨迹超过训练时长范围时，模型便无法再可靠寻址所存储的内容，因为时间旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的偏移量超出了训练时见过的范围，模型难以通过注意力检索相关视觉信息。此外，直接在经过 RoPE 旋转的空间中压缩缓存，会把不兼容的位置相位平均在一起，从而破坏记忆。为解决这些问题，我们提出 WorldTrace，一个面向长时程视觉持久性、无需训练的记忆框架。WorldTrace 为每个摘要槽分配一个独特、位于训练分布内的虚拟位置，使压缩后的记忆仍可寻址。在这一可寻址缓存内部，我们研究两种记忆压缩方式：WorldTrace-Field 压缩历史以保持时间连贯性；WorldTrace-Landmark 则在检测到场景转变时原样保存场景轨迹，以支持情节性回忆。我们进一步提出 LoopBench，评估压缩缓存能否在长距离绕行之后重建曾经访问过的场景。在 LoopBench 上，WorldTrace-Field 将时间一致性提高 +15.5%，WorldTrace-Landmark 将情节性回忆能力提高 +19.5%，无需重新训练即可延长具有视觉持久性的生成。
2608.07408.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2604.20289.en: Real-time world simulation is becoming a key infrastructure for scalable evaluation and online reinforcement learning of autonomous driving systems. Recent driving world models built on autoregressive video diffusion achieve high-fidelity, controllable multi-camera generation, but their inference cost remains a bottleneck for interactive deployment. However, existing diffusion caching methods are designed for offline video generation with multiple denoising steps, and do not transfer to this scenario. Few-step distilled models have no inter-step redundancy left for these methods to reuse, and sequence-level parallelization techniques require future conditioning that closed-loop interactive generation does not provide. We present X-Cache, a training-free acceleration method that caches along a different axis: across consecutive generation chunks rather than across denoising steps. X-Cache maintains per-block residual caches that persist across chunks, and applies a dual-metric gating mechanism over a structure- and action-aware block-input fingerprint to independently decide whether each block should recompute or reuse its cached residual. To prevent approximation errors from permanently contaminating the autoregressive KV cache, X-Cache identifies KV update chunks (the forward passes that write clean keys and values into the persistent cache) and unconditionally forces full computation on these chunks, cutting off error propagation. We implement X-Cache on X-world, a production multi-camera action-conditioned driving world model built on multi-block causal DiT with few-step denoising and rolling KV cache. X-Cache achieves 71% block skip rate with 2.6x wall-clock speedup while maintaining minimum degradation.
2604.20289.zh: 实时世界模拟正成为自动驾驶系统可扩展评估与在线强化学习的重要基础设施。近期基于自回归视频扩散的驾驶世界模型能够实现高保真、可控的多摄像头生成，但推理成本仍是交互式部署的瓶颈。然而，现有扩散缓存方法面向具有多次去噪步骤的离线视频生成设计，无法直接迁移到这一场景。少步蒸馏模型已不再具有可供这些方法复用的步间冗余，而序列级并行技术需要未来条件信息，闭环交互生成无法提供此类信息。我们提出 X-Cache，一种无需训练的加速方法，沿不同维度进行缓存：在连续生成块之间复用，而非在去噪步骤之间复用。X-Cache 为每个网络块维护跨生成块持续存在的残差缓存，并针对具有结构感知和动作感知能力的块输入指纹，应用双指标门控机制，独立决定每个网络块应重新计算还是复用缓存残差。为防止近似误差永久污染自回归 KV 缓存，X-Cache 识别 KV 更新块，即向持久缓存写入干净键和值的前向计算，并对这些块无条件执行完整计算，从而切断误差传播。我们在 X-world 上实现 X-Cache；X-world 是一个生产级多摄像头、动作条件驾驶世界模型，采用多块因果 DiT、少步去噪及滚动 KV 缓存。在保持极小质量下降的同时，X-Cache 实现 71% 的网络块跳过率和 2.6 倍的实际运行时间加速。
2604.20289.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.00337.en: Deploying robot foundation models at scale is the next step towards realizing the potential of general-purpose robots. However, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and other foundation models are computationally demanding, and on-device compute is constrained by power and space. In this paper, we introduce the problem of serving a robot policy to multiple robots from a remote GPU and formulate it as a scheduling problem. We build Armory, a serving system validated on fleets of both simulated and real robots. Our experiments show that naive scheduling heuristics perform well when all robots are the same, but fall short when robots consume action chunks at different rates, uncovering a mismatch between conventional batching methods and the closed-loop requirements of robot policy execution. To address this, we propose a scheduling algorithm that accounts for this heterogeneity and improves overall system throughput by up to $18\%$ in real-world experiments. Additional details are available at https://gatech-rl2.github.io/actionchunkscheduling .
2608.00337.zh: 大规模部署机器人基础模型，是实现通用机器人潜力的下一步。然而，视觉语言动作（VLA）及其他基础模型的计算需求很高，而设备端计算能力受到功耗和空间限制。本文提出通过远程 GPU 为多台机器人提供机器人策略服务的问题，并将其建模为调度问题。我们构建 Armory 服务系统，并在仿真与真实机器人集群上进行验证。实验表明，当所有机器人都相同时，简单调度启发式方法表现良好；但当机器人以不同速率消耗动作块时，这些方法表现不足，揭示了传统批处理方法与机器人策略执行的闭环要求之间的不匹配。为此，我们提出一种考虑这种异质性的调度算法，在真实场景实验中将整体系统吞吐量最高提高 18%。更多细节见 https://gatech-rl2.github.io/actionchunkscheduling 。
2608.00337.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2608.00337.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2610.05062.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models translate multimodal observations into low-level robot actions. During robot operation, each control period sets an inference deadline, and overruns leave the robot acting on stale observations, reducing task success. Meeting this deadline motivates on-device or nearby edge execution, where a single robot requires batch-1 inference outside the design point of LLM serving systems. Although VLA architectures combine familiar vision-language, autoregressive, and diffusion-style components, their runtime behavior in this batch-1 control setting remains uncharacterized. We characterize four representative VLA models on an edge GPU server and two onboard SoCs, using single-inference profiling and 43,200 closed-loop episodes. Action tensor dimensionality determines whether a stage is memory- or compute-bound, platform balance can shift that bottleneck, and GPU frequency scaling yields a platform-dependent energy-latency sweet spot. In closed-loop operation, overlapping inference with action execution creates an accuracy-speed-energy tradeoff, and no configuration is Pareto-dominant across deployment SLOs. These results guide joint design of VLA model architectures, hardware, and runtime policies.
2610.05062.zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型将多模态观测转换为底层机器人动作。在机器人运行期间，每个控制周期都会设定推理截止时间，超时会使机器人依据陈旧观测继续行动，从而降低任务成功率。满足这一截止时间促使系统采用设备端或邻近边缘执行，而单台机器人所需的批量为 1 的推理并不属于大语言模型服务系统的典型设计场景。尽管 VLA 架构组合了熟悉的视觉语言、自回归及扩散式组件，但这些组件在批量为 1 的控制场景中的运行时行为仍缺乏刻画。我们在一台边缘 GPU 服务器和两种机载 SoC 上，对四种具有代表性的 VLA 模型进行分析，使用单次推理剖析及 43,200 个闭环回合。动作张量维度决定一个阶段受到内存还是计算限制，平台的资源配比可能改变这一瓶颈，而 GPU 频率调节会产生依赖平台的能耗与延迟最佳折中点。在闭环运行中，重叠推理与动作执行会形成准确率、速度和能耗之间的权衡，不存在一种配置能够在所有部署 SLO 下都取得帕累托优势。这些结果为 VLA 模型架构、硬件与运行时策略的联合设计提供了依据。
2610.05062.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.34792.en: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $\pi_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.
2609.34792.zh: 长时操作要求机器人记住已经离开视野的线索，同时对运动物体作出响应。然而，视觉语言动作（VLA）策略通常依赖最新观测，而更新视觉上下文往往需要再次执行成本高昂的视觉语言模型（VLM）前向计算。我们提出 D²-VLA，在预训练 VLA 的 KV 缓存接口处结合双记忆与双频控制。D²-VLA 使用块级因果 KV 缓存对观测进行增量编码，并根据不同的时序注意力模式，为 VLM 和动作专家构建彼此独立的历史 KV 读取视图。在周期性 VLM 更新之间，门控适配器将新的视觉特征融入最新的、以历史为条件的 KV 块，同时以短小的快速记忆队列支持动作重新规划。我们提出 DOMINO-Long，一个包含十项任务的基准，要求机器人在操作运动物体时使用先前的视觉线索。D²-VLA 在 DOMINO 上的完整任务成功率为 29.3%，而 π0.5 和 PUMA 分别为 9.6% 和 17.2%；在 DOMINO-Long 上达到 60.0%，两种基线分别为 35.4% 和 20.6%。它还提高了八项真实机器人任务的成功率，并在 LIBERO-Long 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上分别达到 97.5% 和 74.3%。
2609.34792.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2512.20188.en: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems integrate a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for semantic reasoning with an action expert generating continuous action signals, yet both typically run at a single unified frequency. As a result, policy performance is constrained by the low inference speed of large VLMs. This mandatory synchronous execution severely limits control stability and real-time performance in whole-body robotic manipulation, which involves more joints, larger motion spaces, and dynamically changing views. We introduce a truly asynchronous Fast-Slow VLA framework (DuoCore-FS), organizing the system into a fast pathway for high-frequency action generation and a slow pathway for rich VLM reasoning. The system is characterized by two key features. First, a latent representation buffer bridges the slow and fast systems. It stores instruction semantics and action-reasoning representation aligned with the scene-instruction context, providing high-level guidance to the fast pathway. Second, a whole-body action tokenizer provides a compact, unified representation of whole-body actions. Importantly, the VLM and action expert are still jointly trained end-to-end, preserving unified policy learning while enabling asynchronous execution. DuoCore-FS supports a 3B-parameter VLM while achieving 30 Hz whole-body action-chunk generation, approximately three times as fast as prior VLA models with comparable model sizes. Real-world whole-body manipulation experiments demonstrate improved task success rates and significantly enhanced responsiveness compared to synchronous Fast-Slow VLA baselines. The implementation of DuoCore-FS, including training, inference, and deployment, is provided to commercial users by Astribot as part of the Astribot robotic platform.
2512.20188.zh: 大多数视觉语言动作（VLA）系统将负责语义推理的视觉语言模型（VLM）与生成连续动作信号的动作专家结合起来，但两者通常以同一频率运行。因此，策略性能受到大型 VLM 较低推理速度的限制。这种强制同步执行严重限制了全身机器人操作的控制稳定性与实时性能，而此类操作涉及更多关节、更大的运动空间及动态变化的视角。我们提出真正异步的快慢 VLA 框架 DuoCore-FS，将系统划分为负责高频动作生成的快速路径，以及负责丰富 VLM 推理的慢速路径。该系统具有两个关键特性。首先，潜在表征缓冲区连接快慢系统，保存与场景—指令上下文对齐的指令语义及动作推理表征，为快速路径提供高层指导。其次，全身动作分词器为全身动作提供紧凑、统一的表示。VLM 与动作专家仍以端到端方式联合训练，在支持异步执行的同时保留统一的策略学习。DuoCore-FS 支持一个 3B 参数的 VLM，同时实现 30 Hz 的全身动作块生成，速度约为相近模型规模的先前 VLA 模型的三倍。真实全身操作实验表明，相比同步快慢 VLA 基线，该方法提高了任务成功率，并显著改善响应能力。Astribot 将 DuoCore-FS 的训练、推理和部署实现作为 Astribot 机器人平台的一部分提供给商业用户。
2512.20188.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2506.01953.en: Generalized policy and execution efficiency constitute the two critical challenges in robotic manipulation. While recent foundation policies benefit from the common-sense reasoning capabilities of internet-scale pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), they often suffer from low execution frequency. To mitigate this dilemma, dual-system approaches, inspired by Kahneman's theory, have been proposed to leverage a VLM-based System 2 model handling high-level reasoning and a separate System 1 action model ensuring real-time control. However, existing designs maintain both systems as separate models, limiting System 1 from fully leveraging the rich pretrained knowledge from the VLM-based System 2. In this work, we propose Fast-in-Slow (FiS), a unified dual-system vision-language-action (VLA) model that embeds the System 1 execution module within the VLM-based System 2 by partially sharing parameters. This innovative paradigm not only enables high-frequency execution in System 1 but also facilitates coordination between the reasoning and execution components within a single foundation model of System 2. Given their fundamentally distinct roles within FiS-VLA, we design the two systems to incorporate heterogeneous modality inputs alongside asynchronous operating frequencies, enabling both fast and precise manipulation. To enable coordination between the two systems, a dual-aware co-training strategy is proposed that equips System 1 with action generation capabilities while preserving System 2's contextual reasoning representation. For evaluation, FiS-VLA outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods by 8% in simulation and 11% in real-world tasks in terms of average success rate, while achieving a 117.7 Hz control frequency with action chunk set to eight. Project web page: http://fast-in-slow.github.io .
2506.01953.zh: 策略泛化能力与执行效率是机器人操作的两项关键挑战。近期基础策略受益于在互联网规模数据上预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）所具备的常识推理能力，但执行频率往往较低。为缓解这一矛盾，受卡尼曼理论启发的双系统方法采用基于 VLM 的系统 2 处理高层推理，并使用独立的系统 1 动作模型确保实时控制。然而，现有设计将两套系统保留为独立模型，限制了系统 1 充分利用基于 VLM 的系统 2 中丰富的预训练知识。本文提出 Fast-in-Slow（FiS），一种统一的双系统视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，通过部分共享参数，将系统 1 执行模块嵌入基于 VLM 的系统 2。这一范式不仅支持系统 1 高频执行，还能在系统 2 的单个基础模型内部促进推理与执行组件协同。考虑到两个系统在 FiS-VLA 中的角色存在根本差异，我们为其设计不同模态的输入及异步运行频率，从而实现快速而精确的操作。为促进两套系统协调，我们提出双系统感知的协同训练策略，在赋予系统 1 动作生成能力的同时保留系统 2 的上下文推理表征。评估结果表明，FiS-VLA 在仿真和真实任务上的平均成功率分别比先前最先进方法高 8% 和 11%，并在动作块长度设为 8 时达到 117.7 Hz 的控制频率。项目网页见 http://fast-in-slow.github.io 。
2506.01953.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2605.11381.en: Physical AI is experiencing rapid growth with frontier foundation models increasing its capabilities across general environments. Physical AI tasks are characterized by inference properties that are markedly different from digital AI. They consist of multiple rounds of inference and action execution, generating a chunk of actions in each inference round, and asynchronously interleaving inference and execution. This makes existing digital AI serving systems unsuited for physical AI; a shortcoming that is critical for enabling their wide adoption, considering their size and the scale of the robot fleets they have to serve. To fill this gap, we design Kairos, the first multi-robot serving system that makes the generate-execute loop a first-class citizen, with active involvement in the execution phase. Across a wide range of physical AI models and robots, Kairos reduces the average end-to-end task latency by 31.8--66.5% over state-of-the-art digital AI serving practices, with gains scaling with the robot fleet size.
2605.11381.zh: 物理 AI 正迅速发展，前沿基础模型不断增强其在一般环境中的能力。物理 AI 任务的推理特性与数字 AI 显著不同：任务包含多轮推理和动作执行，每轮推理生成一个动作块，并以异步方式交错推理与执行。因此，现有数字 AI 服务系统并不适合物理 AI；考虑到模型的规模及其需要服务的机器人集群规模，这一不足直接影响其广泛应用。为填补这一空缺，我们设计 Kairos，这是首个将“生成—执行”循环作为核心服务对象、并主动参与执行阶段的多机器人服务系统。在广泛的物理 AI 模型和机器人上，相比先进的数字 AI 服务实践，Kairos 将平均端到端任务延迟降低 31.8%–66.5%，且收益随机器人集群规模扩大而增加。
2605.11381.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2406.09246.en: Large policies pretrained on a combination of Internet-scale vision-language data and diverse robot demonstrations have the potential to change how we teach robots new skills: rather than training new behaviors from scratch, we can fine-tune such vision-language-action (VLA) models to obtain robust, generalizable policies for visuomotor control. Yet, widespread adoption of VLAs for robotics has been challenging as 1) existing VLAs are largely closed and inaccessible to the public, and 2) prior work fails to explore methods for efficiently fine-tuning VLAs for new tasks, a key component for adoption. Addressing these challenges, we introduce OpenVLA, a 7B-parameter open-source VLA trained on a diverse collection of 970k real-world robot demonstrations. OpenVLA builds on a Llama 2 language model combined with a visual encoder that fuses pretrained features from DINOv2 and SigLIP. As a product of the added data diversity and new model components, OpenVLA demonstrates strong results for generalist manipulation, outperforming closed models such as RT-2-X (55B) by 16.5% in absolute task success rate across 29 tasks and multiple robot embodiments, with 7x fewer parameters. We further show that we can effectively fine-tune OpenVLA for new settings, with especially strong generalization results in multi-task environments involving multiple objects and strong language grounding abilities, and outperform expressive from-scratch imitation learning methods such as Diffusion Policy by 20.4%. We also explore compute efficiency; as a separate contribution, we show that OpenVLA can be fine-tuned on consumer GPUs via modern low-rank adaptation methods and served efficiently via quantization without a hit to downstream success rate. Finally, we release model checkpoints, fine-tuning notebooks, and our PyTorch codebase with built-in support for training VLAs at scale on Open X-Embodiment datasets.
2406.09246.zh: 在互联网规模视觉语言数据与多样化机器人演示的组合上预训练的大型策略，有望改变我们教授机器人新技能的方式：不必从头训练新行为，而是微调这类视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，即可获得稳健、可泛化的视觉运动控制策略。然而，VLA 在机器人领域的广泛采用仍面临挑战：（1）现有 VLA 大多封闭，公众无法获取；（2）先前工作未充分探索针对新任务高效微调 VLA 的方法，而这正是实际采用的关键。为解决这些问题，我们提出 OpenVLA，一个拥有 7B 参数、在 97 万条多样化真实机器人演示上训练的开源 VLA。OpenVLA 基于 Llama 2 语言模型，并结合融合 DINOv2 和 SigLIP 预训练特征的视觉编码器。得益于更丰富的数据多样性和新的模型组件，OpenVLA 在通用操作中取得较强表现：在 29 项任务和多种机器人形态上，以约为其 1/7 的参数量，相比 RT-2-X（55B）等封闭模型将任务成功率绝对提高 16.5 个百分点。我们进一步展示 OpenVLA 能够有效微调到新场景，尤其在涉及多个物体、需要较强语言语义关联能力的多任务环境中具有较强泛化表现，并比 Diffusion Policy 等表达能力较强的从头训练模仿学习方法高出 20.4%。我们还探索计算效率；作为一项独立贡献，我们展示 OpenVLA 可以借助现代低秩适配方法在消费级 GPU 上微调，并通过量化高效提供服务，而不损害下游成功率。最后，我们发布模型检查点、微调 notebook 和 PyTorch 代码库，并内置在 Open X-Embodiment 数据集上大规模训练 VLA 的支持。
2406.09246.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.12075.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show high robotic manipulation capabilities via a two-stage design: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) stage followed by an Action Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) stage. Since robots must meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) for safety, VLA inference is inherently latency-critical. Meeting these SLOs requires high-end GPUs, yet weight, cost, and power constraints preclude integrating such GPUs on-robot. Prior works offload VLA inference to edge servers that serve many robots on VLA models. However, current VLA systems lack support for multi-request, multi-model execution on a multi-GPU server under SLOs, while existing serving systems for multi-stage models are optimized for throughput and stage disaggregation across separate GPUs, which are ill-suited for the millisecond-scale stages of VLA models. We design Robion, the first VLA serving and management system for multi-robot, multi-model requests on multi-GPU edge servers that meets SLOs. Our serving engine disaggregates the VLM and ADiT stages within a GPU via two streams, dynamically restricting the SMs on VLM stream so ADiT always finds SMs to run alongside it, and co-locates multiple models by sharing these streams across them, prioritizing requests by least remaining SLO time. Our management engine enables flexible model placements on multi-GPU servers, and integrates an intelligent traffic controller that maximizes per-model batching under the chosen placement while bounding each GPU's load to meet SLOs. For individual models, Robion serves on average 6.7$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ higher robot load within 98% SLO attainment over vLLM-Omni, the most widely used multi-stage serving system, and Monolithic, which runs VLM and ADiT as a single pipeline, respectively. In a large-scale experiment of serving 8 different models on a 4-GPU server, Robion can serve up to 64 robots within 98% SLO attainment.
2609.12075.zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型采用先视觉语言模型（VLM）、后动作扩散 Transformer（ADiT）的两阶段设计，展现出较强的机器人操作能力。由于机器人必须满足严格的服务水平目标（SLO）以保障安全，VLA 推理本质上对延迟十分敏感。满足这些 SLO 需要高端 GPU，但重量、成本和功耗限制使这类 GPU 无法集成到机器人本体。先前工作将 VLA 推理卸载到边缘服务器，由其为多台机器人提供 VLA 模型服务。然而，当前 VLA 系统缺乏在 SLO 约束下于多 GPU 服务器执行多请求、多模型的支持，而现有多阶段模型服务系统侧重吞吐量与跨不同 GPU 的阶段分离，不适合 VLA 模型的毫秒级阶段。我们设计 Robion，这是首个在多 GPU 边缘服务器上面向多机器人、多模型请求并满足 SLO 的 VLA 服务与管理系统。其服务引擎通过两条流在单个 GPU 内分离 VLM 和 ADiT 阶段，动态限制 VLM 流可使用的 SM，使 ADiT 始终能找到 SM 与其并行运行；同时通过跨模型共享这两条流实现多模型共置，并按剩余 SLO 时间最少的原则确定请求优先级。管理引擎支持在多 GPU 服务器上灵活放置模型，并集成智能流量控制器，在选定放置方案下最大化各模型的批处理规模，同时限制每个 GPU 的负载以满足 SLO。对于单个模型，在达到 98% SLO 满足率时，Robion 可服务的机器人负载平均分别是广泛使用的多阶段服务系统 vLLM-Omni 和将 VLM、ADiT 作为单条流水线运行的 Monolithic 的 6.7 倍和 1.5 倍。在一台 4-GPU 服务器上服务 8 个不同模型的大规模实验中，Robion 能以 98% 的 SLO 满足率服务最多 64 台机器人。
2609.12075.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2607.01088.en: Robotics foundation models (RFMs) are making general-purpose robots increasingly practical for factory deployments. While RFM serving systems are central to this vision, existing systems are largely shaped by a single-robot, single-model assumption: inference is treated as an edge-computing problem handled by an on-robot or dedicated nearby GPU, and the serving objective is to minimize the latency of a single action model. In this paper, we propose ROSA, an RFM serving system for robot factories designed around three key principles. First, ROSA adopts shared GPU-pool serving, allowing a fleet of robots to access powerful server-class GPUs over the network in order to improve inference performance, battery duration, and GPU utilization. Second, ROSA provides a robotics-aware programming abstraction and system design that supports multi-model pipelines, per-task performance requirements, and failure handling. Third, ROSA uses factory-objective-driven scheduling to maximize SLO-qualified factory productivity rather than minimizing individual request latency. We implement ROSA on top of Ray Serve for distributed orchestration, with vLLM, PyTorch, and JAX as model-serving backends, and evaluate it on both real robots and synthetic large-scale workloads. The results show that ROSA improves factory productivity by up to 12.06x over conventional dedicated serving systems.
2607.01088.zh: 机器人基础模型（RFM）正使通用机器人在工厂中的部署日益可行。虽然 RFM 服务系统是实现这一愿景的核心，但现有系统大多基于单机器人、单模型假设：推理被视为由机器人本体 GPU 或附近专用 GPU 处理的边缘计算问题，服务目标则是最小化单个动作模型的延迟。本文提出面向机器人工厂的 RFM 服务系统 ROSA，并围绕三项关键原则进行设计。第一，ROSA 采用共享 GPU 池服务，使机器人集群通过网络访问高性能服务器级 GPU，以改善推理性能、电池续航和 GPU 利用率。第二，ROSA 提供面向机器人特性的编程抽象与系统设计，支持多模型流水线、逐任务性能要求及故障处理。第三，ROSA 采用工厂目标驱动的调度，最大化满足 SLO 的工厂生产率，而不是最小化单个请求的延迟。我们基于 Ray Serve 实现分布式编排，并以 vLLM、PyTorch 和 JAX 作为模型服务后端，在真实机器人及合成大规模负载上进行评估。结果显示，相比传统专用服务系统，ROSA 最高将工厂生产率提高至 12.06 倍。
2607.01088.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2603.28565.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated exceptional performance in natural language-driven perception and control. However, the high computational cost of VLA models poses significant efficiency challenges, particularly for resource-constrained edge platforms in real-world deployments. However, since different stages of VLA (observation, action generation and execution) must proceed sequentially, and wait for the completion of the preceding stage, the system suffers from frequent halting and high latency. To address this, We conduct a systematic analysis to identify the challenges for fast and fluent generation, and propose enabling VLAs with the ability to asynchronously parallelize across VLA stages in a "streaming" manner. First, we eliminate the reliance on action chunking and adopt action flow matching, which learns the trajectory of action flows rather than denoising chunk-wise actions. It overlaps the latency of action generation and execution. Second, we design an action saliency-aware adaptive observation mechanism, thereby overlapping the latency of execution and observation. Without sacrificing performance, StreamingVLA achieves substantial speedup and improves the fluency of execution. It achieves a 2.4 $\times$ latency speedup and reduces execution halting by 6.5 $\times$.
2603.28565.zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在自然语言驱动的感知与控制方面表现突出。然而，VLA 模型的高计算成本带来显著效率挑战，尤其是在真实部署中资源受限的边缘平台上。由于 VLA 的观测、动作生成和执行等不同阶段必须顺序进行，并等待前一阶段完成，系统会出现频繁停顿和较高延迟。为此，我们进行系统分析，识别快速、流畅生成所面临的挑战，并提出赋予 VLA 以“流式”方式跨阶段异步并行的能力。首先，我们去除对动作分块的依赖，采用动作流匹配，学习动作流的轨迹，而不是对按块组织的动作进行去噪，从而重叠动作生成与执行的延迟。其次，我们设计动作显著性感知的自适应观测机制，进一步重叠执行与观测的延迟。在不牺牲性能的情况下，StreamingVLA 显著加速并改善执行流畅性，实现 2.4 倍的延迟加速，并将执行停顿降至原来的 1/6.5。
2603.28565.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2602.01100.en: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires bridging the gap between high-level planning (System 2) and low-level control (System 1). Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often entangle these processes, performing redundant multimodal reasoning at every timestep, which leads to high latency and goal instability. To address this, we present StreamVLA, a dual-system architecture that unifies textual task decomposition, visual goal imagination, and continuous action generation within a single parameter-efficient backbone. We introduce a "Lock-and-Gated" mechanism to intelligently modulate computation: only when a sub-task transition is detected, the model triggers slow thinking to generate a textual instruction and imagines the specific visual completion state, rather than generic future frames. Crucially, this completion state serves as a time-invariant goal anchor, making the policy robust to execution speed variations. During steady execution, these high-level intents are locked to condition a Flow Matching action head, allowing the model to bypass expensive autoregressive decoding for 72% of timesteps. This hierarchical abstraction ensures sub-goal focus while significantly reducing inference latency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that StreamVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a 98.5% success rate on the LIBERO benchmark and robust recovery in real-world interference scenarios, achieving a 48% reduction in latency compared to full-reasoning baselines.
2602.01100.zh: 长时机器人操作需要弥合高层规划（系统 2）与底层控制（系统 1）之间的差距。当前视觉语言动作（VLA）模型通常将这两个过程耦合起来，在每个时间步执行冗余的多模态推理，造成较高延迟和目标不稳定。为此，我们提出 StreamVLA，一种双系统架构，在单个参数高效的骨干内统一文本任务分解、视觉目标想象和连续动作生成。我们引入“锁定与门控”机制来智能调节计算：只有检测到子任务切换时，模型才触发慢速思考，生成文本指令并想象具体的视觉完成状态，而不是泛化的未来帧。关键在于，该完成状态充当不随时间变化的目标锚点，使策略能够抵御执行速度变化。在稳定执行期间，这些高层意图被锁定，用作流匹配动作头的条件，使模型在 72% 的时间步中绕过昂贵的自回归解码。这种层级抽象既保证对子目标的专注，又显著降低推理延迟。广泛评估显示，StreamVLA 达到先进水平，在 LIBERO 基准上取得 98.5% 的成功率，并能在真实干扰场景中稳健恢复；与完整推理基线相比，延迟降低 48%。
2602.01100.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2607.15621.en: Large language models bring instruction following and scene reasoning to end-to-end driving, but their inference latency collides with the control rate a vehicle requires. Existing closed-loop agents hide this gap by invoking the model on alternate simulation ticks and replaying the previous command in between, so half of all control outputs ignore the newest observations. We present a fast-slow architecture that removes this compromise. A frozen 7B vision-language backbone acts as the slow system, digesting navigation instructions and visual history at low frequency while exposing its per-layer key-value cache as a standing representation of the scene. A lightweight action expert acts as the fast system, attending to this cache and to the current camera frame at every simulation tick to regress waypoints in a single forward pass. Since the cache lags behind the world at deployment, we train the expert under randomized staleness, aligning training with asynchronous execution. On LangAuto-Short routes in CARLA, our system produces fresh control at every 50 ms simulation tick and lifts route completion from 37.0 to 94.0 over the frame-skipping baseline. A frame-skip ablation with the same expert separates the two factors at work: the expert raises the driving score on its own, while per-tick freshness raises completion from 82.1 to 94.0 and cuts red-light violations by a third. Trained on a single town, the expert transfers zero-shot to two unseen towns, holding 84-94% route completion where the baseline reaches 31-41%. It reduces open-loop waypoint error by nearly a factor of four compared to the backbone's own action head, at a per-tick model cost of 32 ms that is independent of history length on a single consumer GPU.
2607.15621.zh: 大语言模型为端到端驾驶带来了指令遵循和场景推理能力，但其推理延迟与车辆所需的控制频率发生冲突。现有闭环智能体通过隔一个仿真时间步调用一次模型、在间隔中重复执行上一条指令来掩盖这一差距，因此一半的控制输出忽略了最新观测。我们提出一种消除这一妥协的快慢架构。冻结的 7B 视觉语言骨干作为慢系统，低频处理导航指令与视觉历史，并将逐层键值缓存提供为持续可用的场景表征。轻量动作专家作为快系统，在每个仿真时间步同时关注该缓存和当前摄像头帧，通过一次前向计算回归航点。由于部署时缓存会滞后于真实世界，我们在随机化陈旧程度的条件下训练动作专家，使训练与异步执行对齐。在 CARLA 的 LangAuto-Short 路线上，系统在每个 50 ms 仿真时间步生成新控制，相比跳帧基线将路线完成率从 37.0 提高到 94.0。使用相同动作专家的跳帧消融区分了两个因素：动作专家本身提高了驾驶得分，而逐步更新将完成率从 82.1 提高到 94.0，并将闯红灯次数减少三分之一。该动作专家仅在一个城镇训练，却可零样本迁移到两个未见过的城镇，保持 84%–94% 的路线完成率，而基线只有 31%–41%。与骨干自身的动作头相比，它将开环航点误差降低近四倍，并在单张消费级 GPU 上以每个时间步 32 ms 的模型计算成本运行，该成本不随历史长度变化。
2607.15621.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2502.02175.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong multi-modal reasoning capabilities, enabling direct action generation from visual perception and language instructions in an end-to-end manner. However, their substantial computational cost poses a challenge for real-time robotic control, where rapid decision-making is essential. This paper introduces VLA-Cache, a training-free inference acceleration method that reduces computational overhead by adaptively caching and reusing static visual tokens across frames. Exploiting the temporal continuity in robotic manipulation, VLA-Cache identifies minimally changed tokens between adjacent frames and reuses their cached key-value representations, thereby circumventing redundant computations. Additionally, to maintain action precision, VLA-Cache selectively re-computes task-relevant tokens that are environmentally sensitive, ensuring the fidelity of critical visual information. To further optimize efficiency, we introduce a layer adaptive token reusing strategy that dynamically adjusts the reuse ratio based on attention concentration across decoder layers, prioritizing critical tokens for recomputation. Extensive experiments on two simulation platforms (LIBERO and SIMPLER) and a real-world robotic system demonstrate that VLA-Cache achieves up to 1.7x speedup in CUDA latency and a 15% increase in control frequency, with negligible loss on task success rate. The code and videos can be found at our project page: https://vla-cache.github.io .
2502.02175.zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型展现出较强的多模态推理能力，能够以端到端方式直接从视觉感知和语言指令生成动作。然而，其较高计算成本给需要快速决策的实时机器人控制带来了挑战。本文提出 VLA-Cache，一种无需训练的推理加速方法，通过跨帧自适应缓存和复用静态视觉 token，降低计算开销。VLA-Cache 利用机器人操作的时间连续性，识别相邻帧之间变化很小的 token，并复用其缓存的键值表征，从而绕过冗余计算。此外，为保持动作精度，VLA-Cache 选择性地重新计算对环境变化敏感、与任务相关的 token，确保关键视觉信息的保真度。为进一步提高效率，我们提出层级自适应 token 复用策略，根据解码器各层的注意力集中程度动态调整复用比例，并优先重新计算关键 token。在两个仿真平台 LIBERO 和 SIMPLER 及真实机器人系统上的大量实验表明，VLA-Cache 最高实现 1.7 倍的 CUDA 延迟加速，并将控制频率提高 15%，任务成功率损失可忽略。代码和视频见 https://vla-cache.github.io 。
2502.02175.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
