1910.02653.en: We formalize the problem of trading-off DNN training time and memory requirements as the tensor rematerialization optimization problem, a generalization of prior checkpointing strategies. We introduce Checkmate, a system that solves for optimal rematerialization schedules in reasonable times (under an hour) using off-the-shelf MILP solvers or near-optimal schedules with an approximation algorithm, then uses these schedules to accelerate millions of training iterations. Our method scales to complex, realistic architectures and is hardware-aware through the use of accelerator-specific, profile-based cost models. In addition to reducing training cost, Checkmate enables real-world networks to be trained with up to 5.1x larger input sizes. Checkmate is an open-source project, available at https://github.com/parasj/checkmate .
1910.02653.zh: 我们将深度神经网络训练时间与内存需求之间的权衡形式化为张量再物化优化问题，这是对先前检查点策略的推广。我们提出 Checkmate 系统，使用现成的混合整数线性规划（MILP）求解器，在合理时间内（不到一小时）求得最优再物化计划，或通过近似算法求得接近最优的计划，随后用这些计划加速数百万次训练迭代。该方法能够扩展到复杂、实际的架构，并通过针对特定加速器、基于性能剖析的成本模型实现硬件感知。除了降低训练成本，Checkmate 还使实际网络能够在输入规模最高增至 5.1 倍时进行训练。Checkmate 是开源项目，地址见 https://github.com/parasj/checkmate 。
1910.02653.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
1910.02653.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2604.04780.en: Image degradation from blur, noise, compression, and poor illumination severely undermines multimodal understanding in real-world settings. Unified multimodal models that combine understanding and generation within a single architecture are a natural fit for this challenge, as their generative pathway can model the fine-grained visual structure that degradation destroys. Yet these models fail to leverage their own generative capacity on degraded inputs. We trace this disconnect to two compounding factors: existing training regimes never ask the model to invoke generation during reasoning, and the standard decode-reencode pathway does not support effective joint optimization. We present CLEAR, a framework that connects the two capabilities through three progressive steps: (1) supervised fine-tuning on a degradation-aware dataset to establish the generate-then-answer reasoning pattern; (2) a Latent Representation Bridge that replaces the decode-reencode detour with a direct, optimizable connection between generation and reasoning; (3) Interleaved GRPO, a reinforcement learning method that jointly optimizes text reasoning and visual generation under answer-correctness rewards. We construct MMD-Bench, covering three degradation severity levels across six standard multimodal benchmarks. Experiments show that CLEAR substantially improves robustness on degraded inputs while preserving clean-image performance. Our analysis further reveals that removing pixel-level reconstruction supervision leads to intermediate visual states with higher perceptual quality, suggesting that task-driven optimization and visual quality are naturally aligned.
2604.04780.zh: 模糊、噪声、压缩和光照不足引起的图像退化，会严重损害真实环境中的多模态理解。在单一架构内结合理解与生成的统一多模态模型，天然适合应对这一挑战，因为其生成路径可以对退化所破坏的精细视觉结构建模。然而，这些模型面对退化输入时，未能利用自身的生成能力。我们将这一脱节归因于两个相互叠加的因素：现有训练方式从不要求模型在推理期间调用生成，而标准的“解码—重新编码”路径又不支持有效的联合优化。我们提出 CLEAR 框架，通过三个渐进步骤连接这两种能力：（1）在退化感知数据集上进行监督微调，建立“先生成、再回答”的推理模式；（2）引入潜在表征桥，以可优化的直接连接取代解码—重新编码的绕行路径，衔接生成与推理；（3）提出 Interleaved GRPO，在答案正确性奖励下联合优化文本推理与视觉生成。我们构建 MMD-Bench，在六个标准多模态基准上覆盖三个退化严重程度。实验表明，CLEAR 在保持干净图像性能的同时，显著提高了对退化输入的稳健性。进一步分析发现，移除像素级重建监督会得到感知质量更高的中间视觉状态，表明任务驱动优化与视觉质量具有天然的一致性。
2604.04780.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2311.11822.en: Deep learning using large models have achieved great success in a wide range of domains. However, training these models on billions of parameters is very challenging in terms of the training speed, memory cost, and communication efficiency, especially under the privacy-preserving regime with differential privacy (DP). On the one hand, DP optimization has comparable efficiency to the standard non-private optimization on a single GPU, but on multiple GPUs, existing DP distributed learning (such as pipeline parallel) has suffered from significantly worse efficiency. On the other hand, the Zero Redundancy Optimizer (ZeRO) is a state-of-the-art solution to the standard distributed learning, exhibiting excellent training efficiency on large models, but to work compatibly with DP is technically complicated. In this work, we develop a new systematic solution, DP-ZeRO, (I) to scale up the trainable DP model size, e.g. to GPT-100B, (II) to obtain the same computation and communication efficiency as the standard ZeRO, and (III) to enable mixed-precision DP training. Our DP-ZeRO, like the standard ZeRO, has the potential to train models with arbitrary size and is evaluated on the world's largest DP models in terms of the number of trainable parameters.
2311.11822.zh: 使用大模型的深度学习已在广泛领域取得巨大成功。然而，从训练速度、内存成本和通信效率来看，训练拥有数十亿参数的模型十分困难，尤其是在采用差分隐私（DP）的隐私保护设置下。一方面，DP 优化在单张 GPU 上可以达到与标准非隐私优化相当的效率，但在多 GPU 上，现有 DP 分布式学习方法（如流水线并行）的效率明显更差。另一方面，零冗余优化器（ZeRO）是标准分布式学习的先进方案，在大模型上具有出色训练效率，但要使其与 DP 兼容，技术上十分复杂。本文提出新的系统化方案 DP-ZeRO，以实现：（I）扩大可训练的 DP 模型规模，例如达到 GPT-100B；（II）获得与标准 ZeRO 相同的计算和通信效率；（III）支持混合精度 DP 训练。与标准 ZeRO 一样，DP-ZeRO 具有训练任意规模模型的潜力，并已在按可训练参数数量计全球最大的 DP 模型上进行评估。
2311.11822.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2006.09616.en: Checkpointing enables the training of deep learning models under restricted memory budgets by freeing intermediate activations from memory and recomputing them on demand. Current checkpointing techniques statically plan these recomputations offline and assume static computation graphs. We demonstrate that a simple online algorithm can achieve comparable performance by introducing Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization (DTR), a greedy online algorithm for checkpointing that is extensible and general, is parameterized by eviction policy, and supports dynamic models. We prove that DTR can train an $N$-layer linear feedforward network on an $\Omega(\sqrt{N})$ memory budget with only $\mathcal{O}(N)$ tensor operations. DTR closely matches the performance of optimal static checkpointing in simulated experiments. We incorporate a DTR prototype into PyTorch merely by interposing on tensor allocations and operator calls and collecting lightweight metadata on tensors.
2006.09616.zh: 检查点机制通过从内存释放中间激活、并在需要时重新计算，使深度学习模型能够在受限的内存预算下训练。当前检查点技术在线下静态规划这些重计算，并假定计算图是静态的。我们提出动态张量再物化（DTR），说明一种简单的在线算法也能达到相当的性能。DTR 是用于检查点管理的贪心在线算法，具有可扩展性和通用性，以驱逐策略为参数，并支持动态模型。我们证明，DTR 能够在 Ω(√N) 的内存预算下，仅用 O(N) 次张量操作训练一个 N 层线性前馈网络。在仿真实验中，DTR 的性能非常接近最优静态检查点方案。我们仅通过拦截张量分配与算子调用、收集轻量级张量元数据，就将 DTR 原型集成到了 PyTorch 中。
2006.09616.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

fastdp-bk.en: Differentially private (DP) optimization is the standard paradigm to learn large neural networks that are accurate and privacy-preserving. The computational cost for DP deep learning, however, is notoriously heavy due to the per-sample gradient clipping. Existing DP implementations are 2 ∼ 1000× more costly in time and space complexity than the standard (non-private) training. In this work, we develop a novel Book-Keeping (BK) technique that implements existing DP optimizers (thus achieving the same accuracy), with a substantial improvement on the computational cost. Specifically, BK enables DP training on large models and high dimensional data to be roughly as fast and memory-saving as the standard training, whereas previous DP algorithms can be inefficient or incapable of training due to memory error. The computational advantage of BK is supported by the complexity analysis as well as extensive experiments on vision and language tasks. Our implementation achieves stateof-the-art (SOTA) accuracy with very small extra cost: on GPT2 and at almost the same memory cost ( < 1% overhead), BK has 1.03 × the time complexity of the standard training (0.83× training speed in practice), and 0.61 × the time complexity of the most efficient DP implementation (1.36 × training speed in practice). We open-source the codebase for the BK algorithm athttps://github.com/awslabs/fas t-differential-privacy.
fastdp-bk.zh: 差分隐私（DP）优化是在保持隐私的同时学习高准确率大型神经网络的标准范式。然而，由于需要进行逐样本梯度裁剪，DP 深度学习的计算成本通常很高。现有 DP 实现在时间和空间复杂度上比标准的非隐私训练高出 2–1000 倍。本文提出新的 Book-Keeping（BK）技术，在实现现有 DP 优化器、因而保持相同准确率的同时，大幅降低计算成本。具体而言，BK 使大模型和高维数据上的 DP 训练在速度与内存节约方面大致接近标准训练，而先前的 DP 算法可能效率低下，甚至因内存错误而无法训练。复杂度分析以及视觉和语言任务上的广泛实验共同支持了 BK 的计算优势。我们的实现仅增加极小成本即可达到先进准确率：在 GPT2 上，内存成本几乎不变（开销小于 1%），BK 的时间复杂度为标准训练的 1.03 倍，实际训练速度为其 0.83 倍；相对于最高效的 DP 实现，BK 的时间复杂度为其 0.61 倍，实际训练速度为其 1.36 倍。我们在 https://github.com/awslabs/fast-differential-privacy 开源了 BK 算法代码库。
fastdp-bk.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

flexrl.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to align vision–language models (VLMs), yet scaling RL for VLMs is bottlenecked by multimodal data handling and extreme workload skew. In typical RL pipelines, visual data loading and preprocessing are centralized, creating severe I/O and CPU/memory stragglers, while batches that mix short image-text prompts with long video contexts lead to large cross-GPU imbalance during rollouts, inference, and training. We present FlexRL, an end-to-end system that removes these bottlenecks. FlexRL introduces: (1)ShadowLoader, a distributed, metadata-driven pipeline that keeps only lightweight visual metadata on the controller, pushes decoding and preprocessing to worker-side preprocessors, and asynchronously materializes tensors to overlap I/O with GPU computation; (2)FlexUlysses, a cost-aware sub-sequence sharding and execution engine that adaptively splits sequences to balance compute and memory. Our evaluation shows that across multiple VLM scales and multimodal datasets on 128-GPU clusters, FlexRL improves end-to-end throughput by up to 8.47×over state-of-the-art RL systems.
flexrl.zh: 强化学习（RL）正越来越多地用于对齐视觉语言模型（VLM），但 VLM 强化学习的扩展受到多模态数据处理和极端工作负载偏斜的限制。在典型 RL 流水线中，视觉数据加载与预处理集中执行，形成严重的 I/O、CPU 和内存长尾；同时，将短图文提示与长视频上下文混合的批次，会在 rollout、推理和训练期间造成很大的跨 GPU 负载不均。我们提出端到端系统 FlexRL，消除这些瓶颈。FlexRL 引入：（1）ShadowLoader，一条分布式、元数据驱动的流水线，控制器仅保存轻量视觉元数据，将解码与预处理下放到工作节点侧预处理器，并异步生成实际张量，以重叠 I/O 与 GPU 计算；（2）FlexUlysses，一种成本感知的子序列分片与执行引擎，通过自适应切分序列来平衡计算与内存。评估表明，在 128-GPU 集群上的多种 VLM 规模及多模态数据集上，FlexRL 相比先进 RL 系统最高将端到端吞吐量提高至 8.47 倍。
flexrl.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

1506.02438.en: Policy gradient methods are an appealing approach in reinforcement learning because they directly optimize the cumulative reward and can straightforwardly be used with nonlinear function approximators such as neural networks. The two main challenges are the large number of samples typically required, and the difficulty of obtaining stable and steady improvement despite the nonstationarity of the incoming data. We address the first challenge by using value functions to substantially reduce the variance of policy gradient estimates at the cost of some bias, with an exponentially-weighted estimator of the advantage function that is analogous to TD(lambda). We address the second challenge by using trust region optimization procedure for both the policy and the value function, which are represented by neural networks. Our approach yields strong empirical results on highly challenging 3D locomotion tasks, learning running gaits for bipedal and quadrupedal simulated robots, and learning a policy for getting the biped to stand up from starting out lying on the ground. In contrast to a body of prior work that uses hand-crafted policy representations, our neural network policies map directly from raw kinematics to joint torques. Our algorithm is fully model-free, and the amount of simulated experience required for the learning tasks on 3D bipeds corresponds to 1-2 weeks of real time.
1506.02438.zh: 策略梯度方法是强化学习中很有吸引力的一种途径，因为它们直接优化累积奖励，并且可以方便地与神经网络等非线性函数逼近器结合。其两项主要挑战是通常需要大量样本，以及在输入数据非平稳的情况下，难以获得稳定、持续的改进。针对第一项挑战，我们使用价值函数，以引入一定偏差为代价显著降低策略梯度估计的方差，具体采用类似 TD(λ) 的指数加权优势函数估计器。针对第二项挑战，我们对均由神经网络表示的策略和价值函数都采用信赖域优化过程。该方法在极具挑战的三维运动任务上取得了较强实验结果，学习了仿真双足与四足机器人的奔跑步态，以及让双足机器人从躺地状态起身站立的策略。与大量使用手工设计策略表示的先前工作不同，我们的神经网络策略直接将原始运动学信息映射为关节力矩。该算法完全不依赖环境模型，而三维双足机器人学习任务所需的仿真经验量相当于 1–2 周的真实时间。
1506.02438.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2101.06983.en: Contrastive learning has been applied successfully to learn vector representations of text. Previous research demonstrated that learning high-quality representations benefits from batch-wise contrastive loss with a large number of negatives. In practice, the technique of in-batch negative is used, where for each example in a batch, other batch examples' positives will be taken as its negatives, avoiding encoding extra negatives. This, however, still conditions each example's loss on all batch examples and requires fitting the entire large batch into GPU memory. This paper introduces a gradient caching technique that decouples backpropagation between contrastive loss and the encoder, removing encoder backward pass data dependency along the batch dimension. As a result, gradients can be computed for one subset of the batch at a time, leading to almost constant memory usage.
2101.06983.zh: 对比学习已被成功用于学习文本的向量表示。先前研究表明，使用大量负样本的批次级对比损失有助于学习高质量表示。实践中通常采用批内负样本技术：对于批次中的每个样本，将同批其他样本的正例作为其负例，从而避免额外编码负样本。然而，这仍然使每个样本的损失依赖整个批次中的所有样本，并要求将整个大批次装入 GPU 内存。本文提出一种梯度缓存技术，将对比损失与编码器之间的反向传播解耦，消除编码器反向计算在批次维度上的数据依赖。因此，可以每次只为批次中的一个子集计算梯度，使内存使用量几乎保持恒定。
2101.06983.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

megascale-data.en: Modern frameworks for training large foundation models (LFMs) employ dataloaders in a data-parallel manner, with each loader processing a disjoint subset of training data. When preparing data for LFM training that originates from multiple, distinct sources, two fundamental challenges arise. First, due to the quadratic computational complexity of the attention operator, the non-uniform sample distribution over data-parallel ranks leads to significant workload imbalance among dataloaders, degrading the training efficiency. Second, supporting diverse data sources requires per-dataset file access states that are redundantly replicated across parallel loaders, consuming excessive memory. This also hinders dynamic data mixing (e.g., curriculum learning) and causes redundant access/memory overhead in hybrid parallelism. We present MegaScale-Data, an industrial-grade distributed data loading architecture for multisource LFMs training, with three key innovations: (1) Disaggregated data preprocessing via role-specific actors (Source Loaders/Data Constructors) to eliminate source and parallelism redundant data access and ensure multisource scalability. (2) Centralized and declarative data plane for load-time multisource orchestration, such as long-short context, multimodality, and curriculum learning. (3) Multi-level auto-partitioning and scaling mechanism for source loaders under heterogeneous preprocessing costs. We also contribute our designs and operational experience in deployment and fault tolerance. MegaScale-Data achieves up to: (1) 4.5x end-to-end training throughput improvement, and (2) 13.5x reduction in CPU memory usage.
megascale-data.zh: 现代大基础模型（LFM）训练框架以数据并行方式使用数据加载器，每个加载器处理训练数据中互不重叠的子集。当为 LFM 训练准备来自多个不同来源的数据时，会出现两个根本挑战。首先，由于注意力算子的计算复杂度为二次方，不同数据并行 rank 上样本分布不均会导致数据加载器之间出现显著的工作负载不均衡，降低训练效率。其次，支持多种数据源需要维护各数据集的文件访问状态，而这些状态在并行加载器之间被重复复制，消耗过多内存。这也妨碍了动态数据混合（例如课程学习），并在混合并行中造成冗余访问和内存开销。我们提出 MegaScale-Data，一种用于多来源 LFM 训练的工业级分布式数据加载架构，包含三个关键创新：（1）通过职责专门化的参与者——数据源加载器（Source Loaders）和数据构造器（Data Constructors）——实现分离式数据预处理，消除因数据源和并行方式引起的冗余数据访问，并保障多数据源扩展能力；（2）使用集中式、声明式数据平面，在加载时编排多个数据源，例如长短上下文、多模态和课程学习；（3）针对异质预处理成本，提供数据源加载器的多级自动分区与扩缩容机制。我们还分享了部署与容错方面的设计和运维经验。MegaScale-Data 实现了最高 4.5 倍的端到端训练吞吐量，以及最高 13.5 倍的 CPU 内存用量降低。

2606.01143.en: In reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, one prompt fans out into $N$ trajectories, yet standard trainers replay the shared prefix's forward and backward pass $N$ times; in long-context retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and multimodal workloads, this repetition dominates training compute. Existing designs reuse the prefix within one computation graph (a packed sequence, fused kernel, or tree traversal); under the trainer's memory limits and parallelism, their compute savings do not reliably become shorter steps. We present PrefixFlow, which takes the prefix out of that graph and into the training schedule through a training-time KV cache: Phase A runs one prefix forward and caches its keys and values ($K/V$); Phase B trains suffixes as ordinary microbatches that read only $K/V$ and write back only their gradients ($gK/gV$); Phase C runs one delayed prefix backward on the accumulated $gK/gV$. Memory and parallelism then become manageable: dormant prefix activations are offloaded during Phase B to free high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for suffixes, and context, pipeline, and data parallelism each schedule the phases through a local rule while tensor and expert parallelism need no change, so saved compute becomes shorter steps under any microbatch split. On dense models, and on mixture-of-experts (MoE) models under Rollout Routing Replay, PrefixFlow matches full-sequence training within bfloat16 (BF16) tolerance. Against an identically configured baseline, it speeds up end-to-end verl RL training on a long-prefix RAG workload by $1.90\times$ ($6.1\times$ on the actor update). In controlled sweeps, actor-side speedup grows with prefix ratio and group size, reaching $4.4\times$ at an 83% prefix ratio, while suffix-dominated splits gain little; offloading dormant prefix activations lowers Phase-B peak HBM by up to 59% and extends trainable sequences by $1.66\times$.
2606.01143.zh: 在强化学习（RL）后训练中，一个提示会分出 N 条轨迹，但标准训练器会将共享前缀的前向与反向计算重放 N 次；在长上下文检索增强生成（RAG）和多模态负载中，这种重复占据训练计算的主要部分。现有设计在单个计算图内复用前缀，例如打包序列、融合算子或树遍历；但在训练器的内存限制和并行配置下，节省的计算并不总能转化为更短的训练步。我们提出 PrefixFlow，通过训练时 KV 缓存，将前缀从单个计算图移到训练调度层面：阶段 A 执行一次前缀前向并缓存其键和值（K/V）；阶段 B 将后缀作为普通微批训练，仅读取 K/V，并仅写回它们的梯度（gK/gV）；阶段 C 基于累积后的 gK/gV 执行一次延迟的前缀反向。由此，内存与并行更易管理：阶段 B 卸载暂不使用的前缀激活，为后缀释放高带宽内存（HBM）；上下文、流水线和数据并行分别通过局部规则调度各阶段，而张量并行与专家并行无需修改，因此在任意微批切分下，节省的计算都能转化为更短的训练步。在稠密模型，以及采用 Rollout Routing Replay 的混合专家（MoE）模型上，PrefixFlow 在 bfloat16（BF16）容差内与完整序列训练一致。相对于配置完全相同的基线，它在长前缀 RAG 负载上将端到端 verl RL 训练加速 1.90 倍，其中 actor 更新加速 6.1 倍。在受控扫描实验中，actor 侧加速随前缀比例和组大小增加而提高，在前缀比例为 83% 时达到 4.4 倍，而后缀占主导的切分收益很小；卸载暂不使用的前缀激活可将阶段 B 的峰值 HBM 最高降低 59%，并使可训练序列长度增至 1.66 倍。
2606.01143.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.25683.en: In modern agentic AI training, the system bottleneck is shifting from rollout to update. Emerging sampling strategies such as tree-structured and step-wise RL greatly increase training sample volume while incurring relatively low marginal rollout cost, causing the update phase to dominate the end-to-end execution time. Crucially, this shift exposes a new optimization opportunity, as production traces reveal substantial prefix redundancy across training samples. In this paper, we propose psRL (prefix sharing for RL), a new training system for agentic AI designed to exploit prefix redundancy among training samples. Leveraging the global visibility and data immutability inherent to the update phase, psRL achieves efficient workload scheduling and memory management for distributed training. Specifically, psRL introduces two novel prefix-sharing mechanisms that enable flexible, fine-grained workload distribution across GPU workers, simultaneously optimizing prefix reuse and achieving load balancing. Moreover, psRL implements a new underlying KV cache manager that facilitates adaptable block-size allocation and dynamic KV caching, maximizing memory utilization while maintaining a high prefix hit rate. Evaluations using production traces demonstrate that psRL outperforms existing systems by up to 5.2x in throughput. The source code will be publicly available soon.
2608.25683.zh: 在现代智能体 AI 训练中，系统瓶颈正在从 rollout 转移到更新阶段。树状结构和逐步 RL 等新兴采样策略，以较低的边际 rollout 成本大幅增加训练样本量，使更新阶段占据端到端执行时间的主要部分。关键在于，这一转变揭示了新的优化机会：生产环境轨迹显示，训练样本之间存在大量前缀冗余。本文提出 psRL，即用于 RL 的前缀共享，一种利用训练样本前缀冗余的新型智能体 AI 训练系统。利用更新阶段固有的全局可见性与数据不可变性，psRL 为分布式训练实现高效的工作负载调度和内存管理。具体而言，psRL 引入两种新的前缀共享机制，使工作负载能够以灵活、细粒度的方式分配到 GPU 工作节点，同时优化前缀复用和负载均衡。此外，psRL 实现了新的底层 KV 缓存管理器，支持灵活的块大小分配和动态 KV 缓存，在保持较高前缀命中率的同时最大化内存利用率。基于生产环境轨迹的评估显示，psRL 的吞吐量最高为现有系统的 5.2 倍。源代码将于近期公开。
2608.25683.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2502.13923.en: We introduce Qwen2.5-VL, the latest flagship model of Qwen vision-language series, which demonstrates significant advancements in both foundational capabilities and innovative functionalities. Qwen2.5-VL achieves a major leap forward in understanding and interacting with the world through enhanced visual recognition, precise object localization, robust document parsing, and long-video comprehension. A standout feature of Qwen2.5-VL is its ability to localize objects using bounding boxes or points accurately. It provides robust structured data extraction from invoices, forms, and tables, as well as detailed analysis of charts, diagrams, and layouts. To handle complex inputs, Qwen2.5-VL introduces dynamic resolution processing and absolute time encoding, enabling it to process images of varying sizes and videos of extended durations (up to hours) with second-level event localization. This allows the model to natively perceive spatial scales and temporal dynamics without relying on traditional normalization techniques. By training a native dynamic-resolution Vision Transformer (ViT) from scratch and incorporating Window Attention, we reduce computational overhead while maintaining native resolution. As a result, Qwen2.5-VL excels not only in static image and document understanding but also as an interactive visual agent capable of reasoning, tool usage, and task execution in real-world scenarios such as operating computers and mobile devices. Qwen2.5-VL is available in three sizes, addressing diverse use cases from edge AI to high-performance computing. The flagship Qwen2.5-VL-72B model matches state-of-the-art models like GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, particularly excelling in document and diagram understanding. Additionally, Qwen2.5-VL maintains robust linguistic performance, preserving the core language competencies of the Qwen2.5 LLM.
2502.13923.zh: 我们介绍 Qwen 视觉语言系列的最新旗舰模型 Qwen2.5-VL，它在基础能力和创新功能方面均有显著进展。通过增强视觉识别、精确目标定位、稳健文档解析和长视频理解，Qwen2.5-VL 在理解世界及与世界交互方面实现了重要提升。它的一项突出能力是使用边界框或点精确定位物体，并能从发票、表单和表格中稳健提取结构化数据，以及详细分析图表、示意图和版式。为处理复杂输入，Qwen2.5-VL 引入动态分辨率处理与绝对时间编码，使其能够处理不同大小的图像和长达数小时的视频，并实现秒级事件定位。因此，模型无需依赖传统归一化技术，就能原生感知空间尺度与时间动态。我们从头训练原生动态分辨率视觉 Transformer（ViT），并结合窗口注意力，在保留原始分辨率的同时降低计算开销。由此，Qwen2.5-VL 不仅擅长静态图像与文档理解，还能充当交互式视觉智能体，在操作计算机和移动设备等真实场景中进行推理、使用工具并执行任务。Qwen2.5-VL 提供三种规模，覆盖从边缘 AI 到高性能计算的不同用途。旗舰 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 可与 GPT-4o 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 等先进模型匹敌，尤其擅长文档和示意图理解。此外，Qwen2.5-VL 保持了较强的语言表现，保留 Qwen2.5 大语言模型的核心语言能力。
2502.13923.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.14498.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable embodied agents to reason and act from visual observations and language instructions. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training enhances these capabilities using task feedback, but current on-policy RL runtimes execute rollout, reference scoring, and actor training in strict serial phases. While effective for text-only RL, this phase-granular execution is wasteful for VLMs, where processing dense video inputs and prompt prefixes occupies a large fraction of each phase. Because prefix processing is independent of the generated response, it can be run alongside rollout decoding, which leaves GPU compute capacity underutilized, without breaking synchronous on-policy semantics. We present Rollplex, a runtime that decomposes the reference and training phase and moves the prefix computation into the rollout decode window. Realizing this schedule requires more than concurrent kernel launches: naive colocation of Qwen2.5-VL-32\,B requires roughly 165\,GiB per GPU, while rollout and training prefer different tensor-parallel (TP) degrees and weight layouts. Rollplex addresses these constraints with two mechanisms. Phase-aware memory management controls HBM residency according to producer--consumer lifetimes. Parallelism-aware weight sharing uses the same physical storage for layout-compatible tensors across distinct TP degrees and reconstructs only incompatible tensors, avoiding a complete second actor copy. On 32 H800 GPUs, Rollplex achieves $1.23\times$--$1.30\times$ speedup over serial colocation and $1.57\times$--$2.24\times$ over disaggregation under the same GPU budget, while preserving the synchronous RL update.
2608.14498.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）使具身智能体能够依据视觉观测和语言指令推理并行动。强化学习（RL）后训练利用任务反馈增强这些能力，但当前同策略 RL 运行时严格串行执行 rollout、参考模型评分和 actor 训练阶段。这种按阶段执行的方式对纯文本 RL 有效，却会浪费 VLM 的资源，因为稠密视频输入和提示前缀的处理占据每个阶段的很大比例。由于前缀处理与生成响应无关，它可以与 GPU 计算能力利用不足的 rollout 解码并行执行，而不破坏同步同策略语义。我们提出 Rollplex 运行时，将参考模型和训练阶段拆解，并把前缀计算移入 rollout 解码窗口。实现这一调度不只是并发启动算子：直接共置 Qwen2.5-VL-32B，每张 GPU 约需 165 GiB 内存，同时 rollout 和训练偏好的张量并行（TP）度与权重布局不同。Rollplex 通过两项机制解决这些约束。阶段感知内存管理依据生产者—消费者生命周期控制 HBM 驻留；并行度感知权重共享则使不同 TP 度下布局兼容的张量使用相同物理存储，只重建不兼容张量，从而避免完整复制第二份 actor。在 32 张 H800 GPU 上，在保持同步 RL 更新的同时，Rollplex 相对于串行共置实现 1.23–1.30 倍加速，相对于同 GPU 预算下的分离部署实现 1.57–2.24 倍加速。
2608.14498.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.12146.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models couples two load-balancing problems. Rollout-trajectory composition determines attention and dense feed-forward work across data-parallel (DP) replicas, while token routing determines expert work across expert-parallel ranks. Optimizing either side independently can worsen the other. Routing replay exposes trajectory lengths and layer-wise expert demand before training, creating an opportunity to coordinate both controls. We present RoutePack, a replay-guided planner that coordinates expert placement and rollout-trajectory scheduling. Its key insight is that placement determines a batchwise expert-rank load bound that trajectory scheduling alone cannot lower, while scheduling controls the hotspots within individual execution micro-steps. RoutePack incrementally adjusts expert placement while preserving expert residency, then uses parallel population annealing to reschedule complete trajectories into token-capped microbatches. Its objective jointly balances dense-side work and layer-wise expert peaks under a fixed, capacity-feasible micro-step count and the deployed synchronization groups. The planner preserves logical token routing and keeps placement fixed throughout forward and backward execution to maintain training-state consistency. We evaluate mixed-task RL post-training of two hybrid-attention MoE models (7.9B and 124B parameters) across six NVIDIA H20-3e configurations spanning 8K-32K contexts. Within the Megatron training region, RoutePack achieves 4.44-11.85% higher throughput than a DP-local first-fit-decreasing baseline and 1.33-5.28% higher throughput than expert rerouting alone. Additional evaluations of the 7.9B model on H200 and H20 retain positive gains. We separately characterize planning and admission costs.
2608.12146.zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型的强化学习（RL）后训练将两个负载均衡问题耦合起来。Rollout 轨迹的组合决定数据并行（DP）副本之间的注意力与稠密前馈工作量，而 token 路由决定专家并行 rank 之间的专家工作量。单独优化任一侧都可能使另一侧变差。路由重放在训练前暴露轨迹长度和逐层专家需求，为协调这两项控制提供了机会。我们提出 RoutePack，一种以重放信息为指导、协调专家放置与 rollout 轨迹调度的规划器。其关键洞察是：放置决定了整个批次的专家 rank 负载界限，仅靠轨迹调度无法降低这一界限，而调度决定各个执行微步内的热点。RoutePack 在保留专家驻留的同时增量调整专家放置，再使用并行种群退火，将完整轨迹重新安排到受 token 上限约束的微批中。其目标是在固定且容量可行的微步数和已部署同步组下，联合平衡稠密侧工作量与逐层专家峰值。规划器保持逻辑 token 路由，并在整个前向和反向执行期间固定专家放置，以保证训练状态一致性。我们在六种 NVIDIA H20-3e 配置上，评估两个采用混合注意力的 MoE 模型（7.9B 和 124B 参数）的混合任务 RL 后训练，上下文范围为 8K–32K。在 Megatron 训练区间内，相比 DP 本地的首次适应递减基线，RoutePack 吞吐量提高 4.44%–11.85%；相比仅进行专家重路由，提高 1.33%–5.28%。在 H200 和 H20 上对 7.9B 模型的额外评估仍显示正收益。我们另行刻画了规划与准入成本。
2608.12146.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

1511.08486.en: Matrix-parametrized models, including multiclass logistic regression and sparse coding, are used in machine learning (ML) applications ranging from computer vision to computational biology. When these models are applied to large-scale ML problems starting at millions of samples and tens of thousands of classes, their parameter matrix can grow at an unexpected rate, resulting in high parameter synchronization costs that greatly slow down distributed learning. To address this issue, we propose a Sufficient Factor Broadcasting (SFB) computation model for efficient distributed learning of a large family of matrix-parameterized models, which share the following property: the parameter update computed on each data sample is a rank-1 matrix, i.e., the outer product of two "sufficient factors" (SFs). By broadcasting the SFs among worker machines and reconstructing the update matrices locally at each worker, SFB improves communication efficiency --- communication costs are linear in the parameter matrix's dimensions, rather than quadratic --- without affecting computational correctness. We present a theoretical convergence analysis of SFB, and empirically corroborate its efficiency on four different matrix-parametrized ML models.
1511.08486.zh: 包括多类逻辑回归和稀疏编码在内的矩阵参数化模型，被广泛用于从计算机视觉到计算生物学的机器学习应用。当这些模型用于样本数达数百万、类别数达数万的大规模机器学习问题时，参数矩阵可能以超出预期的速度增长，导致高昂的参数同步成本，显著拖慢分布式学习。为解决这一问题，我们提出充分因子广播（SFB）计算模型，为一大类矩阵参数化模型实现高效分布式学习。这些模型具有共同性质：基于单个样本计算出的参数更新是秩为 1 的矩阵，即两个“充分因子”（SF）的外积。SFB 在工作机器之间广播充分因子，并在每台工作机器本地重建更新矩阵，从而在不影响计算正确性的情况下改善通信效率：通信成本随参数矩阵的维度线性增长，而非二次增长。我们给出 SFB 的理论收敛分析，并在四种不同的矩阵参数化机器学习模型上通过实验验证其效率。
1511.08486.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.16691.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has emerged as the key paradigm for improving autoregressive video models. Emerging vision-language reward models further strengthen post-training with accurate rewards, but their long chain-of-thought inference substantially raises the associated costs, while the pursuit of long videos prolongs policy training. Despite these rising costs, existing video RL systems still adopt coarse-grained stage-centric execution, which stalls policy training until all reward evaluation finishes, replays every trajectory twice due to a further barrier within policy training, and induces load imbalance across GPUs. To address the challenges, we propose StageBreaker, a fine-grained data-dependency-driven scheduling framework, which schedules the true dataflow of an RL step rather than its stages. Specifically, StageBreaker overlaps policy training with reward evaluation by exploiting reward-separable policy training, and merges the two trajectory replays into one by leveraging loss-independent back-propagation. It further balances GPU load by scheduling computation at the finer granularity. Our evaluation results show that StageBreaker achieves a speedup of up to 1.41$\times$ over stage-centric execution.
2610.16691.zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练已成为改进自回归视频模型的关键范式。新兴视觉语言奖励模型通过准确奖励进一步增强后训练，但其长思维链推理显著增加相关成本，而追求长视频又延长了策略训练。尽管成本不断上升，现有视频 RL 系统仍采用以阶段为中心的粗粒度执行：必须等待全部奖励评估完成后才开始策略训练，策略训练内部的另一道屏障又导致每条轨迹被重放两次，同时造成 GPU 间负载不均。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 StageBreaker，一种细粒度、数据依赖驱动的调度框架，调度一个 RL 步骤的真实数据流，而非其阶段。具体而言，StageBreaker 利用奖励可分离的策略训练，将策略训练与奖励评估重叠，并利用不依赖损失的反向传播，将两次轨迹重放合并为一次。它还通过更细粒度的计算调度平衡 GPU 负载。评估结果表明，StageBreaker 相对于以阶段为中心的执行最高实现 1.41 倍加速。
2610.16691.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.05935.en: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSyncRL, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness. For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSyncRL computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. We prove that gradient streaming produces the same GRPO and OPD updates as batch-synchronous training, without changing either objective. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal Bench 4.0, we train models to the same performance up to $1.9 \times$ faster than synchronous training. With zero policy staleness, ThunderSyncRL also outperforms asynchronous training at a fixed budget by up to $2.47$ percentage points.
2610.05935.zh: 语言模型正在从生成答案走向在交互环境中追求长时程目标。对这些智能体进行后训练需要长且异构的轨迹，而同步系统会让学习引擎一直闲置，直到 rollout 和验证完成。为了消除这些流水线空泡，异步训练使 rollout 与学习跨更新重叠执行，但代价是策略陈旧。我们提出 ThunderSyncRL，在所有必需输入确定后立即开始梯度计算，同时不引入策略陈旧。对于组相对策略优化（GRPO），ThunderSyncRL 在单条轨迹的奖励到达后就计算该轨迹的得分函数梯度，无须等待整个组。对于同策略蒸馏（OPD），它在沙箱执行工具调用的同时，为每个已完成的智能体轮次中经过教师评分的动作计算梯度。我们证明，梯度流式计算在不改变任何一个目标函数的情况下，产生与批同步训练相同的 GRPO 和 OPD 更新。在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal Bench 4.0 上，我们将模型训练到相同性能的速度最高达到同步训练的 1.9 倍。在策略陈旧程度为零的同时，ThunderSyncRL 在固定预算下还比异步训练最高提升 2.47 个百分点。
2610.05935.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.33581.en: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolutions at which these models are typically trained. Cascade refinement is a leading strategy for this setting: it starts from a base image at a native resolution and progressively upsamples it to the target resolution through multiple refinement stages. Each stage typically performs a pixel-space resolution transition followed by latent-space denoising. While prior acceleration efforts mainly focus on reducing denoising cost, we identify a complementary and underexplored bottleneck: the repeated movement of representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions. In cascade pipelines, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress boundary artifacts. We propose UltraFlash, a transition-efficient approach that accelerates these VAE-heavy operations. UltraFlash has two components. Latent Hyperloop replaces intermediate RGB round trips with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the decode-resize-encode transformation without repeated VAE decoding and encoding. Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final reconstruction by addressing patch seams caused by inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by approximately 2x while improving image quality. These results show that optimizing pixel-space transitions can improve both efficiency and fidelity, offering an effective route toward fast, high-quality megapixel visual synthesis.
2610.33581.zh: 使用潜在扩散模型进行百万像素级视觉合成，需要在远高于这些模型通常训练分辨率的条件下运行。级联细化是这一场景中的主要策略之一：它从原生分辨率的基础图像出发，通过多个细化阶段逐步上采样到目标分辨率。每个阶段通常先在像素空间进行分辨率转换，再在潜在空间进行去噪。以往的加速工作主要关注降低去噪成本，而我们发现了一个互补但尚未得到充分研究的瓶颈：表示反复通过 VAE 进行转换。我们将这些操作称为像素空间转换。在级联流水线中，中间潜变量往往先解码为 RGB 图像、调整大小并重新编码，然后才进行细化；最终潜变量则逐块解码，并使用密集重叠来抑制边界伪影。我们提出 UltraFlash，通过提高转换效率来加速这些高度依赖 VAE 的操作。UltraFlash 包含两个组件。Latent Hyperloop 用学习得到的潜在空间捷径替代中间的 RGB 往返转换，近似解码—缩放—编码变换，从而避免反复进行 VAE 解码与编码。稀疏分块解码通过处理 GroupNorm 统计量不一致所导致的块间接缝，并在块之间复用缓存的统计量，加速最终重建，使 VAE 能以远小得多的重叠进行稀疏解码。将 UltraFlash 集成到一个先进的级联基线后，4K 生成延迟约降低至原来的二分之一，同时图像质量得到提升。这些结果表明，优化像素空间转换能够同时改善效率和保真度，为快速、高质量的百万像素级视觉合成提供有效途径。
2610.33581.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2401.10241.en: Pipeline parallelism is one of the key components for large-scale distributed training, yet its efficiency suffers from pipeline bubbles which were deemed inevitable. In this work, we introduce a scheduling strategy that, to our knowledge, is the first to successfully achieve zero pipeline bubbles under synchronous training semantics. The key idea behind this improvement is to split the backward computation into two parts, one that computes gradient for the input and another that computes for the parameters. Based on this idea, we handcraft novel pipeline schedules that significantly outperform the baseline methods. We further develop an algorithm that automatically finds an optimal schedule based on specific model configuration and memory limit. Additionally, to truly achieve zero bubble, we introduce a novel technique to bypass synchronizations during the optimizer step. Experimental evaluations show that our method outperforms the 1F1B schedule up to 23% in throughput under a similar memory limit. This number can be further pushed to 31% when the memory constraint is relaxed. We believe our results mark a major step forward in harnessing the true potential of pipeline parallelism. We open sourced our implementation based on the popular Megatron-LM repository on https://github.com/sail-sg/zero-bubble-pipeline-parallelism .
2401.10241.zh: 流水线并行是大规模分布式训练的关键组成部分之一，但其效率受到过去被认为不可避免的流水线空泡的影响。本文提出一种调度策略，据我们所知，它首次成功在同步训练语义下实现了零流水线空泡。这一改进的关键思想是将反向计算拆成两部分：一部分计算输入梯度，另一部分计算参数梯度。基于这一思想，我们手工设计了新的流水线调度，显著优于基线方法。我们进一步开发了一种算法，能够根据具体模型配置和内存限制自动寻找最优调度。此外，为真正实现零空泡，我们提出了一项绕过优化器步骤中同步操作的新技术。实验评估表明，在相近的内存限制下，我们的方法相对于 1F1B 调度最高提升 23% 的吞吐量；放宽内存约束后，该提升可进一步达到 31%。我们认为，这些结果是在充分发挥流水线并行潜力方面迈出的重要一步。我们已在 https://github.com/sail-sg/zero-bubble-pipeline-parallelism 中开源基于广泛使用的 Megatron-LM 仓库实现的代码。
2401.10241.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2401.10241.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2605.19481.en: Modern LLM serving is increasingly serverless in shape: large model catalogs, long-tail invocations, and multi-tenant demand. Existing GPU serving systems face a tradeoff: dedicated-GPU allocation wastes scarce HBM under sparse traffic, while GPU time sharing places model initialization and weight loading on the cold-start path. Spatial GPU sharing such as multi-instance GPU (MIG) provides isolation and accounting, but each slice has too little HBM for modern LLM weights. We observe that high-bandwidth CPU--GPU interconnects, such as NVLink-C2C (C2C) in NVIDIA GH200 and GB200 Superchips, change the memory constraint: model weights can reside in CPU memory and be streamed on demand to MIG instances, shifting model residency from scarce HBM to abundant host memory. Leveraging this capability, we present C2CServe, a request-granularity serverless LLM serving system that allows MIG instances to switch models across requests without reloading weights into HBM. C2CServe introduces HybridGEMM, a heterogeneous-memory-aware GEMM kernel that adapts data access patterns to balance HBM and C2C bandwidth across MIG partitions using a single tuning knob. To mitigate shared-C2C contention, C2CServe further uses a hierarchical scheduler that coordinates model placement, input chunking, and kernel selection with online feedback control. On GH200, C2CServe reduces cold-start latency by up to 7.1x for dense models and 4.6x for MoE models compared with state-of-the-art serverless LLM serving systems, while maintaining over 95\% TTFT and TPOT attainment under C2C contention.
2605.19481.zh: 现代大语言模型服务越来越呈现无服务器形态：模型目录庞大、调用具有长尾特征，并且存在多租户需求。现有 GPU 服务系统面临权衡：在流量稀疏时，为模型分配专用 GPU 会浪费稀缺的 HBM，而 GPU 时间共享会将模型初始化和权重加载放到冷启动关键路径上。多实例 GPU（MIG）等 GPU 空间共享方式能够提供隔离和计量，但每个切片的 HBM 都不足以容纳现代大语言模型的权重。我们观察到，NVIDIA GH200 和 GB200 超级芯片中的 NVLink-C2C（C2C）等高带宽 CPU—GPU 互连改变了这一内存约束：模型权重可以驻留在 CPU 内存中，并按需流式传输到 MIG 实例，从而将模型驻留位置从稀缺的 HBM 转移到充裕的主机内存。利用这一能力，我们提出 C2CServe，一种以请求为粒度的无服务器大语言模型服务系统，使 MIG 实例能够在不同请求之间切换模型，而无须将权重重新加载进 HBM。C2CServe 引入 HybridGEMM，这是一种感知异构内存的 GEMM 内核，通过一个调节参数自适应调整数据访问模式，平衡各 MIG 分区上的 HBM 与 C2C 带宽。为缓解共享 C2C 的争用，C2CServe 进一步采用分层调度器，通过在线反馈控制协调模型放置、输入分块和内核选择。在 GH200 上，与先进的无服务器大语言模型服务系统相比，C2CServe 将稠密模型和 MoE 模型的冷启动延迟分别最高降低至原来的 1/7.1 和 1/4.6，同时在存在 C2C 争用时保持超过 95% 的 TTFT 和 TPOT 达标率。
2605.19481.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.03537.en: Modern deep learning workloads increasingly comprise heterogeneous computation graphs that combine compute-intensive operators with memory-intensive subgraphs. Existing deep learning compilers typically optimize these operator classes separately, creating rigid fusion boundaries that limit cross-operator optimization and on-chip data reuse. We observe that downstream memory-intensive operations can execute concurrently with compute-intensive operators, allowing their execution to be hidden behind computation; however, automatically exploiting this opportunity poses new compilation challenges. In this paper, we present ComFuse, an automated GPU compilation system that employs a novel operator fusion strategy to generate high-performance kernels for complex graph structures comprising compute-intensive operators and dependency-rich, memory-intensive elementwise-reduction subgraphs. ComFuse further supports the fusion of back-to-back GEMM (B2BGEMM) patterns, extending its applicability to more complex compute-memory interaction patterns. Additionally, it automatically lowers high-level tensor subprograms into optimized fused kernels, reducing the need for manual kernel engineering. Experimental results show that the fused kernels generated by ComFuse outperform those produced by TorchInductor across post-norm workloads and various complex computation scenarios, while supporting more flexible fusion patterns.
2608.03537.zh: 现代深度学习工作负载日益由异构计算图构成，其中同时包含计算密集型算子和内存密集型子图。现有深度学习编译器通常分别优化这两类算子，形成僵硬的融合边界，限制跨算子优化和片上数据复用。我们观察到，下游内存密集型操作能够与计算密集型算子并发执行，从而将其执行隐藏在计算之后；然而，要自动利用这一机会，会带来新的编译挑战。本文提出 ComFuse，一种自动化 GPU 编译系统，采用新的算子融合策略，为由计算密集型算子和依赖关系丰富的内存密集型逐元素—归约子图构成的复杂图结构生成高性能内核。ComFuse 进一步支持连续 GEMM（B2BGEMM）模式的融合，将适用范围扩展到更复杂的计算与内存交互模式。此外，它能够自动将高层张量子程序降低为优化后的融合内核，减少人工内核工程的需求。实验结果表明，在后置归一化工作负载及多种复杂计算场景中，ComFuse 生成的融合内核优于 TorchInductor 生成的内核，同时支持更加灵活的融合模式。
2608.03537.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.14376.en: Despite fixed sampling parameters and random seeds, Large Language Model (LLM) inference exhibits output inconsistency, which undermines downstream tasks such as model evaluation and reinforcement learning. A major source of this nondeterminism is batch-dependent GPU execution: dynamic input shapes change kernel tiling and floating-point reduction orders. Existing systems address this problem with batch-invariant kernels, but these kernels restrict optimized tiling and split reductions, increasing more than 2$\times$ latency and reducing serving throughput by up to 74 %. This paper observes that although most kernels are not batch-invariant, they are position-invariant. Leveraging this property, we present CoRun, a scheduling-based system that achieves deterministic inference without requiring batch invariance. CoRun employs isolated prefill and fixed-shape batched decode to handle the two stages of LLM inference, respectively, leveraging CUDA graphs for efficient execution and simplified implementation. Experiments on LLMs with diverse architectures, including Qwen and DeepSeek, show that CoRun ensures determinism while improving throughput by 15-324 % over batch-invariant approaches, reducing time-to-first-token by 51.8 % and time-per-output-token by 48.6 % on average.
2608.14376.zh: 即使固定采样参数和随机种子，大语言模型（LLM）推理仍会出现输出不一致，损害模型评估和强化学习等下游任务。这种非确定性的一个主要来源是依赖批次的 GPU 执行：动态输入形状会改变内核的分块方式和浮点归约顺序。现有系统通过批次不变的内核解决这一问题，但这些内核限制了优化后的分块方式和拆分归约，使延迟增至两倍以上，并使服务吞吐量最高下降 74%。本文观察到，虽然大多数内核不具有批次不变性，但具有位置不变性。利用这一性质，我们提出 CoRun，一种基于调度的系统，无须要求批次不变性即可实现确定性推理。CoRun 分别采用隔离的预填充和固定形状的批处理解码来处理大语言模型推理的两个阶段，并利用 CUDA Graph 实现高效执行和简化实现。在包括 Qwen 和 DeepSeek 在内、架构各异的大语言模型上的实验表明，CoRun 在确保确定性的同时，相对于批次不变方法将吞吐量提高 15%—324%，平均将首 token 时间降低 51.8%，将每个输出 token 的时间降低 48.6%。
2608.14376.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2604.10180.en: Disaggregation maps parts of an AI workload to different types of GPUs, offering a path to utilize modern heterogeneous GPU clusters. However, existing solutions operate at a coarse granularity and are tightly coupled to specific model architectures, leaving much room for performance improvement. This paper presents Tessera, the first kernel disaggregation system to improve performance and cost efficiency on heterogeneous GPUs for large model inference. Our key insight is that kernels within a single application exhibit diverse resource demands, making them the most suitable granularity for aligning computation with hardware capabilities. Tessera integrates offline analysis with online adaptation by extracting precise inter-kernel dependencies from PTX to ensure correctness, overlapping communication with computation through a pipelined execution model, and employing workload-aware scheduling with lightweight runtime adaptation. Extensive evaluations across five heterogeneous GPUs and four model architectures, scaling up to 16 GPUs, show that Tessera improves serving throughput and cost efficiency by up to 2.3x and 1.6x, respectively, compared to existing disaggregation methods, while generalizing to model architectures where prior approaches do not apply. Surprisingly, a heterogeneous GPU pair under Tessera can even exceed the throughput of two homogeneous high-end GPUs at a lower cost.
2604.10180.zh: 解耦执行将 AI 工作负载的不同部分映射到不同类型的 GPU，为利用现代异构 GPU 集群提供了一条途径。然而，现有方案的执行粒度较粗，而且与特定模型架构紧密耦合，仍有很大的性能提升空间。本文提出 Tessera，这是首个通过内核解耦来提升异构 GPU 上大模型推理性能与成本效率的系统。我们的核心洞察是，同一个应用中的不同内核具有多样的资源需求，因此内核是使计算与硬件能力相匹配的最合适粒度。Tessera 将离线分析与在线自适应相结合：从 PTX 中提取精确的内核间依赖以保证正确性，通过流水线执行模型使通信与计算重叠，并采用感知工作负载的调度及轻量级运行时自适应。覆盖五种异构 GPU 和四种模型架构、规模最高达到 16 块 GPU 的广泛评估表明，相对于现有解耦方法，Tessera 将服务吞吐量和成本效率分别最高提高至 2.3 倍和 1.6 倍，同时能推广到以往方法不适用的模型架构。令人意外的是，Tessera 管理的一对异构 GPU 甚至能以更低的成本超过两块同构高端 GPU 的吞吐量。
2604.10180.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2508.08448.en: GPU singletasking is becoming increasingly inefficient and unsustainable as hardware capabilities grow and workloads diversify. We are now at an inflection point where GPUs must embrace multitasking, much like CPUs did decades ago, to meet the demands of modern AI workloads. In this work, we highlight the key requirements for GPU multitasking, examine prior efforts, and discuss why they fall short. To advance toward efficient and practical GPU multitasking, we envision a resource management layer, analogous to a CPU operating system, to handle various aspects of GPU resource management and sharing. We outline the challenges and potential solutions, and hope this paper inspires broader community efforts to build the next-generation GPU compute paradigm grounded in multitasking.
2508.08448.zh: 随着硬件能力增强和工作负载日益多样化，GPU 单任务执行正变得越来越低效且难以持续。我们现已处于一个转折点：GPU 必须像数十年前的 CPU 一样拥抱多任务执行，才能满足现代 AI 工作负载的需求。本文强调 GPU 多任务执行的关键要求，审视已有探索，并讨论它们为何仍有不足。为迈向高效且实用的 GPU 多任务执行，我们设想建立一个类似 CPU 操作系统的资源管理层，处理 GPU 资源管理与共享的各个方面。我们概述相关挑战和潜在解决方案，并希望本文能激发更广泛的社区努力，构建以多任务执行为基础的下一代 GPU 计算范式。
2508.08448.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

grape.en: Achieving high performance in machine learning workloads is a crucial yet difficult task. To achieve high runtime performance on hardware platforms such as GPUs, graph-based executions such as CUDA graphs are often used to eliminate CPU runtime overheads by submitting jobs in the granularity of multiple kernels. However, many machine learning workloads, especially dynamic deep neural networks (DNNs) with varying-sized inputs or datadependent control flows, face challenges when directly using CUDA graphs to achieve optimal performance. We observe that the use of graph-based executions poses three key challenges in terms of efficiency and even practicability: (1) Extra data movements when copying input values to graphs’ placeholders. (2) High GPU memory consumption due to the numerous CUDA graphs created to efficiently support dynamic-shape workloads. (3) Inability to handle data-dependent control flows. To address those challenges, we propose Grape, a new graph compiler that enables practical and efficient graph-based executions for dynamic DNNs on GPUs. Grape comprises three key components: (1) an alias predictor that automatically removes extra data movements by leveraging code positions at the Python frontend, (2) a metadata compressor that efficiently utilizes the data redundancy in CUDA graphs’ memory regions by compressing them, and (3) a predication rewriter that safely replaces control flows with predication contexts while preserving programs’ semantics. The three components improve the efficiency and broaden the optimization scope of graph-based executions while allowing machine learning practitioners to program dynamic DNNs at the Python level with minimal source code changes. We evaluate Grape on state-of-the-art text generation (GPT-2, GPT-J) and speech recognition (Wav2Vec2) workloads, which include both training and inference, using real systems with modern GPUs. Our evaluation shows that Grape achieves up to 36.43× less GPU memory consumption and up to 1.26× better performance than prior works on graph-based executions that directly use CUDA graphs. Furthermore, Grape can optimize workloads that are impractical for prior works due to the three key challenges, achieving 1.78× and 1.82× better performance on GPT-J and Wav2Vec2 respectively than the original implementations that do not use graph-based executions.
grape.zh: 在机器学习工作负载中获得高性能是一项至关重要却十分困难的任务。为在 GPU 等硬件平台上获得高运行时性能，人们通常采用 CUDA Graph 等基于图的执行方式，以多个内核为提交粒度来消除 CPU 运行时开销。然而，许多机器学习工作负载，尤其是输入大小可变或具有数据依赖控制流的动态深度神经网络（DNN），很难通过直接使用 CUDA Graph 获得最优性能。我们观察到，基于图的执行在效率乃至实用性方面存在三个关键挑战：（1）将输入值复制到图的占位符时产生额外的数据移动；（2）为高效支持动态形状工作负载而创建大量 CUDA Graph，导致 GPU 内存消耗很高；（3）无法处理依赖数据的控制流。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Grape，一种新的图编译器，使动态 DNN 能够在 GPU 上实现实用且高效的基于图的执行。Grape 包含三个关键组件：（1）别名预测器，利用 Python 前端的代码位置自动消除额外数据移动；（2）元数据压缩器，通过压缩 CUDA Graph 内存区域中的冗余数据来高效利用内存；（3）谓词化重写器，在保留程序语义的同时，将控制流安全地替换为谓词化上下文。这三个组件提升了基于图的执行的效率并拓宽其优化范围，同时允许机器学习开发者在 Python 层编写动态 DNN，只需极少的源代码修改。我们在配备现代 GPU 的真实系统上，使用先进的文本生成（GPT-2、GPT-J）和语音识别（Wav2Vec2）工作负载评估 Grape，同时覆盖训练和推理。评估表明，相对于直接使用 CUDA Graph 的既有图执行工作，Grape 的 GPU 内存消耗最高降低至原来的 1/36.43，性能最高达到 1.26 倍。此外，对于由于上述三个关键挑战而无法被既有工作实用地处理的工作负载，Grape 仍能进行优化：相对于不使用图执行的原始实现，它在 GPT-J 和 Wav2Vec2 上的性能分别达到 1.78 倍和 1.82 倍。

2007.01277.en: We present automatic horizontal fusion, a novel optimization technique that complements the standard kernel fusion techniques for GPU programs. Unlike the standard fusion, whose goal is to eliminate intermediate data round trips, our horizontal fusion technique aims to increase the thread-level parallelism to hide instruction latencies. We also present HFuse, a new source to source CUDA compiler that implements automatic horizontal fusion. Our experimental results show that horizontal fusion can speed up the running time by 2.5%-60.8%. Our results reveal that the horizontal fusion is especially beneficial for fusing kernels with instructions that require different kinds of GPU resources (e.g., a memory-intensive kernel and a compute-intensive kernel).
2007.01277.zh: 我们提出自动水平融合，一种新的优化技术，用于补充 GPU 程序的标准内核融合技术。标准融合的目标是消除中间数据的往返传输，而我们的水平融合技术旨在增加线程级并行度，从而隐藏指令延迟。我们还提出 HFuse，一个实现自动水平融合的新型 CUDA 源码到源码编译器。实验结果表明，水平融合可使运行时间获得 2.5%—60.8% 的加速。结果还揭示，水平融合对于融合包含不同 GPU 资源需求指令的内核尤其有益，例如将内存密集型内核与计算密集型内核融合。
2007.01277.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

mccs.en: Performance of collective communication is critical for distributed systems. Using libraries to implement collective communication algorithms is not a good fit for a multi-tenant cloud environment because the tenant is not aware of the underlying physical network configuration or how other tenants use the shared cloud network—this lack of information prevents the library from selecting an optimal algorithm. In this paper, we explore a new approach for collective communication that more tightly integrates the implementation with the cloud network instead of the applications. We introduce MCCS, or Managed Collective Communication as a Service, which exposes traditional collective communication abstractions to applications while providing control and flexibility to the cloud provider for their implementations. Realizing MCCS involves overcoming several key challenges to integrate collective communication as part of the cloud network, including memory management of tenant GPU buffers, synchronizing changes to collective communication strategies, and supporting policies that involve cross-layer traffic optimization. Our evaluations show that MCCS improves tenant collective communication performance by up to 2.4× compared to one of the state-of-the-art collective communication libraries (NCCL), while adding more management features including dynamic algorithm adjustment, quality of service, and network-aware traffic engineering.
mccs.zh: 集合通信的性能对分布式系统至关重要。在多租户云环境中，通过库来实现集合通信算法并不合适，因为租户不了解底层物理网络配置，也不知道其他租户如何使用共享云网络；这种信息缺失使库无法选择最优算法。本文探索一种新的集合通信方法，使其实现与云网络而非应用更加紧密地结合。我们提出 MCCS，即托管集合通信即服务：它向应用暴露传统的集合通信抽象，同时向云服务提供方提供实现层面的控制能力与灵活性。实现 MCCS 需要克服将集合通信集成为云网络组成部分的若干关键挑战，包括管理租户 GPU 缓冲区的内存、同步集合通信策略的变更，以及支持涉及跨层流量优化的策略。评估表明，与先进集合通信库之一 NCCL 相比，MCCS 将租户集合通信的性能最高提升至 2.4 倍，同时增加了动态算法调整、服务质量和网络感知流量工程等管理功能。
mccs.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.13585.en: Communication has become a bottleneck in distributed training and inference of large models. Overlapping communication with computation at the granularity of kernels, on separate streams, reduces only part of this communication cost. Fused kernels often have better performance by transmitting each output tile as soon as it is produced, but existing fused kernels are largely confined to a single NVLink domain. We present mKernel, a library of multi-GPU, multi-node fused kernels that overlap computation, intra-node NVLink communication, and inter-node RDMA at tile granularity. mKernel partitions the streaming multiprocessors (SMs) of a persistent kernel into compute and communication roles, and an on-GPU controller tunes the SM partition adaptively at run time, since the best SM partition varies with the kernel and the input shape. It structures data movement hierarchically so that data traversing the inter-node network is minimized. Finally, it drives the network from the GPU through a lightweight command queue and host proxy implemented directly on RDMA verbs, which allows the same kernels to run on any network backend (e.g. InfiniBand and on AWS EFA); we observe, surprisingly, that GPUDirect Async (IBGDA) yields little additional benefit over host-assisted GPU-initiated communication. We implement five kernels spanning tensor, sequence, and expert parallelism. On two 16-GPU H200 clusters, mKernel achieves speedups of up to 1.72x on GEMM+AllReduce and $1.88\times$ on Ring Attention.
2609.13585.zh: 通信已成为大模型分布式训练和推理的瓶颈。在独立流上以内核为粒度重叠通信与计算，只能减少部分通信成本。融合内核在每个输出块生成后立即将其传输，因而通常具有更好的性能，但现有融合内核基本局限于单个 NVLink 域。我们提出 mKernel，一个支持多 GPU、多节点的融合内核库，以块为粒度重叠计算、节点内 NVLink 通信和节点间 RDMA。mKernel 将持久化内核的流式多处理器（SM）划分为计算和通信两类角色，并通过 GPU 上的控制器在运行时自适应调整 SM 划分，因为最优划分随内核和输入形状而变化。它以分层方式组织数据移动，尽量减少经过节点间网络的数据。最后，它通过轻量级命令队列和直接基于 RDMA verbs 实现的主机代理，由 GPU 驱动网络，使同一组内核能够在任意网络后端上运行，例如 InfiniBand 和 AWS EFA；令人意外的是，我们观察到，与主机辅助的 GPU 发起通信相比，GPUDirect Async（IBGDA）几乎没有带来额外收益。我们实现了五个内核，涵盖张量并行、序列并行和专家并行。在两个各配备 16 块 H200 GPU 的集群上，mKernel 在 GEMM+AllReduce 和 Ring Attention 上分别实现最高 1.72 倍和 1.88 倍的加速。

2512.22219.en: We introduce Mirage Persistent Kernel (MPK), the first compiler and runtime system that automatically transforms multi-GPU model inference into a single high-performance mega-kernel. MPK introduces an SM-level graph representation that captures data dependencies at the granularity of individual streaming multiprocessors (SMs), enabling cross-operator software pipelining, \rev{fine-grained overlap of computation and communication, and other optimizations that are infeasible under the conventional kernel-per-operator execution model}. The MPK compiler lowers tensor programs into optimized SM-level task graphs and generates fast CUDA implementations for each task, while the MPK in-kernel parallel runtime executes these tasks within a single persistent mega-kernel using decentralized scheduling across SMs. Together, these components provide end-to-end kernel fusion with minimal developer effort, while preserving the flexibility of existing programming models. Our evaluation shows that MPK significantly outperforms existing kernel-per-operator LLM serving systems, achieving up to 1.7$\times$ lower end-to-end inference latency and pushing LLM inference performance close to the limits of the underlying hardware. MPK is publicly available at https://github.com/mirage-project/mirage .
2512.22219.zh: 我们提出 Mirage Persistent Kernel（MPK），这是首个能够自动将多 GPU 模型推理转换为单个高性能巨型内核的编译器与运行时系统。MPK 引入一种 SM 级图表示，以单个流式多处理器（SM）为粒度捕获数据依赖，从而实现跨算子软件流水线、计算与通信的细粒度重叠，以及传统每个算子一个内核的执行模型无法实现的其他优化。MPK 编译器将张量程序降低为优化后的 SM 级任务图，并为每个任务生成快速的 CUDA 实现；MPK 的内核内并行运行时则通过跨 SM 的去中心化调度，在单个持久化巨型内核中执行这些任务。这些组件共同实现了端到端内核融合，只需开发者付出极少工作，同时保留现有编程模型的灵活性。评估表明，MPK 显著优于现有每个算子一个内核的大语言模型服务系统，将端到端推理延迟最高降低至原来的 1/1.7，并将大语言模型推理性能推近底层硬件的极限。MPK 已在 https://github.com/mirage-project/mirage 中公开。
