orion.en: GPUs are critical for maximizing the throughput-per-Watt of deep neural network (DNN) applications. However, DNN applications often underutilize GPUs, even when using large batch sizes and eliminating input data processing or communication stalls. DNN workloads consist of data-dependent operators, with different compute and memory requirements. While an operator may saturate GPU compute units or memory bandwidth, it often leaves other GPU resources idle. Despite the prevalence of GPU sharing techniques, current approaches are not sufficiently fine-grained or interferenceaware to maximize GPU utilization while minimizing interference at the granularity of 10s of μs. We propose Orion, a system that transparently intercepts GPU kernel launches from multiple clients sharing a GPU. Orion schedules work on the GPU at the granularity of individual operators and minimizes interference by taking into account each operator’s compute and memory requirements. We integrate Orion in PyTorch and demonstrate its benefits in various DNN workload collocation use cases. Orion significantly improves tail latency compared to state-of-the-art baselines for a highpriority inference job while collocating best-effort inference jobs to increase per-GPU request throughput by up to 7.3×, or while collocating DNN training, saving up to 1.49 × in training costs compared to dedicated GPU allocation.
orion.zh: GPU 对最大化深度神经网络（DNN）应用的每瓦吞吐量至关重要。然而，即使采用较大的批大小并消除输入数据处理或通信停顿，DNN 应用往往仍未充分利用 GPU。DNN 工作负载由具有数据依赖关系的算子组成，各算子的计算和内存需求不同。某个算子即使能占满 GPU 计算单元或内存带宽，往往仍会让其他 GPU 资源闲置。尽管 GPU 共享技术十分普遍，当前方法的粒度仍不够细，也不能充分感知干扰，因而难以在数十微秒粒度上最大化 GPU 利用率并尽量减少干扰。我们提出 Orion，一种透明拦截共享同一 GPU 的多个客户端所发起内核启动的系统。Orion 以单个算子为粒度调度 GPU 上的工作，并通过考虑各算子的计算和内存需求来减少干扰。我们将 Orion 集成到 PyTorch 中，并在多种 DNN 工作负载混部场景中展示其收益。与先进基线相比，Orion 显著改善高优先级推理作业的尾延迟；同时，通过混部尽力而为的推理作业，将单 GPU 请求吞吐量最高提升至 7.3 倍，或者通过混部 DNN 训练，相对于分配专用 GPU 将训练成本最高降低至原来的 1/1.49。
orion.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

singe.en: We present Singe, a Domain Specific Language (DSL) compiler for combustion chemistry that leverages warp specialization to produce high performance code for GPUs. Instead of relying on traditional GPU programming models that emphasize data-parallel computations, warp specialization allows compilers like Singe to partition computations into sub-computations which are then assigned to different warps within a thread block. Fine-grain synchronization between warps is performed efficiently in hardware using producer-consumer named barriers. Partitioning computations using warp specialization allows Singe to deal efficiently with the irregularity in both data access patterns and computation. Furthermore, warp-specialized partitioning of computations allows Singe to fit extremely large working sets into on-chip memories. Finally, we describe the architecture and general compilation techniques necessary for constructing a warp-specializing compiler. We show that the warp-specialized code emitted by Singe is up to 3.75X faster than previously optimized data-parallel GPU kernels.
singe.zh: 我们提出 Singe，一种面向燃烧化学的领域特定语言（DSL）编译器，利用 warp 专门化为 GPU 生成高性能代码。传统 GPU 编程模型强调数据并行计算，而 warp 专门化允许 Singe 这样的编译器将计算划分为多个子计算，并将其分配给线程块内的不同 warp。warp 之间的细粒度同步通过生产者—消费者命名屏障在硬件中高效完成。借助 warp 专门化划分计算，使 Singe 能够高效应对数据访问模式和计算两方面的不规则性。此外，以 warp 专门化方式划分计算还使 Singe 能将极大的工作集放入片上内存。最后，我们介绍构建 warp 专门化编译器所需的架构和通用编译技术。我们表明，Singe 生成的 warp 专门化代码相对于此前经过优化的数据并行 GPU 内核，最高实现 3.75 倍的加速。
singe.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.07098.en: Large transformer-based models increasingly depend on multi-GPU execution, which requires frequent collective communication among GPUs. Existing communication libraries often rely on many GPU threads to achieve high bandwidth or low latency, resulting in a large streaming multiprocessor (SM)-side resource footprint. This footprint can limit the resources available to other GPU work, particularly when communication and computation execute concurrently. Thus, efficient collective communication should not only achieve high collective performance but also reduce its SM-side resource usage. This paper presents T-CCL, a resource-efficient collective communication library based on the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) for intra-node communication. T-CCL offloads both data movement and reduction operations to TMA and executes each collective as a pipelined series of asynchronous TMA operations, reducing the SM resources required for collective communication while maintaining high bandwidth. Evaluated across AllReduce, AllGather, and ReduceScatter collectives, T-CCL outperforms NCCL by up to 2.4x with unrestricted communication resources and up to 3.42x under restricted resource budgets, remains competitive with NCCL's recent symmetric-memory kernels, and occupies the same or fewer SMs in profiled cases. In a GEMM-collective overlap case study, switching the communication backend from NCCL to T-CCL raises the average operator-level speedup over a sequential baseline from 1.12x to 1.25x on two GPUs and from 1.04x to 1.14x on four GPUs, as T-CCL uses fewer SMs for communication, leaving more SMs available to the overlapped GEMM. Integrated into vLLM as a communication backend, T-CCL improves end-to-end inference throughput over vLLM's automatic backend dispatch by up to 1.31x, outperforming it at every evaluated batch size on both the conversation and decode-heavy workloads.
2610.07098.zh: 基于 Transformer 的大型模型越来越依赖多 GPU 执行，这要求 GPU 之间频繁进行集合通信。现有通信库往往依赖大量 GPU 线程来实现高带宽或低延迟，导致流式多处理器（SM）侧的资源占用较大。这种占用会限制其他 GPU 工作可用的资源，尤其是在通信和计算并发执行时。因此，高效的集合通信不仅应具有很高的通信性能，还应减少 SM 侧资源使用。本文提出 T-CCL，一种基于张量内存加速器（TMA）、用于节点内通信的资源高效集合通信库。T-CCL 将数据移动和归约操作都卸载给 TMA，并将每次集合通信执行为一系列流水化的异步 TMA 操作，在保持高带宽的同时减少集合通信所需的 SM 资源。在 AllReduce、AllGather 和 ReduceScatter 上的评估表明，通信资源不受限时 T-CCL 相对于 NCCL 最高实现 2.4 倍的性能，在资源预算受限时最高达到 3.42 倍；相对于 NCCL 近期的对称内存内核，它仍具有竞争力，并且在所分析的案例中占用相同或更少的 SM。在 GEMM 与集合通信重叠的案例研究中，将通信后端由 NCCL 切换为 T-CCL 后，相对于顺序执行基线的平均算子级加速比，在两块 GPU 上由 1.12 倍提升至 1.25 倍，在四块 GPU 上由 1.04 倍提升至 1.14 倍；原因是 T-CCL 使用更少的 SM 进行通信，为重叠执行的 GEMM 留出了更多 SM。将 T-CCL 作为通信后端集成到 vLLM 后，与 vLLM 的自动后端选择相比，端到端推理吞吐量最高提升至 1.31 倍，并在对话和解码占比高的两类工作负载中、所有评估的批大小下均取得更高性能。
2610.07098.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

tacker.en: The proliferation of machine learning applications has promoted both CUDA Cores and Tensor Cores’ integration to meet their acceleration demands. While studies have shown that co-locating multiple tasks on the same GPU can effectively improve system throughput and resource utilization, existing schemes focus on scheduling the resources of traditional CUDA Cores and thus lack the ability to exploit the parallelism between Tensor Cores and CUDA Cores. In this paper, we propose Tacker, a static kernel fusion and scheduling approach to improve GPU utilization of both types of cores while ensuring the QoS (Quality-of-Service) of co-located tasks. Tacker consists of a Tensor-CUDA Core kernel fuser, a duration predictor for fused kernels, and a runtime QoS-aware kernel manager . The kernel fuser enables the flexible fusion of kernels that use Tensor Cores and CUDA Cores, respectively. The duration predictor precisely predicts the duration of the fused kernels. Finally, the kernel manager invokes the fused kernel or the original kernel based on the QoS headroom of latency-critical tasks to improve the system throughput. Our experimental results show that Tacker improves the throughput of best-effort applications compared with state-of-the-art solutions by 18.6% on average, while ensuring the QoS of latency-critical tasks.
tacker.zh: 机器学习应用的普及推动了 CUDA Core 和 Tensor Core 的共同集成，以满足其加速需求。已有研究表明，在同一块 GPU 上混部多个任务能有效提高系统吞吐量和资源利用率，但现有方案主要关注传统 CUDA Core 的资源调度，因而缺乏利用 Tensor Core 与 CUDA Core 之间并行性的能力。本文提出 Tacker，一种静态内核融合与调度方法，在保障混部任务服务质量（QoS）的同时，提高这两类计算核心的 GPU 利用率。Tacker 由 Tensor-CUDA Core 内核融合器、融合内核时长预测器和运行时 QoS 感知内核管理器组成。内核融合器能够灵活融合分别使用 Tensor Core 和 CUDA Core 的内核。时长预测器精确预测融合内核的执行时长。最后，内核管理器根据延迟敏感任务的 QoS 余量，选择调用融合内核或原始内核，以提高系统吞吐量。实验结果表明，与先进方案相比，Tacker 在保障延迟敏感任务 QoS 的同时，将尽力而为应用的吞吐量平均提高 18.6%。
tacker.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2510.14719.en: Modern GPUs feature specialized hardware units that enable high-performance, asynchronous dataflow execution. However, the conventional SIMT programming model is fundamentally misaligned with this task-parallel hardware, creating a significant programmability gap. While hardware-level warp specialization is the key to unlocking peak performance, it forces developers to manually orchestrate complex, low-level communication and software pipelines--a process that is labor-intensive, error-prone, and unsustainable. To address this challenge, we present Tawa, an automated compiler that systematically generates high-performance, warp-specialized code from a high-level, tile-based program. Central to our approach is a novel IR abstraction, asynchronous references (aref), which expresses warp-level communication without exposing low-level hardware details. Using this abstraction, Tawa automatically partitions programs into producer-consumer roles and manages the intricate dataflow pipeline, relieving developers of invasive kernel rewriting. Evaluation on NVIDIA H100 GPUs across representative LLM kernels shows that Tawa delivers high hardware utilization, achieving up to 1.1$\times$ speedup over highly optimized cuBLAS GEMM kernels. For attention workloads, Tawa attains 1.2$\times$ speedup over Triton and matches the performance of the hand-optimized CUTLASS C++ FlashAttention-3 kernel with far less programming effort.
2510.14719.zh: 现代 GPU 配备专门化硬件单元，能够实现高性能的异步数据流执行。然而，传统 SIMT 编程模型与这种任务并行硬件存在根本性的不匹配，造成显著的可编程性鸿沟。虽然硬件层面的 warp 专门化是释放峰值性能的关键，但它迫使开发者手动组织复杂、底层的通信与软件流水线；这一过程劳动密集、容易出错且难以持续。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Tawa，一个自动化编译器，能够系统地从高层、基于块的程序生成高性能的 warp 专门化代码。我们方法的核心是新的中间表示抽象——异步引用（aref），它在不暴露底层硬件细节的情况下表达 warp 级通信。利用这一抽象，Tawa 自动将程序划分为生产者和消费者角色，并管理复杂的数据流流水线，使开发者无须对内核进行侵入式重写。在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上对代表性大语言模型内核的评估表明，Tawa 能实现较高的硬件利用率，相对于高度优化的 cuBLAS GEMM 内核最高实现 1.1 倍加速。对于注意力工作负载，Tawa 相对于 Triton 实现 1.2 倍加速，并以少得多的编程工作达到手工优化的 CUTLASS C++ FlashAttention-3 内核的性能。
2510.14719.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

turbobus.en: GPU memory offloading is widely adopted for LLM workloads but shifts the bottleneck to GPU–CPU transfers, which can take up to 90% of the end-to-end inference/training time! Paradoxically, over 60% of PCIe bandwidth remains idle. The root cause is that PCIe links areindividually bottlenecked but collectively underutilized. Bursty, phase-driven transfer patterns leave bandwidth idle both within and across jobs. We present TurboBus, which pools PCIe bandwidth across co-located jobs via emerging scale-up fabrics. TurboBus enables any GPU to borrow idle PCIe links from neighboring GPUs, even those belonging to other jobs, while preserving isolation through a privileged daemon. At the core of TurboBus, it streams data through relay GPUs with bounded memory overhead, keeps all links busy through fine-grained PCIe allocation, enables bidirectional transfers leveraging PCIe/NVLink bandwidth asymmetry, and balances fairness and completion time with a size-aware scheduling. We fully implement TurboBus and our experiments show that it reduces first-token latency by up to 40% for on-demand model loading (within 5% of the analytical optimum), achieves up to 1.6× throughput for KV-cache-offloaded inference, and accelerates training by up to 7%, while imposing less than 1% overhead on co-located workloads.
turbobus.zh: GPU 内存卸载已被广泛用于大语言模型工作负载，但这会将瓶颈转移到 GPU—CPU 传输，而传输时间最高可占端到端推理或训练时间的 90%！矛盾的是，超过 60% 的 PCIe 带宽仍处于闲置状态。根本原因在于，PCIe 链路单独来看存在瓶颈，整体来看却未被充分利用。具有突发性、受执行阶段驱动的传输模式，使单个作业内和不同作业之间都出现带宽闲置。我们提出 TurboBus，借助新兴的纵向扩展互连，将混部作业的 PCIe 带宽池化。TurboBus 允许任意 GPU 借用相邻 GPU 的闲置 PCIe 链路，甚至包括属于其他作业的 GPU，同时通过特权守护进程维持隔离。TurboBus 的核心机制包括：在内存开销有界的情况下通过中继 GPU 流式传输数据；通过细粒度 PCIe 分配保持所有链路繁忙；利用 PCIe 与 NVLink 的带宽不对称性实现双向传输；以及通过感知数据大小的调度平衡公平性和完成时间。我们完整实现了 TurboBus，实验表明，它将按需模型加载的首 token 延迟最高降低 40%（与分析得到的最优值相差不超过 5%），使 KV 缓存卸载推理的吞吐量最高达到 1.6 倍，并使训练最高加速 7%，同时给混部工作负载带来的开销低于 1%。
turbobus.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2512.18134.en: GPU architectures have continued to grow in complexity, with recent incarnations introducing increasingly powerful fixed-function units for matrix multiplication and data movement to accompany highly parallel general-purpose cores. To fully leverage these machines, software must use sophisticated schedules that maximally utilize all hardware resources. Since realizing such schedules is complex, both programmers and compilers routinely employ program transformations, such as software pipelining (SWP) and warp specialization (WS), to do so in practice. However, determining how best to use SWP and WS in combination is a challenging problem that is currently handled through a mix of brittle compilation heuristics and fallible human intuition, with little insight into the space of solutions. To remedy this situation, we introduce a novel formulation of SWP and WS as a joint optimization problem that can be solved holistically by off-the-shelf constraint solvers. We reify our approach in Twill, the first system that automatically derives optimal SWP and WS schedules for a large class of iterative programs. Twill is heuristic-free, easily extensible to new GPU architectures, and guaranteed to produce optimal schedules. We show that Twill can rediscover, and thereby prove optimal, the SWP and WS schedules manually developed by experts for Flash Attention on both the NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPU architectures.
2512.18134.zh: GPU 架构的复杂性持续增加，近几代产品在高度并行的通用计算核心之外，又引入了越来越强大的矩阵乘法和数据移动固定功能单元。要充分利用这些机器，软件必须使用复杂的调度，尽量充分利用所有硬件资源。由于实现此类调度十分复杂，程序员和编译器在实践中通常采用软件流水线（SWP）和 warp 专门化（WS）等程序变换。然而，确定如何最优地结合 SWP 与 WS 是一个困难问题；目前人们混合使用脆弱的编译启发式和可能出错的人工直觉来处理，对解空间缺乏充分认识。为改善这一状况，我们提出一种新的表述方式，将 SWP 与 WS 视为联合优化问题，并用现成的约束求解器整体求解。我们在 Twill 中实现这一方法；它是首个能够为一大类迭代程序自动推导最优 SWP 和 WS 调度的系统。Twill 无须启发式，易于扩展到新的 GPU 架构，并保证生成最优调度。我们表明，Twill 能够重新发现专家为 NVIDIA Hopper 和 Blackwell 两种 GPU 架构上的 Flash Attention 手动设计的 SWP 和 WS 调度，从而证明这些调度是最优的。
2512.18134.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2403.03208.en: Inspired by the concept of active learning, we propose active inference$\unicode{x2013}$a methodology for statistical inference with machine-learning-assisted data collection. Assuming a budget on the number of labels that can be collected, the methodology uses a machine learning model to identify which data points would be most beneficial to label, thus effectively utilizing the budget. It operates on a simple yet powerful intuition: prioritize the collection of labels for data points where the model exhibits uncertainty, and rely on the model's predictions where it is confident. Active inference constructs provably valid confidence intervals and hypothesis tests while leveraging any black-box machine learning model and handling any data distribution. The key point is that it achieves the same level of accuracy with far fewer samples than existing baselines relying on non-adaptively-collected data. This means that for the same number of collected samples, active inference enables smaller confidence intervals and more powerful p-values. We evaluate active inference on datasets from public opinion research, census analysis, and proteomics.
2403.03208.zh: 受主动学习概念的启发，我们提出主动推断——一种借助机器学习辅助数据采集的统计推断方法。在可采集标签数量受到预算限制的情况下，该方法使用机器学习模型识别最值得标注的数据点，从而有效利用预算。它基于一个简单而有力的直觉：优先采集模型表现出不确定性的数据点的标签，而在模型有把握时依赖其预测。主动推断能够利用任意黑盒机器学习模型、处理任意数据分布，并构建具有有效性证明的置信区间和假设检验。关键在于，与依赖非自适应采集数据的现有基线相比，它用少得多的样本即可达到同等准确性。这意味着，在采集样本数相同的情况下，主动推断能够得到更窄的置信区间，以及带来更高检验功效的 p 值。我们在来自民意研究、人口普查分析和蛋白质组学的数据集上评估主动推断。
2403.03208.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2311.14768.en: Diffusion models, as a type of generative model, have achieved impressive results in generating images and videos conditioned on textual conditions. However, the generation process of diffusion models involves denoising dozens of steps to produce photorealistic images/videos, which is computationally expensive. Unlike previous methods that design ``one-size-fits-all'' approaches for speed up, we argue denoising steps should be sample-specific conditioned on the richness of input texts. To this end, we introduce AdaDiff, a lightweight framework designed to learn instance-specific step usage policies, which are then used by the diffusion model for generation. AdaDiff is optimized using a policy gradient method to maximize a carefully designed reward function, balancing inference time and generation quality. We conduct experiments on three image generation and two video generation benchmarks and demonstrate that our approach achieves similar visual quality compared to the baseline using a fixed 50 denoising steps while reducing inference time by at least 33%, going as high as 40%. Furthermore, our method can be used on top of other acceleration methods to provide further speed benefits. Lastly, qualitative analysis shows that AdaDiff allocates more steps to more informative prompts and fewer steps to simpler prompts.
2311.14768.zh: 扩散模型作为一种生成模型，在以文本为条件生成图像和视频方面已取得令人瞩目的成果。然而，扩散模型的生成过程需要经过数十步去噪才能得到照片级逼真的图像或视频，计算成本高昂。与以往设计一刀切加速方案的方法不同，我们认为去噪步数应针对具体样本，根据输入文本的信息丰富程度而确定。为此，我们提出 AdaDiff，一个轻量级框架，用于学习实例特定的步数使用策略，再由扩散模型依据这些策略进行生成。AdaDiff 使用策略梯度方法进行优化，最大化经过精心设计、用于平衡推理时间和生成质量的奖励函数。我们在三个图像生成和两个视频生成基准上进行实验，表明与固定使用 50 步去噪的基线相比，我们的方法能够保持相近的视觉质量，同时将推理时间至少减少 33%，最高减少 40%。此外，我们的方法可以叠加在其他加速方法之上，进一步提高速度。最后，定性分析表明，AdaDiff 会为信息更丰富的提示分配更多步数，为更简单的提示分配更少步数。
2311.14768.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.22263.en: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used approach to post-training large language models. In a typical implementation, learning is off-policy: The policy generating the responses differs from the policy being trained because of training-inference mismatch or policy staleness in asynchronous training. This discrepancy is commonly addressed by importance sampling, whose ratio is usually regularized in practice through truncation, masking, or clipping. Under regularized importance sampling, the importance-weighted policy gradient is no longer invariant to constant shifts in the reward. This invariance is recovered by using the covariance between the reward and the importance-weighted score as the estimand, which coincides with the policy gradient when the ratio is not regularized. This note develops this covariance perspective for both sequence-level and token-level importance sampling. The covariance perspective reveals the roles of the group-mean baseline and score centering in policy gradient estimation. Both perform centering in covariance estimation, but they differ in the mean being subtracted: The group-mean baseline uses a sample mean, whereas score centering uses a population mean. The two lead to distinct unbiased covariance estimators with different variances. Whether both forms of centering should be used simultaneously depends on whether importance sampling is applied at the sequence level or at the token level. With sequence-level importance sampling, score centering adds no benefit once the group-mean baseline is used; with token-level importance sampling, using the group-mean baseline without score centering generally introduces bias when the importance ratio is regularized.
2610.22263.zh: 强化学习已成为大语言模型后训练中广泛使用的方法。在典型实现中，学习是离策略的：由于训练与推理不匹配，或异步训练中的策略陈旧，生成回答的策略不同于正在训练的策略。人们通常使用重要性采样处理这一差异，而在实践中，重要性比率通常会通过截断、掩蔽或裁剪进行正则化。在正则化重要性采样下，经过重要性加权的策略梯度不再对奖励的常数平移保持不变。将奖励与重要性加权得分函数之间的协方差作为待估量，即可恢复这种不变性；当比率未经正则化时，该待估量与策略梯度一致。本文针对序列级和 token 级重要性采样发展这一协方差视角。该视角揭示了组均值基线和得分函数中心化在策略梯度估计中的作用。两者都在协方差估计中进行中心化，但所减去的均值不同：组均值基线使用样本均值，而得分函数中心化使用总体均值。二者产生不同的无偏协方差估计量，其方差也不同。是否应同时使用这两种中心化方式，取决于重要性采样是在序列级还是 token 级进行。在序列级重要性采样中，使用组均值基线后，得分函数中心化不再带来收益；在 token 级重要性采样中，如果重要性比率经过正则化，仅使用组均值基线而不进行得分函数中心化，通常会引入偏差。
2610.22263.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.28409.en: Large language model agents are often given an inference budget and asked to maximise success within it. A multi-turn agent has to allocate this budget across many environment interactions. An external harness can enforce the budget, but it remains unclear whether the agent itself can learn when and how much to spend. We ask whether agents can learn this allocation across dynamically specified budgets and which rewards best teach this behaviour. We adapt existing length penalties to budget constraints spanning multiple resource types, introduce new reward formulations, and compare eleven objectives in a shared training pipeline. We train Qwen3.5 models at 4B and 9B on AppWorld with budgets over tokens, API calls, and environment steps, and on the BabyAI gridworld with turn budgets. We train a separate policy for each environment and resource type, with each policy trained across budget values. Training with rewards that penalise overspending substantially improves within-budget success and natural compliance over untrained models and over training on task success alone, with agents learning to adapt their resource use to stated budgets and task difficulty. These gains extend to unseen budgets and, zero-shot, to a shifted task distribution and a new benchmark. Reward objectives trade off success within budget and natural compliance. A sigmoid penalty for overspending most often achieves the highest within-budget success at an individual budget, while a fixed negative reward for overspending generally yields the strongest natural compliance. Combining penalties for overspend frequency and magnitude gives the smallest average gap to the best method at each budget. Overall, we show that a single agent can learn to allocate resources across turns and adapt its behaviour to user-specified budgets using budget feedback without external budget-allocation controllers.
2610.28409.zh: 大语言模型智能体通常会获得一个推理预算，并被要求在该预算内尽量提高成功率。多轮智能体必须在许多次环境交互之间分配这一预算。外部执行框架可以强制执行预算，但智能体自身能否学会何时使用以及使用多少资源，仍不清楚。我们研究智能体能否在动态指定的预算下学会这种分配，以及哪些奖励最适合教会这种行为。我们将现有的长度惩罚适配到涵盖多种资源类型的预算约束，提出新的奖励形式，并在共享的训练流水线中比较十一种目标。我们在 AppWorld 上训练 4B 和 9B 规模的 Qwen3.5 模型，预算涵盖 token、API 调用和环境步数；还在 BabyAI 网格世界中使用轮次预算进行训练。对于每种环境和资源类型，我们分别训练一个策略，而每个策略都跨多个预算值训练。与未经训练的模型以及仅根据任务成功进行训练的方法相比，使用惩罚超支的奖励进行训练，能够显著提高预算内成功率和自然遵守预算的程度，智能体会学会根据声明的预算和任务难度调整资源使用。这些收益可扩展到未见过的预算，并能零样本推广到发生偏移的任务分布和一个新基准。不同奖励目标在预算内成功率与自然遵守预算之间存在权衡。对于单个预算值，采用 sigmoid 超支惩罚往往获得最高的预算内成功率；对超支给予固定负奖励，通常能获得最强的自然预算遵守能力。结合超支频率和超支幅度的惩罚，与各预算下最佳方法之间的平均差距最小。总体而言，我们表明，单个智能体能够通过预算反馈学会在不同轮次间分配资源，并根据用户指定的预算调整行为，无须外部预算分配控制器。
2610.28409.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.32444.en: We study training-inference mismatch in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for large language models, where rollouts are sampled by an inference engine while gradients are computed by a training engine, and the two engines assign different probabilities to the same tokens. To account for this discrepancy in policy updates, we introduce calibrated importance sampling (CIS). CIS is motivated by an empirically supported logit-displacement characterization that expresses the mismatch as an additive displacement $\varepsilon_t$ in log-odds, determined by the per-logit perturbation before the softmax, whose distribution is approximately invariant to token confidence. This characterization motivates a confidence-aware truncation: large positive displacements are truncated at a single constant threshold, which maps back to an importance-ratio cap that tightens as token confidence increases. Theoretically, we show that CIS replaces the unbounded second moment that governs the error of exact importance sampling with a term bounded by a constant, at the cost of a bias controlled by the truncated excess. In evaluation across three mixture-of-experts models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CIS achieves the highest five-benchmark average on all three models among the evaluated baselines. Diagnostic analyses show that CIS places less truncation bias on low-confidence tokens than truncated importance sampling, while upward clipping of small importance weights reduces held-out accuracy.
2609.32444.zh: 我们研究大语言模型可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中的训练—推理不匹配：rollout 由推理引擎采样，而梯度由训练引擎计算，两个引擎会为相同的 token 赋予不同的概率。为在策略更新中处理这一差异，我们提出校准重要性采样（CIS）。CIS 的依据是一种得到实证支持的 logit 位移刻画：它将不匹配表示为对数优势中的加性位移 ε_t，该位移由 softmax 前各 logit 的扰动决定，其分布近似不随 token 置信度变化。由此我们设计了感知置信度的截断方法：对较大的正位移使用一个统一的常数阈值截断，映射回重要性比率后，这相当于一个随 token 置信度提高而收紧的上限。理论上，我们证明 CIS 将控制精确重要性采样误差的无界二阶矩，替换为一个受常数约束的项，代价是引入由被截断超额部分控制的偏差。在三个混合专家模型和五个数学推理基准上的评估中，CIS 在全部三个模型上均取得所评估基线中最高的五基准平均分。诊断分析表明，与截断重要性采样相比，CIS 在低置信度 token 上施加的截断偏差更小，而将较小的重要性权重向上裁剪会降低留出集准确率。
2609.32444.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2503.14476.en: Inference scaling empowers LLMs with unprecedented reasoning ability, with reinforcement learning as the core technique to elicit complex reasoning. However, key technical details of state-of-the-art reasoning LLMs are concealed (such as in OpenAI o1 blog and DeepSeek R1 technical report), thus the community still struggles to reproduce their RL training results. We propose the $\textbf{D}$ecoupled Clip and $\textbf{D}$ynamic s$\textbf{A}$mpling $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{O}$ptimization ($\textbf{DAPO}$) algorithm, and fully open-source a state-of-the-art large-scale RL system that achieves 50 points on AIME 2024 using Qwen2.5-32B base model. Unlike previous works that withhold training details, we introduce four key techniques of our algorithm that make large-scale LLM RL a success. In addition, we open-source our training code, which is built on the verl framework, along with a carefully curated and processed dataset. These components of our open-source system enhance reproducibility and support future research in large-scale LLM RL.
2503.14476.zh: 推理规模扩展赋予大语言模型前所未有的推理能力，其中强化学习是激发复杂推理的核心技术。然而，先进推理大语言模型的关键技术细节并未公开，例如 OpenAI o1 博客和 DeepSeek R1 技术报告中的相关内容，因此社区仍难以复现它们的强化学习训练结果。我们提出解耦裁剪与动态采样策略优化（DAPO）算法，并完整开源一个先进的大规模强化学习系统，该系统使用 Qwen2.5-32B 基础模型，在 AIME 2024 上取得 50 分。不同于以往保留训练细节的工作，我们介绍了算法中使大规模大语言模型强化学习得以成功的四项关键技术。此外，我们开源了基于 verl 框架构建的训练代码，以及经过精心筛选和处理的数据集。这些开源系统组件提高了可复现性，并为未来的大规模大语言模型强化学习研究提供支持。
2503.14476.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2305.13301.en: Diffusion models are a class of flexible generative models trained with an approximation to the log-likelihood objective. However, most use cases of diffusion models are not concerned with likelihoods, but instead with downstream objectives such as human-perceived image quality or drug effectiveness. In this paper, we investigate reinforcement learning methods for directly optimizing diffusion models for such objectives. We describe how posing denoising as a multi-step decision-making problem enables a class of policy gradient algorithms, which we refer to as denoising diffusion policy optimization (DDPO), that are more effective than alternative reward-weighted likelihood approaches. Empirically, DDPO is able to adapt text-to-image diffusion models to objectives that are difficult to express via prompting, such as image compressibility, and those derived from human feedback, such as aesthetic quality. Finally, we show that DDPO can improve prompt-image alignment using feedback from a vision-language model without the need for additional data collection or human annotation. The project's website can be found at http://rl-diffusion.github.io .
2305.13301.zh: 扩散模型是一类灵活的生成模型，使用对数似然目标的近似形式进行训练。然而，扩散模型的大多数应用并不关心似然，而是关注人类感知的图像质量或药物有效性等下游目标。本文研究使用强化学习方法直接针对这些目标优化扩散模型。我们说明，将去噪表述为一个多步决策问题，如何使一类策略梯度算法成为可能；我们将其称为去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO），它比其他基于奖励加权似然的方法更加有效。实证上，DDPO 能让文本到图像扩散模型适应难以通过提示表达的目标，例如图像可压缩性，也能适应由人类反馈得到的目标，例如美学质量。最后，我们表明，DDPO 能利用视觉语言模型的反馈改善提示与图像的对齐，无须额外采集数据或人工标注。项目网站见 http://rl-diffusion.github.io 。
2305.13301.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2305.13301.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2601.18543.en: We introduce GenAgent, unifying visual understanding and generation through an agentic multimodal model. Unlike unified models that face expensive training costs and understanding-generation trade-offs, GenAgent decouples these capabilities through an agentic framework: understanding is handled by the multimodal model itself, while generation is achieved by treating image generation models as invokable tools. Crucially, unlike existing modular systems constrained by static pipelines, this design enables autonomous multi-turn interactions where the agent generates multimodal chains-of-thought encompassing reasoning, tool invocation, judgment, and reflection to iteratively refine outputs. We employ a two-stage training strategy: first, cold-start with supervised fine-tuning on high-quality tool invocation and reflection data to bootstrap agent behaviors; second, end-to-end agentic reinforcement learning combining pointwise rewards (final image quality) and pairwise rewards (reflection accuracy), with trajectory resampling for enhanced multi-turn exploration. GenAgent significantly boosts base generator(FLUX.1-dev) performance on GenEval++ (+23.6\%) and WISE (+14\%). Beyond performance gains, our framework demonstrates three key properties: 1) cross-tool generalization to generators with varying capabilities, 2) test-time scaling with consistent improvements across interaction rounds, and 3) task-adaptive reasoning that automatically adjusts to different tasks. Our code will be available at \href{ https://github.com/deep-kaixun/GenAgent }{this url}.
2601.18543.zh: 我们提出 GenAgent，通过智能体式多模态模型统一视觉理解与生成。统一模型往往面临高昂的训练成本以及理解与生成之间的权衡，而 GenAgent 通过智能体框架将这两种能力解耦：理解由多模态模型自身完成，生成则通过将图像生成模型作为可调用工具实现。关键在于，不同于受静态流水线限制的现有模块化系统，这一设计支持自主的多轮交互，智能体生成包含推理、工具调用、判断和反思的多模态思维链，迭代改进输出。我们采用两阶段训练策略：首先，在高质量工具调用和反思数据上进行监督微调冷启动，以建立智能体行为；其次，进行端到端智能体强化学习，结合逐样本奖励（最终图像质量）和成对奖励（反思准确性），并通过轨迹重采样加强多轮探索。GenAgent 显著提升基础生成器 FLUX.1-dev 的性能，在 GenEval++ 和 WISE 上分别提高 23.6% 和 14%。除了性能收益，我们的框架还展示出三个关键性质：（1）能够跨工具泛化到能力不同的生成器；（2）能够进行测试时扩展，并随交互轮次增加持续改善；（3）具备任务自适应推理能力，能自动适配不同任务。代码将在 https://github.com/deep-kaixun/GenAgent 中公开。

2605.17969.en: Despite rapid advances in text-to-image generation, faithfully realizing user intent remains challenging, often requiring manual multi-turn trial and error. To automate this process, existing systems rely on either simple prompt rewriting or closed-loop agents driven by hand-crafted rules, rather than learning to adapt actions to the evolving generation process. In this paper, we reformulate image generation as a state-conditioned action-making problem and propose Generation Navigator, a multi-turn T2I agent that learns to dynamically steer the generation trajectory and output the next action. However, training this agent via reinforcement learning introduces a critical credit assignment challenge: naively rewarding a trajectory based solely on a single state assigns equal credit to all actions in the rollout, ignores the quality dynamics across turns, and fails to distinguish actions that improve the trajectory from those that degrade it or waste turns without progress. We resolve this with PRE-GRPO (Peak-Retention-Efficiency Group Relative Policy Optimization), a trajectory-level reinforcement learning objective that explicitly rewards discovering a high-quality image (Peak), avoiding subsequent quality degradation across turns (Retention), and minimizing unnecessary turns (Efficiency). Experiments show substantial improvements across benchmarks, reaching a WISE score of 0.90 and 79.06% reasoning accuracy on T2I-ReasonBench.
2605.17969.zh: 尽管文本到图像生成发展迅速，忠实实现用户意图仍然困难，往往需要人工进行多轮试错。为了自动化这一过程，现有系统依赖简单的提示改写或由手工规则驱动的闭环智能体，而非学习根据不断演进的生成过程调整动作。本文将图像生成重新表述为以状态为条件的动作决策问题，并提出 Generation Navigator：一种多轮 T2I 智能体，能够学习动态引导生成轨迹并输出下一步动作。然而，通过强化学习训练这一智能体带来了关键的信用分配挑战：如果仅依据单个状态对轨迹进行简单奖励，就会为 rollout 中所有动作分配同等信用，忽略不同轮次之间的质量变化，也无法区分改善轨迹的动作、导致退化的动作以及没有进展而浪费轮次的动作。我们通过 PRE-GRPO（峰值—保持—效率组相对策略优化）解决这一问题。这是一种轨迹级强化学习目标，明确奖励发现高质量图像（峰值）、避免后续轮次中的质量退化（保持），以及尽量减少不必要的轮次（效率）。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上取得显著提升，WISE 得分达到 0.90，T2I-ReasonBench 推理准确率达到 79.06%。
2605.17969.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

greensmith-variance-reduction.en: Policy gradient methods for reinforcement learning avoid s ome of the undesirable properties of the value function approaches, such as policy degradation ( Baxter and Bartlett, 2001). However, the variance of the performance gradient estimates obtaine d from the simulation is sometimes excessive. In this paper, we consider variance reduction meth ods that were developed for Monte Carlo estimates of integrals. We study two commonly used policy gradient techniques, the baseline and actor-critic methods, from this perspective. Both can b e interpreted as additive control variate variance reduction methods. We consider the expected avera ge reward performance measure, and we focus on the GPOMDP algorithm for estimating performance gradients in partially observable Markov decision processes controlled by stochastic reactive policies. We give bounds for the estimation error of the gradient estimates for both baseline and actor-critic algorithms, in terms of the sample size and mixing properties of the controlled system.For the baseline technique, we compute the optimal baseline, and show that the popular approach of using the average reward to define the baseline can be suboptimal. For actor-critic algorithms, we show that using the true value function as the critic can be suboptimal. We also discuss algorithms for estimating the optimal baseline and approximate value function.
greensmith-variance-reduction.zh: 用于强化学习的策略梯度方法避免了价值函数方法的一些不理想性质，例如策略退化（Baxter 和 Bartlett，2001）。然而，通过仿真得到的性能梯度估计，其方差有时过大。本文考虑原本为积分的蒙特卡洛估计而发展的方差缩减方法，并从这一视角研究两种常用策略梯度技术：基线方法和 actor-critic 方法。二者都可以解释为加性控制变量方差缩减方法。我们考虑期望平均奖励这一性能指标，并重点研究 GPOMDP 算法：它用于估计由随机反应式策略控制的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程中的性能梯度。我们根据样本量和受控系统的混合性质，给出基线算法和 actor-critic 算法的梯度估计误差界。对于基线技术，我们计算最优基线，并表明常用的以平均奖励定义基线的方法可能是次优的。对于 actor-critic 算法，我们表明将真实价值函数用作 critic 也可能是次优的。我们还讨论用于估计最优基线和近似价值函数的算法。
greensmith-variance-reduction.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

horvitz-thompson.en: This paper presents a general technique for the treatment of samples drawn without replacement from finite universes when unequal selection probabilities are used. Two sampling schemes are discussed in connection with the problem of determining optimum selection probabilities according to the information available in a supplementary variable. Admittedly, these two schemes have limited application. They should prove useful, however, for the first stage of sampling with multi-stage designs, since both permit unbiased estimation of the sampling variance without resorting to additional assumptions.
horvitz-thompson.zh: 本文提出一种通用技术，用于处理从有限总体中按不等选择概率进行不放回抽样所得的样本。围绕如何根据辅助变量所提供的信息确定最优选择概率这一问题，本文讨论了两种抽样方案。诚然，这两种方案的适用范围有限。然而，它们应当对多阶段设计中的第一阶段抽样有所帮助，因为两者都允许在不引入额外假设的情况下，对抽样方差进行无偏估计。
horvitz-thompson.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2503.05696.en: Many reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are impractical for training in operational systems or computationally expensive high-fidelity simulations, as they require large amounts of data. Meanwhile, low-fidelity simulators, e.g., reduced-order models, heuristic rewards, or learned world models, can cheaply provide useful data, even if they are too coarse for zero-shot transfer. We propose multi-fidelity policy gradients (MFPGs), a sample-efficient RL framework that mixes scarce target-environment data with a control variate formed from abundant low-fidelity simulation data to construct an unbiased, variance-reduced estimator for on-policy policy gradients. We instantiate the framework with a practical, multi-fidelity variant of the classical REINFORCE algorithm. Under standard assumptions, the MFPG estimator guarantees asymptotic convergence to locally optimal policies in the target environment and achieves faster finite-sample convergence than standard REINFORCE. We evaluate MFPG on robotics benchmark tasks with limited high-fidelity data but abundant off-dynamics, low-fidelity data. When low-fidelity data are neutral or beneficial and dynamics gaps are mild-moderate, MFPG is, among the evaluated off-dynamics RL and low-fidelity-only approaches, the only method that consistently achieves statistically significant improvements over a high-fidelity-only baseline. When low-fidelity data become harmful, MFPG exhibits the strongest robustness, whereas strong off-dynamics RL methods exploit low-fidelity data aggressively and fail much more severely. An additional experiment with anti-correlated high- and low-fidelity rewards shows MFPG can remain effective even under reward misspecification. MFPG thus offers a reliable paradigm for exploiting cheap low-fidelity data (e.g., for efficient sim-to-real transfer) while managing the trade-off between policy performance and data collection cost.
2503.05696.zh: 许多强化学习（RL）算法需要大量数据，因此难以用于在实际运行系统或计算成本高昂的高保真仿真中进行训练。与此同时，低保真模拟器，例如降阶模型、启发式奖励或学习得到的世界模型，能够以低成本提供有用数据，即使它们过于粗糙、无法实现零样本迁移。我们提出多保真策略梯度（MFPG），一种样本高效的强化学习框架，将稀缺的目标环境数据与由大量低保真仿真数据构造的控制变量相结合，构建无偏且方差更低的同策略策略梯度估计量。我们使用经典 REINFORCE 算法的一种实用多保真变体来实例化这一框架。在标准假设下，MFPG 估计量保证渐近收敛到目标环境中的局部最优策略，并且具有比标准 REINFORCE 更快的有限样本收敛速度。我们在高保真数据有限、但具有不同动力学的低保真数据充足的机器人基准任务上评估 MFPG。当低保真数据的作用为中性或有益、且动力学差距为轻度至中度时，在所评估的异动力学强化学习方法和仅使用低保真数据的方法中，MFPG 是唯一能够持续相对于仅使用高保真数据的基线取得统计显著改进的方法。当低保真数据变得有害时，MFPG 表现出最强的鲁棒性，而强大的异动力学强化学习方法会激进利用低保真数据，因而遭受严重得多的失败。另一个高保真与低保真奖励负相关的实验表明，即使奖励设定有误，MFPG 也能够保持有效。因此，MFPG 为利用廉价低保真数据提供了一种可靠范式，例如实现高效的仿真到现实迁移，同时管理策略性能与数据采集成本之间的权衡。
2503.05696.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.02505.en: Policy gradient methods for on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) can become unstable when expensive, scarce target-domain data yield noisy gradient estimates. We address this challenge by complementing limited high-fidelity (HF) target-domain data with abundant, cheap, but biased low-fidelity (LF) data, e.g., from a simplified simulator. Most existing methods directly optimize biased objectives based on LF data. In contrast, the recently introduced multi-fidelity policy gradient (MFPG) framework uses LF data solely to construct a control variate that reduces variance and improves HF data efficiency without biasing the policy gradient estimator. However, published work on MFPG is limited to REINFORCE on small-scale simulation tasks. We develop MFPG for modern actor-critic learning in GPU-parallel simulation and on a physical robot. Our analysis and experiments show that naive extensions to proximal policy optimization (PPO) can lose cross-fidelity correlation or inflate variance. Our MFPG-PPO addresses these failures by redesigning the sampling, advantage estimation, and control variate construction to preserve cross-fidelity correlation, and by monitoring estimator uncertainty to prevent variance inflation. We also introduce a budget-aware MFPG-PPO to divide a fixed sampling budget among high- and low-fidelity data sources. Across simulated robot locomotion tasks of varying LF-to-HF transfer difficulty and HF data budgets, MFPG-PPO improves upon PPO trained on HF data alone in nearly all settings, and consistently matches the performance of PPO trained with 16x more HF data on the hardest task at the smallest HF budgets. In contrast, most baselines that use LF data perform well only where direct LF-to-HF transfer succeeds. MFPG-PPO enables stable learning on a physical Franka arm using only 4 real-robot episodes per update and no human demonstrations.
2610.02505.zh: 在同策略强化学习（RL）中，当昂贵且稀缺的目标域数据产生高噪声梯度估计时，策略梯度方法可能变得不稳定。为解决这一挑战，我们用大量廉价但有偏的低保真（LF）数据，例如来自简化模拟器的数据，补充有限的高保真（HF）目标域数据。大多数现有方法直接优化基于低保真数据的有偏目标。相比之下，近期提出的多保真策略梯度（MFPG）框架仅使用低保真数据来构造控制变量，在不使策略梯度估计量产生偏差的前提下，降低方差并提高高保真数据效率。然而，已发表的 MFPG 工作仅限于小规模仿真任务上的 REINFORCE。我们将 MFPG 扩展到 GPU 并行仿真和实体机器人上的现代 actor-critic 学习。分析和实验表明，简单扩展到近端策略优化（PPO）可能导致跨保真度相关性丢失或方差增大。我们的 MFPG-PPO 通过重新设计采样、优势估计和控制变量构造来保留跨保真度相关性，并通过监测估计量不确定性防止方差增大，从而解决这些问题。我们还引入预算感知的 MFPG-PPO，将固定采样预算分配给高保真和低保真数据源。在具有不同低保真到高保真迁移难度及高保真数据预算的模拟机器人运动任务中，MFPG-PPO 几乎在所有设置下都优于仅用高保真数据训练的 PPO；在最困难任务且高保真预算最小时，它持续达到使用 16 倍高保真数据训练的 PPO 的性能。相比之下，大多数利用低保真数据的基线，仅在能够直接从低保真成功迁移到高保真的情况下表现良好。MFPG-PPO 在每次更新仅使用 4 个真实机器人回合、且无须人类示范的情况下，实现了实体 Franka 机械臂上的稳定学习。
2610.02505.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2606.01985.en: Recent breakthroughs in instruction-based image editing have captured significant attention, as models are now capable of handling real-world editing demands with the practicality required by everyday users. However, editing models trained primarily for single-turn edits often break down in multi-turn editing--the natural interactive setting where a user iteratively refines an image based on the model's own previous outputs. This failure stems from the all-or-nothing requirement, where a single failed turn compromises the entire sequence, and error propagation, where exposure bias leads to compounding editing errors. To address these challenges, we introduce MT-EditFlow, a flow-matching reinforcement learning framework designed to optimize reward signals for sequential image editing. MT-EditFlow integrates a multi-turn perspective with a multi-reward formulation to provide a unified structure applicable to both GRPO and NFT-based reinforcement learning methods. We systematically analyze and optimize the reward signal by investigating effective scoring strategies for turn-level aggregation, VLM reasoning modes to trade off reward bias and variance, and advantage fusion levels to prevent reward hacking. Our findings reveal that broadcasting the aggregated advantage across the entire editing trajectory effectively bridges the gap between local planning and global multi-turn task success. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MT-EditFlow significantly improves performance across diverse base models. Notably, it boosts FLUX.1-Kontext-dev by 6.85 points in turn-3 overall performance, surpassing state-of-the-art open-source models such as Qwen-Image-Edit. By maintaining high marginal success rates and reducing exposure bias, MT-EditFlow provides a foundation for more reliable and natural human-AI collaboration in visual content creation.
2606.01985.zh: 基于指令的图像编辑近期取得突破，模型如今已经能够以日常用户所需的实用性处理真实世界的编辑需求，因此受到广泛关注。然而，主要针对单轮编辑训练的模型，在多轮编辑中往往表现失常；而多轮编辑正是用户基于模型先前输出不断细化图像的自然交互方式。这种失效源于“全成或全败”的要求——某一轮失败就会影响整个序列——以及错误传播：暴露偏差会使编辑错误不断累积。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 MT-EditFlow，一种流匹配强化学习框架，旨在优化顺序图像编辑的奖励信号。MT-EditFlow 将多轮视角与多奖励表述相结合，为基于 GRPO 和 NFT 的强化学习方法提供统一结构。我们通过研究用于轮次级聚合的有效评分策略、权衡奖励偏差与方差的 VLM 推理模式，以及防止奖励投机的优势融合层级，系统地分析和优化奖励信号。我们的发现表明，将聚合后的优势广播到整个编辑轨迹，可以有效弥合局部规划与全局多轮任务成功之间的差距。大量实验表明，MT-EditFlow 能显著改善不同基础模型的性能。尤其是，它使 FLUX.1-Kontext-dev 的第三轮综合性能提高了 6.85 分，超过 Qwen-Image-Edit 等最先进开源模型。通过保持较高的逐轮边际成功率并减少暴露偏差，MT-EditFlow 为视觉内容创作中更可靠、更自然的人机协作奠定了基础。
2606.01985.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2507.06961.en: Off-Policy Evaluation (OPE) aims to estimate the value of a target policy using offline data collected from potentially different policies. In real-world applications, however, logged data often suffers from missingness. While OPE has been extensively studied in the literature, a theoretical understanding of how missing data affects OPE results remains unclear. In this paper, we investigate OPE in the presence of monotone missingness and theoretically demonstrate that the value estimates remain unbiased under ignorable missingness but can be biased under nonignorable (informative) missingness. To retain the consistency of value estimation, we propose an inverse probability weighted value estimator and conduct statistical inference to quantify the uncertainty of the estimates. Through a series of numerical experiments, we empirically demonstrate that our proposed estimator yields a more reliable value inference under missing data.
2507.06961.zh: 离策略评估（Off-Policy Evaluation，OPE）旨在使用可能由其他策略采集的离线数据，估计目标策略的价值。然而，在实际应用中，日志数据往往存在缺失。尽管已有文献对 OPE 进行了广泛研究，缺失数据如何影响 OPE 结果，在理论上仍缺乏清晰认识。本文研究存在单调缺失时的 OPE，并从理论上证明：在可忽略缺失条件下，价值估计仍然无偏；但在不可忽略、即具有信息性的缺失条件下，估计可能有偏。为保持价值估计的一致性，我们提出逆概率加权价值估计量，并开展统计推断以量化估计的不确定性。通过一系列数值实验，我们实证表明，所提出的估计量能在数据缺失时提供更可靠的价值推断。
2507.06961.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.36830.en: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves resource utilization in large language model post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but it also introduces policy lag as trajectories are generated and queued while the trainer continues to update. We study how this lag accumulates over a trajectory's lifetime and how it can be controlled without sacrificing the wall-clock benefits of asynchronous execution. We decompose trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness, accumulated before rollout completion, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated after a completed trajectory enters the pool. Motivated by this decomposition, we introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks completed trajectories using an effective-staleness score that combines Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness. This avoids penalizing long or interrupted rollouts solely because they span multiple policy versions. In single-turn mathematical reasoning, PACE improves the six-benchmark average validation accuracy by 18.7\% over unfiltered asynchronous RL at the same wall-clock budget and matches synchronous RL performance with 47.1\% less GPU time. PACE also improves validation performance in multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning, outperforming both synchronous and unfiltered asynchronous RL. Further experiments with the mixture-of-experts model and an alternative RL algorithm support its applicability across model architectures and training algorithms.
2609.36830.zh: 完全异步强化学习（RL）通过重叠 rollout 生成与策略优化，提高大语言模型后训练的资源利用率；但当轨迹生成和排队期间训练器仍持续更新时，也会引入策略滞后。我们研究这种滞后如何在一条轨迹的生命周期内累积，以及如何在不牺牲异步执行实际耗时收益的情况下加以控制。我们将轨迹陈旧度分解为生成陈旧度和等待陈旧度：前者在 rollout 完成之前累积，后者在已完成轨迹进入数据池之后累积。基于这一分解，我们提出 PACE（Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness，感知数据池的有效陈旧度控制）。PACE 将数据池中超额的占用量转换为自适应拒收预算，并使用一种有效陈旧度评分对已完成轨迹排序，该评分结合了等待陈旧度与感知前缀的生成陈旧度。这样就不会仅因为长 rollout 或被中断的 rollout 跨越多个策略版本而惩罚它们。在单轮数学推理中，在相同实际耗时预算下，PACE 相对不进行过滤的异步 RL，将六项基准的平均验证准确率提高了 18.7%，并以少 47.1% 的 GPU 时间达到同步 RL 的性能。PACE 也改善了多轮工具集成推理中的验证性能，优于同步 RL 和不进行过滤的异步 RL。混合专家模型和另一种 RL 算法上的进一步实验，支持其适用于不同模型架构与训练算法。
2609.36830.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

1707.06347.en: We propose a new family of policy gradient methods for reinforcement learning, which alternate between sampling data through interaction with the environment, and optimizing a "surrogate" objective function using stochastic gradient ascent. Whereas standard policy gradient methods perform one gradient update per data sample, we propose a novel objective function that enables multiple epochs of minibatch updates. The new methods, which we call proximal policy optimization (PPO), have some of the benefits of trust region policy optimization (TRPO), but they are much simpler to implement, more general, and have better sample complexity (empirically). Our experiments test PPO on a collection of benchmark tasks, including simulated robotic locomotion and Atari game playing, and we show that PPO outperforms other online policy gradient methods, and overall strikes a favorable balance between sample complexity, simplicity, and wall-time.
1707.06347.zh: 我们提出一类新的强化学习策略梯度方法，在通过与环境交互采样数据和使用随机梯度上升优化“代理”目标函数之间交替进行。标准策略梯度方法针对每个数据样本只执行一次梯度更新，而我们提出一种新的目标函数，支持进行多轮小批次更新。我们将这类新方法称为近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization，PPO）。它具有信赖域策略优化（TRPO）的部分优点，但实现更简单、适用范围更广，并且在实验中表现出更好的样本复杂度。我们在一组基准任务上测试 PPO，包括模拟机器人运动控制和 Atari 游戏，并表明 PPO 优于其他在线策略梯度方法，总体上在样本复杂度、简单性和实际耗时之间取得了良好平衡。
1707.06347.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

reinforce.en: This article presents a general class of associative reinforcement learning algorithms for connectionist networks containing stochastic units. These algorithms, called REINFORCE algorithms, are shown to make weight adjustments in a direction that lies along the gradient of expected reinforcement in both immediate-reinforcement tasks and certain limited forms of delayed-reinforcement tasks, and they do this without explicitly computing gradient estimates or even storing information from which such estimates could be computed. Specific examples of such algorithms are presented, some of which bear a close relationship to certain existing algorithms while others are novel but potentially interesting in their own right. Also given are results that show how such algorithms can be naturally integrated with backpropagation. We close with a brief discussion of a number of additional issues surrounding the use of such algorithms, including what is known about their limiting behaviors as well as further considerations that might be used to help develop similar but potentially more powerful reinforcement learning algorithms.
reinforce.zh: 本文针对包含随机单元的联结主义网络，提出了一般形式的关联强化学习算法。这些算法被称为 REINFORCE 算法。我们证明，在即时强化任务和某些受限的延迟强化任务中，它们能够沿着期望强化信号的梯度方向调整权重，而且无须显式计算梯度估计，甚至无须存储可用来计算这类估计的信息。文中给出了这些算法的具体实例，其中一些与已有算法密切相关，另一些则是本身具有潜在研究价值的新算法。我们还给出一些结果，说明这类算法如何自然地与反向传播相结合。最后，我们简要讨论使用这些算法时的若干其他问题，包括对其极限行为的已有认识，以及可能有助于开发类似但更强大的强化学习算法的进一步考虑。
reinforce.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2511.08991.en: Active statistical inference is a new method for inference with AI-assisted data collection. Given a budget on the number of labeled data points that can be collected and assuming access to an AI predictive model, the basic idea is to improve estimation accuracy by prioritizing the collection of labels where the model is most uncertain. The drawback, however, is that inaccurate uncertainty estimates can make active sampling produce highly noisy results, potentially worse than those from naive uniform sampling. In this work, we present robust sampling strategies for active statistical inference. Robust sampling ensures that the resulting estimator is never worse than the estimator using uniform sampling. Furthermore, with reliable uncertainty estimates, the estimator usually outperforms standard active inference. This is achieved by optimally interpolating between uniform and active sampling, depending on the quality of the uncertainty scores, and by using ideas from robust optimization. We demonstrate the utility of the method on a series of real datasets from computational social science and survey research.
2511.08991.zh: 主动统计推断是一种借助 AI 辅助数据采集开展推断的新方法。在可采集的标注数据点数量受到预算限制、并假设能够使用 AI 预测模型的情况下，其基本思路是优先采集模型最不确定位置的标签，从而提高估计准确性。然而，其缺点在于，不准确的不确定性估计可能使主动采样产生噪声很大的结果，甚至比朴素的均匀采样更差。本文提出用于主动统计推断的稳健采样策略。稳健采样确保所得估计量不会差于采用均匀采样得到的估计量。此外，当不确定性估计可靠时，所得估计量通常优于标准主动推断。我们根据不确定性分数的质量，在均匀采样与主动采样之间进行最优插值，并借助稳健优化思想实现这一点。我们在计算社会科学和调查研究的一系列真实数据集上展示了该方法的实用价值。
2511.08991.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2610.22282.en: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.
2610.22282.zh: 强化学习可以让视觉生成器对齐预训练目标之外的奖励信号，但现有得分函数方法通常通过扰动反向去噪轨迹引入随机性，导致基于 rollout 的优化成本高昂。我们转而研究：能否在保留生成器原有采样器的同时，在生成器内部引入随机探索？路由策略优化（Routing Policy Optimization，RPO）通过将注意力路由转化为随机探索动作，回答了这一问题。在少数选定的去噪噪声级别上，每个查询块保留自身所在的块，并按照生成器原生注意力权重的分布采样额外的键块，或者保留稠密注意力。采样得到的路由会扰动该次转移的速度场，而以稠密速度场为中心的高斯似然通过得分函数目标对这一扰动进行评分。RPO 进一步使用受控的双 rollout 估计量：两个 rollout 共享相同提示、初始潜变量、采用路由的去噪级别以及稠密锚点层，仅在采样的注意力路由上有所不同。它们的奖励差为采用路由的转移提供优势信号。由于似然直接对稠密速度场本身求导，即使移除路由，学习到的更新仍然有效。在推理阶段，RPO 恢复稠密注意力，并保留原有的确定性采样器。文本到图像和文本到视频生成实验表明，RPO 在提高生成质量的同时，相对 Flow-GRPO 类方法实现了接近 4 倍的训练效率。可视化结果请参见 https://velox-world.com/rpo 。
