2509.15965.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated immense potential in advancing artificial general intelligence, agentic intelligence, and embodied intelligence. However, the inherent heterogeneity and dynamicity of RL workflows often lead to low hardware utilization and slow training on existing systems. In this paper, we present RLinf, a high-performance RL training system based on our key observation that the major roadblock to efficient RL training lies in system flexibility. To maximize flexibility and efficiency, RLinf is built atop a novel RL system design paradigm called macro-to-micro flow transformation (M2Flow), which automatically breaks down high-level, easy-to-compose RL workflows at both the temporal and spatial dimensions, and recomposes them into optimized execution flows. Supported by RLinf worker's adaptive communication capability, we devise context switching and elastic pipelining to realize M2Flow transformation, and a profiling-guided scheduling policy to generate optimal execution plans. Extensive evaluations on both reasoning RL and embodied RL tasks demonstrate that RLinf consistently outperforms state-of-the-art systems, achieving $1.07\times-2.43\times$ speedup in end-to-end training throughput.
2509.15965.zh: 强化学习（RL）在推动通用人工智能、智能体智能和具身智能方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，RL 工作流固有的异构性与动态性，经常导致现有系统的硬件利用率低、训练速度慢。本文提出高性能 RL 训练系统 RLinf，其基础是我们的一个关键观察：高效 RL 训练的主要障碍在于系统灵活性。为最大限度提高灵活性与效率，RLinf 构建在一种称为“宏观到微观流转换”（macro-to-micro flow transformation，M2Flow）的新型 RL 系统设计范式之上。该范式在时间与空间两个维度，自动分解高层、易于组合的 RL 工作流，再将其重新组合为经过优化的执行流。依托 RLinf 工作单元的自适应通信能力，我们设计了上下文切换与弹性流水线来实现 M2Flow 转换，并使用剖析结果指导的调度策略生成最优执行计划。针对推理 RL 与具身 RL 任务的大量评估表明，RLinf 持续优于最先进系统，使端到端训练吞吐量获得 1.07–2.43 倍的加速。
2509.15965.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2602.07837.en: Online policy learning directly in the physical world is a promising yet challenging direction for embodied intelligence. Unlike simulation, real-world systems cannot be arbitrarily accelerated, cheaply reset, or massively replicated, suggesting that real-world policy learning is not merely an algorithmic problem, but inherently a systems problem. We present USER, a \underline{U}nified and extensible \underline{S}yst\underline{E}m for real-world online policy lea\underline{R}ning. On the systems side, USER introduces a hardware abstraction layer for unified robot management and an adaptive communication plane that enables efficient cloud-edge training. On the learning side, USER adopts a fully asynchronous training framework, designs a persistent and cache-aware replay buffer, and provides extensible abstractions for rewards, algorithms, and policies. Experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate that USER supports multi-robot coordination, heterogeneous manipulators, cloud-edge training with large models, and long-running asynchronous training. Together, these capabilities establish USER as a unified and extensible systems foundation for real-world online policy learning.
2602.07837.zh: 直接在物理世界中开展在线策略学习，是具身智能一个有前景但也充满挑战的方向。与仿真不同，真实世界系统无法任意加速、低成本重置或大规模复制，这意味着真实世界策略学习不仅是算法问题，本质上也是系统问题。我们提出 USER，一个面向真实世界在线策略学习的统一、可扩展系统。在系统方面，USER 引入用于统一管理机器人的硬件抽象层，以及支持高效云边训练的自适应通信平面。在学习方面，USER 采用完全异步的训练框架，设计了支持持久化且感知缓存的经验回放缓冲区，并为奖励、算法和策略提供可扩展抽象。仿真与真实世界实验表明，USER 支持多机器人协调、异构机械臂、使用大模型的云边训练，以及长时间运行的异步训练。这些能力共同使 USER 成为真实世界在线策略学习的统一、可扩展系统基础。
2602.07837.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2607.14187.en: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagination play complementary roles. Language provides the abstract structure of a plan, including task decomposition, planning primitives, constraints, temporal order, and decision logic, while visual imagination grounds this structure through world state prediction and joint subgoal planning, associating each planning step with intermediate and final physical states. RxBrain adopts a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports language, image, and video understanding and generation within one model. To train this capability, we build an automatic pipeline that converts embodied videos into joint text-visual planning supervision by decomposing videos into planning steps and aligning them with visual state transitions. We further introduce RxBrain-Bench to evaluate whether models can represent embodied plans through joint textual and visual components rather than separate understanding or generation. Experiments show that RxBrain maintains embodied understanding and generation abilities, and produces plans with coupled textual reasoning, world state prediction, and joint subgoal planning. We also extend RxBrain to continuous robot action generation, where it shows promising real-robot performance without large-scale action-data pretraining. These results provide an initial step toward foundation models for embodied cognition.
2607.14187.zh: 具身认知要求智能体将高层任务推理与需要实现的物理状态连接起来。我们提出 Hy-Embodied-RxBrain，一个具备联合语言—视觉推理与想象能力的具身认知基础模型。与强调场景理解和文本决策的视觉语言模型，或主要预测未来视觉状态的生成式世界模型不同，RxBrain 将具身计划表达为单一规划序列，使语言与视觉想象发挥互补作用。语言提供计划的抽象结构，包括任务分解、规划原语、约束、时间顺序和决策逻辑；视觉想象则通过世界状态预测和联合子目标规划，将这一结构落实到物理层面，把每个规划步骤与中间和最终物理状态关联起来。RxBrain 采用统一多模态混合 Transformer 架构，在同一个模型内支持语言、图像和视频的理解与生成。为训练这一能力，我们构建自动化流水线，将具身视频分解为规划步骤，并将其与视觉状态转变对齐，从而把视频转换为联合文本—视觉规划监督。我们进一步提出 RxBrain-Bench，评估模型能否通过联合文本和视觉组件表示具身计划，而不只是分别完成理解或生成。实验表明，RxBrain 保持了具身理解与生成能力，并能产生将文本推理、世界状态预测和联合子目标规划相互耦合的计划。我们还将 RxBrain 扩展到连续机器人动作生成；无需大规模动作数据预训练，它便在真实机器人上展现出有前景的性能。这些结果为面向具身认知的基础模型迈出了初步一步。
2607.14187.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2502.05171.en: We study a novel language model architecture that is capable of scaling test-time computation by implicitly reasoning in latent space. Our model works by iterating a recurrent block, thereby unrolling to arbitrary depth at test-time. This stands in contrast to mainstream reasoning models that scale up compute by producing more tokens. Unlike approaches based on chain-of-thought, our approach does not require any specialized training data, can work with small context windows, and can capture types of reasoning that are not easily represented in words. We scale a proof-of-concept model to 3.5 billion parameters and 800 billion tokens. We show that the resulting model can improve its performance on reasoning benchmarks, sometimes dramatically, up to a computation load equivalent to 50 billion parameters.
2502.05171.zh: 我们研究一种新的语言模型架构，通过在潜在空间中进行隐式推理，扩展测试时计算量。模型反复执行一个循环模块，因此可以在测试时展开到任意深度。这与通过生成更多 token 来增加计算量的主流推理模型不同。与基于思维链的方法相比，我们的方法不需要任何专门训练数据，可以在较小上下文窗口下工作，并能够表达难以用语言描述的推理类型。我们将概念验证模型扩展到 3.5B 参数，并使用 800B token 训练。结果表明，所得模型可以随着计算量增加而改善推理基准上的性能，有时提升十分显著；有效扩展的计算负载可达到相当于 50B 参数模型的水平。
2502.05171.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2303.17651.en: Like humans, large language models (LLMs) do not always generate the best output on their first try. Motivated by how humans refine their written text, we introduce Self-Refine, an approach for improving initial outputs from LLMs through iterative feedback and refinement. The main idea is to generate an initial output using an LLMs; then, the same LLMs provides feedback for its output and uses it to refine itself, iteratively. Self-Refine does not require any supervised training data, additional training, or reinforcement learning, and instead uses a single LLM as the generator, refiner, and feedback provider. We evaluate Self-Refine across 7 diverse tasks, ranging from dialog response generation to mathematical reasoning, using state-of-the-art (GPT-3.5, ChatGPT, and GPT-4) LLMs. Across all evaluated tasks, outputs generated with Self-Refine are preferred by humans and automatic metrics over those generated with the same LLM using conventional one-step generation, improving by ~20% absolute on average in task performance. Our work demonstrates that even state-of-the-art LLMs like GPT-4 can be further improved at test time using our simple, standalone approach.
2303.17651.zh: 与人类一样，大型语言模型（LLM）并不总能在第一次尝试时生成最佳输出。受到人类修改书面文本方式的启发，我们提出 Self-Refine，通过迭代反馈和改进来提升 LLM 的初始输出。其核心思路是先用一个 LLM 生成初始输出，再由同一个 LLM 对该输出给出反馈，并依据反馈不断自我改进。Self-Refine 不需要监督训练数据、额外训练或强化学习，而是让单个 LLM 同时承担生成器、改进器和反馈提供者的角色。我们使用 GPT-3.5、ChatGPT 和 GPT-4 等先进 LLM，在从对话回复生成到数学推理的 7 项不同任务上评估 Self-Refine。在全部评估任务中，无论人工偏好还是自动指标，Self-Refine 生成的输出都优于同一 LLM 使用传统单步生成得到的输出，任务性能平均绝对提高约 20%。我们的工作表明，即使是 GPT-4 这样的先进 LLM，也可以通过这一简单、独立的方法，在测试时进一步改善表现。
2303.17651.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2509.09674.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation. Despite substantial progress enabled by large-scale pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), these models face two fundamental challenges: (i) the scarcity and high cost of large-scale human-operated robotic trajectories required for SFT scaling, and (ii) limited generalization to tasks involving distribution shift. Recent breakthroughs in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) demonstrate that reinforcement learning (RL) can dramatically enhance step-by-step reasoning capabilities, raising a natural question: Can RL similarly improve the long-horizon step-by-step action planning of VLA? In this work, we introduce SimpleVLA-RL, an efficient RL framework tailored for VLA models. Building upon veRL, we introduce VLA-specific trajectory sampling, scalable parallelization, multi-environment rendering, and optimized loss computation. When applied to OpenVLA-OFT, SimpleVLA-RL achieves SoTA performance on LIBERO and even outperforms $\pi_0$ on RoboTwin 1.0\&2.0 with the exploration-enhancing strategies we introduce. SimpleVLA-RL not only reduces dependence on large-scale data and enables robust generalization, but also remarkably surpasses SFT in real-world tasks. Moreover, we identify a novel phenomenon ``pushcut'' during RL training, wherein the policy discovers previously unseen patterns beyond those seen in the previous training process. Github: https://github.com/PRIME-RL/SimpleVLA-RL
2509.09674.zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型近期已成为机器人操作的一种强大范式。尽管大规模预训练和监督微调（SFT）带来了显著进展，这类模型仍面临两个根本挑战：（i）扩展 SFT 所需的大规模人工操作机器人轨迹稀缺且昂贵；（ii）对存在分布偏移的任务泛化能力有限。大型推理模型（LRM）的近期突破表明，强化学习（RL）可以显著增强逐步推理能力，由此自然产生一个问题：强化学习能否同样改善 VLA 的长时程、逐步动作规划？本文提出 SimpleVLA-RL，一个专为 VLA 模型设计的高效强化学习框架。基于 veRL，我们引入 VLA 专属轨迹采样、可扩展并行化、多环境渲染和优化后的损失计算。将 SimpleVLA-RL 应用于 OpenVLA-OFT 时，它在 LIBERO 上取得最先进性能；结合我们提出的增强探索策略后，甚至在 RoboTwin 1.0 和 2.0 上超过 π0。SimpleVLA-RL 不仅减少对大规模数据的依赖，并实现稳健泛化，在真实任务中也显著超过 SFT。此外，我们在强化学习训练中识别出一种名为“pushcut”的新现象：策略发现了超出先前训练过程所见范围的新模式。GitHub 地址见 https://github.com/PRIME-RL/SimpleVLA-RL 。
2509.09674.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2509.09674.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2203.14465.en: Generating step-by-step "chain-of-thought" rationales improves language model performance on complex reasoning tasks like mathematics or commonsense question-answering. However, inducing language model rationale generation currently requires either constructing massive rationale datasets or sacrificing accuracy by using only few-shot inference. We propose a technique to iteratively leverage a small number of rationale examples and a large dataset without rationales, to bootstrap the ability to perform successively more complex reasoning. This technique, the "Self-Taught Reasoner" (STaR), relies on a simple loop: generate rationales to answer many questions, prompted with a few rationale examples; if the generated answers are wrong, try again to generate a rationale given the correct answer; fine-tune on all the rationales that ultimately yielded correct answers; repeat. We show that STaR significantly improves performance on multiple datasets compared to a model fine-tuned to directly predict final answers, and performs comparably to fine-tuning a 30$\times$ larger state-of-the-art language model on CommensenseQA. Thus, STaR lets a model improve itself by learning from its own generated reasoning.
2203.14465.zh: 生成逐步的“思维链”推理过程，可以提升语言模型在数学和常识问答等复杂推理任务上的表现。然而，目前让语言模型生成推理过程，要么需要构建海量推理过程数据集，要么只能依赖少样本推理并牺牲准确率。我们提出一种技术，迭代利用少量带推理过程的示例和大量不带推理过程的数据，逐步引导模型获得处理更复杂推理的能力。这种技术称为自学推理器（STaR），依赖一个简单循环：使用少量推理过程示例作为提示，让模型为许多问题生成推理过程并作答；如果答案错误，则在给定正确答案的条件下重新尝试生成推理过程；对所有最终导出正确答案的推理过程进行微调；然后重复。我们表明，在多个数据集上，相较直接微调来预测最终答案的模型，STaR 显著提高性能；在 CommonsenseQA 上，它的表现可比于微调一个规模大 30 倍的先进语言模型。因此，STaR 让模型能够从自己生成的推理中学习，从而自我改进。
2203.14465.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2310.02304.en: Several recent advances in AI systems solve problems by providing a "scaffolding" program that structures multiple calls to language models (LMs) to generate better outputs. A scaffolding program is written in a programming language such as Python. In this work, we use a language-model-infused scaffolding program to improve itself. We start with a seed "improver" that improves an input program according to a given utility function by querying an LM several times and returning the best solution. We then run this seed improver to improve itself. Across a small set of downstream tasks, the resulting improved improver generates programs with significantly better performance than its seed improver. A variety of self-improvement strategies are proposed by the language model, including beam search, genetic algorithms, and simulated annealing. Since the language models themselves are not altered, this is not full recursive self-improvement. Nonetheless, it demonstrates that a modern language model, GPT-4 in our experiments, is capable of writing code that can call itself to improve itself. We consider concerns around the development of self-improving technologies and evaluate the frequency with which the generated code bypasses a sandbox.
2310.02304.zh: 近期若干 AI 系统进展通过提供一个“支架”程序来解决问题：该程序组织对语言模型（LM）的多次调用，以生成更好的输出。支架程序使用 Python 等编程语言编写。在本文中，我们让一个融入语言模型的支架程序改进自身。我们从一个种子“改进器”出发，它依据给定效用函数，通过多次查询 LM 并返回最佳方案来改进输入程序。随后，我们运行这个种子改进器，让它优化自身。在一小组下游任务中，由此得到的改进后改进器，生成的程序性能显著优于最初的种子改进器。语言模型提出了多种自我改进策略，包括束搜索、遗传算法和模拟退火。由于语言模型本身没有被改变，这并不是完整的递归自我改进。尽管如此，它仍表明，现代语言模型能够编写调用自身来改进自身的代码；我们的实验使用的是 GPT-4。我们还考虑了自我改进技术发展所带来的担忧，并评估生成代码绕过沙箱的频率。
2310.02304.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

1807.03819.en: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) sequentially process data by updating their state with each new data point, and have long been the de facto choice for sequence modeling tasks. However, their inherently sequential computation makes them slow to train. Feed-forward and convolutional architectures have recently been shown to achieve superior results on some sequence modeling tasks such as machine translation, with the added advantage that they concurrently process all inputs in the sequence, leading to easy parallelization and faster training times. Despite these successes, however, popular feed-forward sequence models like the Transformer fail to generalize in many simple tasks that recurrent models handle with ease, e.g. copying strings or even simple logical inference when the string or formula lengths exceed those observed at training time. We propose the Universal Transformer (UT), a parallel-in-time self-attentive recurrent sequence model which can be cast as a generalization of the Transformer model and which addresses these issues. UTs combine the parallelizability and global receptive field of feed-forward sequence models like the Transformer with the recurrent inductive bias of RNNs. We also add a dynamic per-position halting mechanism and find that it improves accuracy on several tasks. In contrast to the standard Transformer, under certain assumptions, UTs can be shown to be Turing-complete. Our experiments show that UTs outperform standard Transformers on a wide range of algorithmic and language understanding tasks, including the challenging LAMBADA language modeling task where UTs achieve a new state of the art, and machine translation where UTs achieve a 0.9 BLEU improvement over Transformers on the WMT14 En-De dataset.
1807.03819.zh: 循环神经网络（RNN）通过每接收一个新数据点就更新状态的方式，顺序处理数据，长期以来一直是序列建模任务的事实标准选择。然而，其固有的顺序计算使训练速度缓慢。近期研究表明，前馈与卷积架构在机器翻译等一些序列建模任务上能够取得更好结果，并且可以同时处理序列中的全部输入，因此易于并行化、训练也更快。尽管取得这些成功，Transformer 等常用前馈序列模型却无法泛化到许多循环模型能轻松处理的简单任务，例如当字符串或公式长度超过训练时范围时，复制字符串，甚至简单逻辑推理，都会出现困难。我们提出 Universal Transformer（UT），一种可在时间维度上并行的自注意力循环序列模型，它可视为 Transformer 的推广，并能够解决这些问题。UT 将 Transformer 等前馈序列模型的可并行性和全局感受野，与 RNN 的循环归纳偏置结合起来。我们还加入逐位置动态停止机制，发现它能提高若干任务的准确率。与标准 Transformer 不同，在一定假设下，可以证明 UT 具有图灵完备性。实验表明，UT 在广泛的算法任务与语言理解任务上优于标准 Transformer，包括困难的 LAMBADA 语言建模任务，UT 在其上取得新的最先进结果；在机器翻译中，UT 在 WMT14 英德数据集上的 BLEU 比 Transformer 高 0.9。
1807.03819.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2605.01352.en: Graphics and compute increasingly share a single GPU in embodied AI simulators, AI-enabled games, and VR systems. Running these workloads concurrently can improve utilization, but contention can also compromise rendering and inference latency. Effective sharing therefore requires control over both concurrency and resource allocation. Native CUDA and Vulkan runtimes complicate this task: they place work in separate scheduling domains, while compute-oriented resource controls do not govern the graphics pipeline. We present VUDA, a system that enables controlled spatial sharing of native CUDA compute and Vulkan graphics on NVIDIA GPUs. An analysis of GPU scheduling, address translation, and workload dispatch reveals how to coordinate the two execution stacks without replacing either one. VUDA redirects CUDA channels into Vulkan's scheduling domain while preserving the runtimes' separate data address spaces. It then uses GPU front-end controls to partition execution resources between the graphics and compute pipelines, with allocations adjustable at runtime. Together, these mechanisms let applications control resource sharing without modifying GPU drivers or rewriting kernels and shaders. We evaluate VUDA across four application scenarios on three NVIDIA GPU platforms, covering throughput and latency objectives for graphics, compute, or both. In embodied AI simulation, enabling concurrency improves throughput by up to $1.62\times$ over the same asynchronous pipeline under default time sharing. In driving perception, partitioned co-execution reduces the measured inference-budget miss rate from 80.1% to zero while sustaining 60-FPS rendering.
2605.01352.zh: 在具身智能模拟器、AI 增强游戏和虚拟现实系统中，图形与计算越来越多地共享单个 GPU。并发运行这些工作负载能够提高利用率，但资源竞争也可能损害渲染与推理延迟。因此，有效共享既需要控制并发，也需要控制资源分配。原生 CUDA 和 Vulkan 运行时使这一任务更加复杂：它们将工作放在不同调度域中，而面向计算的资源控制又无法管理图形流水线。我们提出 VUDA，一个在 NVIDIA GPU 上实现原生 CUDA 计算与 Vulkan 图形受控空间共享的系统。通过分析 GPU 调度、地址转换和工作负载分派，我们揭示了如何在不替换任何一套执行栈的情况下协调二者。VUDA 将 CUDA 通道重定向到 Vulkan 的调度域，同时保留两个运行时独立的数据地址空间。随后，它利用 GPU 前端控制，在图形与计算流水线之间划分执行资源，并支持运行时调整分配。这些机制使应用无需修改 GPU 驱动，也无需重写内核和着色器，就能控制资源共享。我们在三个 NVIDIA GPU 平台的四类应用场景上评估 VUDA，涵盖图形、计算或二者的吞吐与延迟目标。在具身智能模拟中，相较默认时间共享下的同一异步流水线，启用并发最高将吞吐量提高至 1.62 倍。在驾驶感知中，分区共同执行将实测推理预算违约率从 80.1% 降至零，同时维持 60 FPS 渲染。
2605.01352.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2603.22078.en: Robot action planning in the real world is challenging as it requires not only understanding the current state of the environment but also predicting how it will evolve in response to actions. Vision-language-action (VLA), which repurpose large-scale vision-language models for robot action generation using action experts, have achieved notable success across a variety of robotic tasks. Nevertheless, their performance remains constrained by the scope of their training data, exhibiting limited generalization to unseen scenarios and vulnerability to diverse contextual perturbations. More recently, world models have been revisited as an alternative to VLAs. These models, referred to as world action models (WAMs), are built upon world models that are trained on large corpora of video data to predict future states. With minor adaptations, their latent representation can be decoded into robot actions. It has been suggested that their explicit dynamic prediction capacity, combined with spatiotemporal priors acquired from web-scale video pretraining, enables WAMs to generalize more effectively than VLAs. In this paper, we conduct a comparative study of prominent state-of-the-art VLA policies and recently released WAMs. We evaluate their performance on the LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0-Plus benchmarks under various visual and language perturbations. Our results show that WAMs achieve strong robustness, with LingBot-VA reaching 74.2% success rate on RoboTwin 2.0-Plus and Cosmos-Policy achieving 82.2% on LIBERO-Plus. While VLAs such as $\pi_{0.5}$ can achieve comparable robustness on certain tasks, they typically require extensive training with diverse robotic datasets and varied learning objectives. The evaluation code for the RoboTwin2.0-Plus benchmark is available at: https://robot-robustness.github.io/RoboTwin2.0-Plus/ .
2603.22078.zh: 真实世界中的机器人动作规划十分困难，因为它不仅需要理解环境当前状态，还需要预测环境将如何响应动作而演化。视觉语言动作（VLA）方法通过动作专家，将大规模视觉语言模型用于机器人动作生成，已在多种机器人任务上取得显著成功。然而，其表现仍受训练数据范围限制，对未见场景的泛化不足，也容易受到多种上下文扰动影响。近期，世界模型再次被研究为 VLA 的替代方案。这类方法称为世界动作模型（WAM），建立在使用大规模视频数据训练、能够预测未来状态的世界模型之上；只需少量适配，其潜在表示就可以解码为机器人动作。有观点认为，显式动态预测能力与网络规模视频预训练获得的时空先验相结合，使 WAM 比 VLA 更有效地泛化。本文对具有代表性的先进 VLA 策略与近期发布的 WAM 进行比较研究。我们在 LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 2.0-Plus 上，评估它们面对多种视觉与语言扰动时的表现。结果显示，WAM 具有很强的稳健性：LingBot-VA 在 RoboTwin 2.0-Plus 上达到 74.2% 成功率，Cosmos-Policy 在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 82.2%。尽管 π0.5 等 VLA 在某些任务上能达到相近稳健性，但通常需要使用多样化机器人数据集和不同学习目标进行大量训练。RoboTwin2.0-Plus 基准的评估代码可通过 https://robot-robustness.github.io/RoboTwin2.0-Plus/ 获取。
2603.22078.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.01880.en: World Action Models generate fixed-horizon action chunks through iterative denoising, creating substantial inference latency that can cause pauses, stale actions, and discontinuities during robotic execution. We present an empirical study of asynchronous deployment strategies that overlap model inference with action execution to enable responsive and smooth control. We compare six strategies, including synchronous execution, pure asynchronous switching, post-hoc action blending, denoising-time blending, inference-time velocity guidance, and prefix-conditioned generation, on a 10 Hz bimanual robot. Evaluation combines offline trajectory analysis with online experiments across dynamic manipulation, precision-critical placement, and long-horizon tasks. Our results identify accurate temporal alignment between observations, predictions, and executed commands as a fundamental requirement. Alignment errors produce persistent chunk-boundary discontinuities that cannot be corrected through blending alone. With proper alignment, direct action weighting provides a simple and smooth baseline but sacrifices accuracy in precision-critical tasks. Inference-time velocity guidance fails to reliably constrain committed actions on our platform. In contrast, prefix-conditioned generation achieves the best overall balance between task performance, execution speed, and trajectory smoothness by learning consistent action continuations during training. These findings clarify the practical trade-offs among asynchronous deployment strategies and provide guidance for deploying high-latency World Action Models in real-time robotic systems.
2608.01880.zh: 世界动作模型通过迭代去噪生成固定时域的动作片段，带来显著推理延迟，可能导致机器人执行停顿、动作陈旧和不连续。我们对异步部署策略开展实证研究，通过重叠模型推理与动作执行，实现响应及时且平滑的控制。我们在一个 10 Hz 双臂机器人上比较六种策略，包括同步执行、纯异步切换、事后动作混合、去噪期间混合、推理时速度引导，以及以前缀为条件的生成。评估结合离线轨迹分析与在线实验，覆盖动态操作、精度要求较高的放置任务和长时程任务。结果表明，观察、预测与实际执行命令之间准确的时间对齐是一项基础要求。对齐错误会在动作片段边界产生持续不连续，仅靠混合无法纠正。正确对齐后，直接对动作加权提供了简单、平滑的基线，但会牺牲精度关键任务的准确性。在我们的平台上，推理时速度引导无法可靠约束最终执行的动作。相比之下，以前缀为条件的生成，通过在训练期间学习一致的动作续接，在任务表现、执行速度与轨迹平滑度之间取得了最佳总体平衡。这些发现阐明了不同异步部署策略的实际取舍，并为在实时机器人系统中部署高延迟世界动作模型提供指导。
2608.01880.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2606.20781.en: World Action Models (WAMs) are embodied predictive-action models that make a forecast of the future available to action. Recent WAMs repurpose large video generation models, and a parallel line relies on language or vision-language backbones without a video-generation core. This rapid expansion has blurred the boundary among broad world models, video generation models, action-grounded video world models, Vision-Language-Action policies, and WAMs. This survey gives the field a common account. It first clarifies these boundaries, then organizes existing works through two complementary views. The first view asks what each method is required to generate, spanning rendered futures, latent futures, and video-generation-free action reasoning. The second view decomposes each method by predictive substrate, backbone, action coupling, and deployment regime. This anatomy supports a unified discussion of interactability, causality, persistence, physical plausibility, and generalization, followed by data, evaluation, and open challenges. Across these axes, a consistent design pattern emerges: WAMs are not simply video generators with action heads, but predictive-action methods whose design choices trade representational richness against compute, memory, latency, and action-label cost. The field is moving toward methods that generate less of the future while preserving what control requires. The survey homepage is available at https://world-action-models.github.io/ .
2606.20781.zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）是一类具身预测—动作模型，使未来预测能够为动作决策所用。近期 WAM 通常改造大型视频生成模型，另一条并行路线则依赖语言或视觉语言骨干，而不包含视频生成核心。这一领域的快速扩张，使广义世界模型、视频生成模型、基于动作的视频世界模型、视觉语言动作策略以及 WAM 之间的边界变得模糊。本综述为该领域提供统一描述。我们首先澄清这些边界，再从两个互补视角组织现有工作。第一个视角考察各方法必须生成什么，涵盖渲染后的未来、潜在未来，以及不依赖视频生成的动作推理。第二个视角按照预测基础、骨干网络、动作耦合和部署方式分解各方法。这种剖析支持对可交互性、因果性、持久性、物理合理性和泛化进行统一讨论，随后进一步讨论数据、评估和开放挑战。沿这些维度可以观察到一致的设计模式：WAM 并非简单地给视频生成器添加动作头，而是一类预测—动作方法，其设计选择需要在表示丰富性与计算、内存、延迟及动作标注成本之间权衡。该领域正在转向这样的方向：减少对未来的生成内容，同时保留控制所必需的信息。综述主页可通过 https://world-action-models.github.io/ 访问。
2606.20781.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.
2606.20781.source_link_verification: Original abstract hyperlinks restored from official source HTML on 2026-10-30; body otherwise unchanged.

2511.14759.en: We study how vision-language-action (VLA) models can improve through real-world deployments via reinforcement learning (RL). We present a general-purpose method, RL with Experience and Corrections via Advantage-conditioned Policies (RECAP), that provides for RL training of VLAs via advantage conditioning. Our method incorporates heterogeneous data into the self-improvement process, including demonstrations, data from on-policy collection, and expert teleoperated interventions provided during autonomous execution. RECAP starts by pre-training a generalist VLA with offline RL, which we call $\pi^{*}_{0.6}$, that can then be specialized to attain high performance on downstream tasks through on-robot data collection. We show that the $\pi^{*}_{0.6}$ model trained with the full RECAP method can fold laundry in real homes, reliably assemble boxes, and make espresso drinks using a professional espresso machine. On some of the hardest tasks, RECAP more than doubles task throughput and roughly halves the task failure rate.
2511.14759.zh: 我们研究视觉语言动作（VLA）模型如何在真实世界部署过程中通过强化学习（RL）不断改进。我们提出一种通用方法 RECAP，即通过优势条件化策略，利用经验与纠正进行强化学习，为 VLA 提供基于优势条件化的强化学习训练。该方法将异构数据纳入自我改进过程，包括演示、同策略采集数据，以及自主执行期间由专家通过遥操作提供的干预。RECAP 首先通过离线强化学习预训练一个通用 VLA，我们将其称为 π*0.6；随后，通过在机器人上采集数据，该模型可以进一步专门化，在下游任务中取得高性能。我们表明，使用完整 RECAP 方法训练的 π*0.6 能够在真实家庭中折叠衣物、可靠地组装盒子，并使用专业浓缩咖啡机制作意式咖啡饮品。在一些最困难的任务上，RECAP 使任务吞吐量提高到两倍以上，并将任务失败率大约减半。
2511.14759.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2604.15483.en: We present a new robotic foundation model, called ${\pi}_{0.7}$, that can enable strong out-of-the-box performance in a wide range of scenarios. ${\pi}_{0.7}$ can follow diverse language instructions in unseen environments, including multi-stage tasks with various kitchen appliances, provide zero-shot cross-embodiment generalization, for example enabling a robot to fold laundry without seeing the task before, and perform challenging tasks such as operating an espresso machine out of the box at a level of performance that matches much more specialized RL-finetuned models. The main idea behind ${\pi}_{0.7}$ is to use diverse context conditioning during training. This conditioning information, contained in the prompt, makes it possible to steer the model precisely to perform many tasks with different strategies. It is conditioned not just on a language command that describes what it should do, but on additional multimodal information that also describes the manner or strategy in which it should do it, including metadata about task performance and subgoal images. This enables ${\pi}_{0.7}$ to use very diverse data, including demonstrations, potentially suboptimal (autonomous) data including failures, and data from non-robot sources. Our experiments evaluate ${\pi}_{0.7}$ across numerous tasks with multiple robot platforms, on tasks that require speed and dexterity, language following, and compositional task generalization.
2604.15483.zh: 我们提出一个新的机器人基础模型 π0.7，它能够在广泛场景中提供强大的开箱即用性能。π0.7 可以在未见环境中遵循多样化语言指令，包括涉及不同厨房电器的多阶段任务；它还能实现零样本跨具身泛化，例如让机器人在此前未见过该任务的情况下折叠衣物；对于操作意式咖啡机等困难任务，它开箱即用的表现就能达到更为专门化的强化学习微调模型水平。π0.7 的核心思路是在训练中使用多样化上下文条件。提示中的这些条件信息，使模型能够被精确引导，以不同策略执行许多任务。模型的条件不仅包含描述“应该做什么”的语言命令，还包括描述“应该以何种方式或策略执行”的额外多模态信息，例如任务表现元数据和子目标图像。这使 π0.7 能够利用极为多样的数据，包括演示、可能次优的自主执行数据及其中的失败样本，以及非机器人来源数据。我们在多个机器人平台、众多任务上评估 π0.7，涵盖对速度和灵巧性、语言遵循，以及组合式任务泛化的要求。
2604.15483.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2510.25889.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to understand and perform complex tasks from multimodal input. Although recent work explores using reinforcement learning (RL) to automate the laborious data collection process in scaling supervised fine-tuning (SFT), applying RL to large-scale flow-based VLAs (\eg, $\pi_0$, $\pi_{0.5}$) remains challenging due to intractable action log-likelihoods raised from flow matching. We address this challenge with $\pi_{\texttt{RL}}$, featuring two technical approaches: (1) \textbf{Flow-Noise} models the denoising process as a discrete-time MDP with a learnable noise network for exact log-likelihood computation. (2) \textbf{Flow-SDE} integrates denoising with agent-environment interaction, formulating a two-layer MDP that employs ODE-to-SDE conversion for efficient RL exploration. We evaluate $\pi_{\texttt{RL}}$ across various benchmarks, with experiments demonstrating that RL yields significant performance improvements in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.
2510.25889.zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够根据多模态输入理解并执行复杂任务。近期工作探索使用强化学习（RL），自动化扩展监督微调（SFT）所需的繁重数据采集过程；但将强化学习应用于 π0、π0.5 等大规模、基于流的 VLA 仍有困难，因为流匹配产生的动作对数似然难以求解。我们通过 πRL 解决这一挑战，包含两条技术路径：（1）Flow-Noise 将去噪过程建模为离散时间马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），引入可学习噪声网络，以精确计算对数似然。（2）Flow-SDE 将去噪与智能体—环境交互相结合，构建两层 MDP，并利用从常微分方程（ODE）到随机微分方程（SDE）的转换，实现高效的强化学习探索。我们在多种基准上评估 πRL，实验表明，强化学习在分布内和分布外设置中都带来显著性能提升。
2510.25889.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.16885.en: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to both execute individual skills reliably and sequence them coherently over extended tasks. Most hierarchical vision-language-action (VLA) models make each such decision with a single forward pass, leaving no mechanism to allocate additional computation to difficult or consequential choices. We introduce $\tau_0$-VLA, a hierarchical robot foundation model that formulates high-level subtask generation as a compute-scalable inference problem through world-model-guided test-time computation. At each inference step, the high-level policy uses execution memory to generate a subtask and, when needed, searches over alternatives before committing to its output. A low-level policy then executes the generated subtask across multiple robot embodiments. The policy is trained on 40,115 hours of heterogeneous real-world data with multimodal co-training. Across in-domain and distribution-shifted settings, allocating additional test-time computation substantially improves next-subtask prediction accuracy, and these gains translate into higher closed-loop success on long-horizon robot manipulation tasks.
2608.16885.zh: 长时程机器人操作要求机器人既能可靠执行单项技能，又能在较长任务中连贯地安排技能顺序。大多数分层视觉语言动作（VLA）模型仅通过一次前向计算做出每项此类决策，没有机制为困难或后果重大的选择分配额外计算。我们提出 τ0-VLA，一个分层机器人基础模型，通过世界模型引导的测试时计算，将高层子任务生成表述为可扩展计算量的推理问题。在每个推理步骤中，高层策略利用执行记忆生成子任务，并在必要时先搜索备选方案，再确定输出。随后，低层策略在多种机器人形态上执行生成的子任务。该策略使用 40,115 小时异构真实世界数据，通过多模态协同训练得到。在域内与分布偏移设置中，增加测试时计算都能显著提高下一子任务预测准确率；这些改进进一步转化为长时程机器人操作任务中更高的闭环成功率。
2608.16885.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2606.01027.en: Robotic manipulation requires models that generate executable actions while anticipating and evaluating their future consequences before physical execution. We present $\tau_0$-World Model ($\tau_0$-WM), a unified video-action world model that integrates policy learning, video prediction, and action evaluation within a single future-predictive framework. Built on a shared video diffusion backbone, $\tau_0$-WM provides two complementary interfaces. First, a video action model jointly predicts future visual latents and continuous action chunks from multi-view observations, language instructions, and robot state. Second, an action-conditioned video simulator rolls out candidate action chunks into multi-view futures and predicts dense task-progress scores. The model is trained on approximately $27{,}300$ hours of real-robot teleoperation, UMI-style interaction, egocentric human videos, and rollout or failure trajectories using modality-specific supervision masks. At inference time, $\tau_0$-WM uses test-time computation to sample action candidates, rank them with re-denoising consistency, and invoke simulator-based rectification for low-quality candidates. On challenging long-horizon and fine-grained robotic manipulation tasks, $\tau_0$-WM shows superior performance over other relevant baselines.
2606.01027.zh: 机器人操作需要模型生成可执行动作，同时在物理执行之前预判并评估未来后果。我们提出 τ0-World Model（τ0-WM），一个统一视频—动作世界模型，在单一未来预测框架内整合策略学习、视频预测和动作评估。τ0-WM 建立在共享视频扩散骨干之上，提供两个互补接口。首先，视频动作模型根据多视角观察、语言指令和机器人状态，联合预测未来视觉潜变量与连续动作片段。其次，以动作为条件的视频模拟器将候选动作片段展开为多视角未来，并预测稠密的任务进展得分。该模型使用约 27,300 小时数据训练，涵盖真实机器人遥操作、UMI 风格交互、第一人称人类视频，以及策略执行或失败轨迹，并采用模态专属监督掩码。在推理时，τ0-WM 利用测试时计算采样候选动作，通过重新去噪的一致性对它们排序，并对低质量候选调用基于模拟器的纠正。在具有挑战性的长时程与精细机器人操作任务上，τ0-WM 优于其他相关基线。
2606.01027.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2603.11101.en: Embodied intelligence is a key step towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), yet its development faces multiple challenges including data, frameworks, infrastructure, and evaluation systems. To address these issues, we have, for the first time in the industry, launched a cloud-based, thousand-GPU distributed training platform for embodied intelligence, built upon the widely adopted LeRobot framework, and have systematically overcome bottlenecks across the entire pipeline. At the data layer, we have restructured the data pipeline to optimize the flow of embodied training data. In terms of training, for the GR00T-N1.5 model, utilizing thousand-GPU clusters and data at the scale of hundreds of millions, the single-round training time has been reduced from 15 hours to just 22 minutes, achieving a 40-fold speedup. At the model layer, by combining variable-length FlashAttention and Data Packing, we have moved from sample redundancy to sequence integration, resulting in a 188% speed increase; {\pi}-0.5 attention optimization has accelerated training by 165%; and FP8 quantization has delivered a 140% speedup. On the infrastructure side, relying on high-performance storage, a 3.2T RDMA network, and a Ray-driven elastic AI data lake, we have achieved deep synergy among data, storage, communication, and computation. We have also built an end-to-end evaluation system, creating a closed loop from training to simulation to assessment. This framework has already been fully validated on thousand-GPU clusters, laying a crucial technical foundation for the development and application of next-generation autonomous intelligent robots, and is expected to accelerate the arrival of the era of human-machine integration.
2603.11101.zh: 具身智能是迈向通用人工智能（AGI）的关键一步，但其发展面临数据、框架、基础设施和评估体系等多重挑战。为应对这些问题，我们基于广泛使用的 LeRobot 框架，在行业内首次推出云端千卡分布式具身智能训练平台，并系统性克服整个流水线中的瓶颈。在数据层，我们重构数据流水线，优化具身训练数据的流转。在训练方面，针对 GR00T-N1.5 模型，利用千卡集群和数亿规模数据，将单轮训练时间从 15 小时缩短至仅 22 分钟，实现 40 倍加速。在模型层，通过结合变长 FlashAttention 与数据打包，我们从样本冗余转向序列整合，使速度提高 188%；π-0.5 注意力优化使训练加速 165%；FP8 量化带来 140% 的速度提升。在基础设施方面，依托高性能存储、3.2T RDMA 网络，以及 Ray 驱动的弹性 AI 数据湖，我们实现数据、存储、通信和计算的深度协同。我们还构建了端到端评估系统，形成从训练到模拟再到评估的闭环。该框架已在千卡集群上得到充分验证，为下一代自主智能机器人的研发和应用奠定关键技术基础，并有望加速人机融合时代的到来。
2603.11101.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2607.08639.en: The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. Nevertheless, we argue that repurposing video generative models designed for digital content creation is inherently inadequate for physical environments. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model built from the ground up for embodiment. Four core design principles showcase its evolution from LingBot-VA. (1) Departing from traditional reconstruction-focused VAEs, we introduce a semantic visual-action tokenizer, which aligns visual representations with both semantics and actions, improving instruction following and action precision in subsequent policy learning. (2) Given the strictly causal nature of temporal dynamics, we adopt a causal pretraining paradigm, training from scratch to circumvent the catastrophic forgetting that frequently occurs when adapting bidirectional architectures. (3) To meet the demands of high-frequency inference, our model employs a sparse MoE backbone, expanding model capacity without compromising efficiency. (4) Real-time closed-loop control is realized through an enhanced asynchronous inference scheme, which predicts future latents in parallel with action execution while re-grounding each rollout on the latest observation via learned forward dynamics. Real-world deployment validates LingBot-VA 2.0 as a robust foundation model, as evidenced by its few-shot generalization across complex manipulation tasks.
2607.08639.zh: 视频动作模型的出现为机器人控制提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，我们认为，将原本用于数字内容创作的视频生成模型改作机器人控制，在物理环境中存在根本不足。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 LingBot-VA 2.0，一个从一开始就面向具身任务构建的视频动作基础模型。四项核心设计原则体现了它相对 LingBot-VA 的演进。（1）不同于传统以重建为重点的 VAE，我们引入语义视觉—动作 tokenizer，将视觉表示同时与语义和动作对齐，从而改善后续策略学习中的指令遵循与动作精度。（2）考虑到时间动态具有严格因果性，我们采用因果预训练范式，从零训练，避免适配双向架构时经常出现的灾难性遗忘。（3）为满足高频推理需求，模型采用稀疏 MoE 骨干，在不牺牲效率的情况下扩大模型容量。（4）通过增强的异步推理方案实现实时闭环控制：在动作执行的同时并行预测未来潜变量，并借助学习得到的前向动力学，让每次预测展开重新以最新观察为依据。真实世界部署验证了 LingBot-VA 2.0 作为基础模型的稳健性，其在复杂操作任务上的少样本泛化能力提供了证据。
2607.08639.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2604.14268.en: We introduce HY-World 2.0, a multi-modal world model framework that advances our prior project HY-World 1.0. HY-World 2.0 accommodates diverse input modalities, including text prompts, single-view images, multi-view images, and videos, and produces 3D world representations. With text or single-view image inputs, the model performs world generation, synthesizing high-fidelity, navigable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. This is achieved through a four-stage method: a) Panorama Generation with HY-Pano 2.0, b) Trajectory Planning with WorldNav, c) World Expansion with WorldStereo 2.0, and d) World Composition with WorldMirror 2.0. Specifically, we introduce key innovations to enhance panorama fidelity, enable 3D scene understanding and planning, and upgrade WorldStereo, our keyframe-based view generation model with consistent memory. We also upgrade WorldMirror, a feed-forward model for universal 3D prediction, by refining model architecture and learning strategy, enabling world reconstruction from multi-view images or videos. Also, we introduce WorldLens, a high-performance 3DGS rendering platform featuring a flexible engine-agnostic architecture, automatic IBL lighting, efficient collision detection, and training-rendering co-design, enabling interactive exploration of 3D worlds with character support. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HY-World 2.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks among open-source approaches, delivering results comparable to the closed-source model Marble. We release all model weights, code, and technical details to facilitate reproducibility and support further research on 3D world models.
2604.14268.zh: 我们提出 HY-World 2.0，一个在此前 HY-World 1.0 项目基础上进一步发展的多模态世界模型框架。HY-World 2.0 支持文本提示、单视角图像、多视角图像和视频等多种输入，并输出三维世界表示。对于文本或单视角图像输入，模型执行世界生成，合成高保真、可导航的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景。这一过程通过四阶段方法实现：（a）使用 HY-Pano 2.0 生成全景；（b）使用 WorldNav 规划轨迹；（c）使用 WorldStereo 2.0 扩展世界；（d）使用 WorldMirror 2.0 合成世界。具体而言，我们引入关键创新来增强全景保真度、实现三维场景理解与规划，并升级 WorldStereo，即我们具有一致性记忆、基于关键帧的视图生成模型。我们还通过改进架构和学习策略，升级通用三维预测前馈模型 WorldMirror，使其能够从多视角图像或视频重建世界。此外，我们提出高性能 3DGS 渲染平台 WorldLens，其特性包括灵活、与具体引擎无关的架构，自动基于图像的光照（IBL）、高效碰撞检测，以及训练与渲染协同设计，支持带角色的三维世界交互式探索。大量实验表明，HY-World 2.0 在多个基准上达到开源方法中的最先进性能，效果可比于闭源模型 Marble。我们公开全部模型权重、代码和技术细节，以促进可复现性，并支持三维世界模型的进一步研究。
2604.14268.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2609.14858.en: Recursive self-improvement is becoming essential for autonomous AI agents, whose progress depends on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. Effective exploration drives this process, yet managing and improving exploration strategies remains a major bottleneck. Current systems face a fundamental dilemma: fixed strategies fail to adapt as search spaces scale, while online policy optimization must navigate vast meta-search spaces under delayed, expensive feedback from long-horizon rollouts. We introduce \textsc{Dream-RSI}, a framework for scalable, recursively self-improving exploration. A lightweight orchestration layer makes exploration explicit and programmable while leaving the underlying base agent unchanged. Our key insight is that accumulated discovery history can act as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By dreaming within this simulator built from historical discovery trees, \textsc{Dream-RSI} obtains immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies without repeated, expensive online evaluation. The improved policy is then redeployed online to drive further discovery, continuously expanding the simulator pool in a self-improving loop. Across 9 tasks in 4 domains, \textsc{Dream-RSI} achieves competitive quality and improves discovery efficiency in several settings.
2609.14858.zh: 递归自我改进正成为自主 AI 智能体的重要能力，其进步依赖于在复杂领域中发现高价值解。有效探索推动着这一过程，但管理和改进探索策略仍是主要瓶颈。现有系统面临根本困境：固定策略无法随着搜索空间扩大而适应；在线策略优化则必须在庞大的元搜索空间中行动，而长时程轨迹生成提供的反馈既延迟又昂贵。我们提出 Dream-RSI，一个支持可扩展、递归自我改进探索的框架。轻量编排层使探索变得显式且可编程，同时保持底层基础智能体不变。我们的关键洞见是，累积的发现历史可以充当已实现搜索空间上的回放模拟器。通过在基于历史发现树构建的模拟器中进行“梦境式”探索，Dream-RSI 获得即时、低成本的离策略反馈，用来评估和改进探索策略，无需反复进行昂贵的在线评估。随后，改进后的策略重新部署到线上，推动进一步发现，并在自我改进循环中持续扩展模拟器池。在 4 个领域的 9 项任务上，Dream-RSI 取得了有竞争力的结果质量，并在若干设置中提高发现效率。
2609.14858.translation_review: Full source abstract translated; numerical claims and coverage checked.

2608.01150.en: High-quality video generation requires training Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) jointly on image and video data, posing a mixed-length sequence training problem across GPUs. Existing systems rely on data parallelism (DP), context parallelism (CP), or their combination; we model these designs as disjoint-group placement and prove that they face a fundamental tradeoff between inter-group load imbalance and intra-group communication redundancy. We present Zellige, a moldable sequence placement system that jointly selects each sequence's parallelism configuration and participating ranks. Zellige consists of three components: a hardware profiler that estimates the execution time and memory consumption of candidate placements, a two-stage planner that balances compute-heavy anchor sequences and packs lighter filler sequences into the remaining capacity, and a coalesced attention engine that efficiently executes whole sequences alongside distributed-attention shards. Across 21 plans, the hardware profile predicts step makespan and peak allocated memory with mean absolute percentage errors of $3.4%$ and $1.5%$, respectively. The two-stage planner solves each batch in 33--119 ms, significantly faster than a joint-placement reference that optimizes all sequences together, while their modeled makespans differ by at most $0.32%$. In end-to-end evaluations, Zellige outperforms KnapFormer by $1.12$--$1.48\times$ on 16 A800 GPUs and $1.27$--$1.54\times$ on 32 A6000 GPUs.
2608.01150.zh: 高质量视频生成需要在图像和视频数据上联合训练扩散 Transformer（DiT），这带来了跨 GPU 的混合长度序列训练问题。现有系统依赖数据并行（DP）、上下文并行（CP）或二者的组合；我们将这些设计建模为互不相交的分组放置，并证明它们面临组间负载不均衡与组内冗余通信之间的根本权衡。我们提出 Zellige，一种可塑序列放置系统，联合选择每个序列的并行配置和参与执行的 rank。Zellige 由三个组件组成：估计候选放置方案执行时间和显存消耗的硬件分析器；平衡计算密集型锚点序列、并将较轻的填充序列打包到剩余容量中的两阶段规划器；以及使完整序列能够与分布式注意力分片一起高效执行的合并注意力引擎。在 21 个方案上，硬件分析模型对训练步完成时间和峰值已分配显存的预测平均绝对百分比误差分别为 3.4% 和 1.5%。两阶段规划器每个批次的求解时间为 33–119 毫秒，显著快于同时优化所有序列的联合放置参考方案，而二者建模得到的完成时间差异最多为 0.32%。在端到端评测中，Zellige 相对 KnapFormer 在 16 张 A800 GPU 上的性能达到 1.12–1.48 倍，在 32 张 A6000 GPU 上达到 1.27–1.54 倍。

2609.19242.en: Block diffusion language models (BDLMs) combine autoregressive dependencies across blocks with parallel denoising within blocks, but long-context training is constrained by distributed attention communication and activation memory. Conventional context parallelism (CP) shards the combined clean-plus-corrupted sequence by position, communicating shared clean K/V together with block-specific corrupted K/V and their gradients. We observe that the BDLM objective separates over target blocks. We introduce block parallelism (BP), a new distributed parallelism dimension that assigns each corrupted-block computation to one rank. To scale BP to long contexts, we introduce context-sharded block parallelism (CSBP), which also shards the shared clean sequence across those ranks. CSBP keeps corrupted K/V and gradients local, avoids replicated clean prefixes, and preserves BDLM training semantics. On 16 H200 GPUs at 256K context, CSBP improves throughput over the best baseline by 1.18-1.45x for supervised fine-tuning and 1.27-1.33x for conversion of autoregressive models to BDLMs, while matching or reducing peak HBM. Full-model speedup reaches 1.61x at 512K. On eight H100 GPUs, CSBP accelerates DFlash2 speculative-decoder training by 2.48x at 512K and 7.59x at 1M. In matched 12-hour DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT runs, CSBP achieves higher pass rates at every trained checkpoint on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench Lite. Code: https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM
2609.19242.zh: 块扩散语言模型（BDLM）将块间自回归依赖与块内并行去噪相结合，但其长上下文训练受到分布式注意力通信和激活内存的限制。传统上下文并行（CP）按位置切分由干净序列和受扰动序列拼接而成的序列，将共享的干净 K/V 与各块专有的受扰动 K/V 及其梯度一起通信。我们观察到，BDLM 的目标函数可以按目标块分解。我们提出块并行（BP），这一新的分布式并行维度将每个受扰动块的计算分配给一个 rank。为了把 BP 扩展到长上下文，我们进一步提出上下文分片块并行（CSBP），在这些 rank 之间同时切分共享的干净序列。CSBP 将受扰动 K/V 及其梯度保留在本地，避免重复的干净前缀，并保持 BDLM 的训练语义。在 16 张 H200 GPU、256K 上下文下，相比最佳基线，CSBP 在监督微调中将吞吐提高至 1.18–1.45 倍，在自回归模型转换为 BDLM 的训练中提高至 1.27–1.33 倍，同时保持或降低峰值 HBM 占用。在 512K 上下文下，全模型加速达到 1.61 倍。在 8 张 H100 GPU 上，CSBP 将 DFlash2 推测解码器训练在 512K 和 1M 上下文下分别加速 2.48 倍和 7.59 倍。在时长同为 12 小时的 DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B 监督微调中，CSBP 在每个已训练检查点上都获得了更高的 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench Lite 通过率。代码：https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM。
2609.19242.extraction: Complete abstract blockquote from official arXiv abstract page; hyperlink labels expanded to their destination URLs; whitespace normalized.

2605.18739.en: We present LongLive-2.0, an NVFP4-based parallel infrastructure throughout the full training and inference workflow of long video generation, addressing speed and memory bottlenecks. For training, we introduce sequence-parallel autoregressive (AR) training, instantiated as Balanced SP, which co-designs the efficient teacher-forcing layout with SP execution by pairing clean-history and noisy-target temporal chunks on each rank, enabling a natural teacher-forcing mask with SP-aware chunked VAE encoding. Combined with NVFP4 precision, it reduces GPU memory cost and accelerates GEMM computation during training, the proportion of which increases as video length grows. Moreover, we show that a high-quality infrastructure and dataset enable a remarkably clean training pipeline. Unlike existing Self-Forcing series methods that rely on ODE initialization and subsequent distribution matching distillation (DMD), LongLive-2.0 directly tunes a diffusion model into a long, multi-shot, interactive auto-regressive (AR) diffusion model. It can be further converted to real-time generation (4 to 2 denoising steps) with standalone LoRA weights. For inference on Blackwell GPUs, we enable W4A4 NVFP4 inference, quantize KV cache into NVFP4 for memory savings, and boost end-to-end throughput with asynchronous streaming VAE decoding. On non-Blackwell GPU architectures, we deploy SP inference to match the speed on Blackwell GPUs, while the quantized KV cache can lower inter-GPU communication of SP. Experiments show up to 2.15x speedup in training, and 1.84x in inference. LongLive-2.0-5B achieves 45.7 FPS inference while attaining strong performance on benchmarks. To our knowledge, LongLive-2.0 is the first NVFP4 training and inference system for long video generation.
2605.18739.zh: 我们提出 LongLive-2.0，一套覆盖长视频生成完整训练与推理流程、基于 NVFP4 的并行基础设施，用于解决速度与内存瓶颈。在训练方面，我们提出序列并行的自回归（AR）训练，并将其具体实现为 Balanced SP：在每个 rank 上配对干净历史块与带噪目标时间块，协同设计高效的教师强制布局和序列并行执行，从而结合适配序列并行的分块 VAE 编码，使用自然的教师强制掩码。结合 NVFP4 精度后，它降低训练中的 GPU 内存成本并加速 GEMM 计算，而此类计算的占比随视频长度增加而上升。此外，我们表明，高质量基础设施和数据集能够支持非常简洁的训练流程。不同于依赖 ODE 初始化及后续分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）的现有 Self-Forcing 系列方法，LongLive-2.0 直接将扩散模型微调为长时、多镜头、可交互的自回归扩散模型。使用独立 LoRA 权重，还可以进一步将其转换为实时生成模型，采用 4 至 2 步去噪。在 Blackwell GPU 上推理时，我们实现 W4A4 NVFP4 推理，将 KV 缓存量化为 NVFP4 以节省内存，并通过异步流式 VAE 解码提升端到端吞吐。在非 Blackwell GPU 架构上，我们采用序列并行推理以达到与 Blackwell GPU 相当的速度，同时量化 KV 缓存可降低序列并行的 GPU 间通信。实验显示，训练最高加速 2.15 倍，推理最高加速 1.84 倍。LongLive-2.0-5B 在取得较强基准表现的同时，实现了 45.7 FPS 的推理速度。据我们所知，LongLive-2.0 是首个面向长视频生成的 NVFP4 训练与推理系统。

2505.13211.en: We present MAGI-1, a world model that generates videos by autoregressively predicting a sequence of video chunks, defined as fixed-length segments of consecutive frames. Trained to denoise per-chunk noise that increases monotonically over time, MAGI-1 enables causal temporal modeling and naturally supports streaming generation. It achieves strong performance on image-to-video (I2V) tasks conditioned on text instructions, providing high temporal consistency and scalability, which are made possible by several algorithmic innovations and a dedicated infrastructure stack. MAGI-1 facilitates controllable generation via chunk-wise prompting and supports real-time, memory-efficient deployment by maintaining constant peak inference cost, regardless of video length. The largest variant of MAGI-1 comprises 24 billion parameters and supports context lengths of up to 4 million tokens, demonstrating the scalability and robustness of our approach. The code and models are available at https://github.com/SandAI-org/MAGI-1 and https://github.com/SandAI-org/MagiAttention . The product can be accessed at https://sand.ai .
2505.13211.zh: 我们提出 MAGI-1，一种通过自回归预测一系列视频块来生成视频的世界模型；每个视频块由固定长度的连续帧片段组成。MAGI-1 通过学习对随时间单调增加的逐块噪声进行去噪，实现因果时序建模，并自然支持流式生成。在文本指令条件下的图像到视频（I2V）任务中，它取得了较强表现，具备较高的时间一致性和可扩展性，这得益于多项算法创新及专门构建的基础设施栈。MAGI-1 通过逐块提示支持可控生成，并使峰值推理成本不随视频长度变化，从而支持实时、内存高效的部署。MAGI-1 的最大版本包含 240 亿参数，支持最多 400 万 token 的上下文长度，展示了该方法的可扩展性和稳健性。代码与模型已发布于 https://github.com/SandAI-org/MAGI-1 和 https://github.com/SandAI-org/MagiAttention；产品可通过 https://sand.ai 访问。

2511.00062.en: We introduce [Cosmos-Predict2.5], the latest generation of the Cosmos World Foundation Models for Physical AI. Built on a flow-based architecture, [Cosmos-Predict2.5] unifies Text2World, Image2World, and Video2World generation in a single model and leverages [Cosmos-Reason1], a Physical AI vision-language model, to provide richer text grounding and finer control of world simulation. Trained on 200M curated video clips and refined with reinforcement learning-based post-training, [Cosmos-Predict2.5] achieves substantial improvements over [Cosmos-Predict1] in video quality and instruction alignment, with models released at 2B and 14B scales. These capabilities enable more reliable synthetic data generation, policy evaluation, and closed-loop simulation for robotics and autonomous systems. We further extend the family with [Cosmos-Transfer2.5], a control-net style framework for Sim2Real and Real2Real world translation. Despite being 3.5$\times$ smaller than [Cosmos-Transfer1], it delivers higher fidelity and robust long-horizon video generation. Together, these advances establish [Cosmos-Predict2.5] and [Cosmos-Transfer2.5] as versatile tools for scaling embodied intelligence. To accelerate research and deployment in Physical AI, we release source code, pretrained checkpoints, and curated benchmarks under the NVIDIA Open Model License at https://github.com/nvidia-cosmos/cosmos-predict2.5 and https://github.com/nvidia-cosmos/cosmos-transfer2.5 . We hope these open resources lower the barrier to adoption and foster innovation in building the next generation of embodied intelligence.
2511.00062.zh: 我们介绍 Cosmos-Predict2.5，即面向物理 AI 的最新一代 Cosmos 世界基础模型。Cosmos-Predict2.5 基于流模型架构，在单个模型中统一文本生成世界、图像生成世界和视频生成世界，并利用物理 AI 视觉语言模型 Cosmos-Reason1 提供更丰富的文本语义关联与更精细的世界模拟控制。Cosmos-Predict2.5 在 2 亿个精选视频片段上训练，再通过基于强化学习的后训练改进，在视频质量与指令对齐方面相较 Cosmos-Predict1 实现显著提升，并发布 2B 和 14B 两种规模的模型。这些能力能够为机器人和自主系统提供更可靠的合成数据生成、策略评估与闭环模拟。我们还推出 Cosmos-Transfer2.5，将该系列扩展为采用 ControlNet 风格框架的 Sim2Real 与 Real2Real 世界转换模型。尽管其规模约为 Cosmos-Transfer1 的 1/3.5，它仍实现了更高的保真度与稳健的长时视频生成。这些进展共同使 Cosmos-Predict2.5 和 Cosmos-Transfer2.5 成为扩展具身智能能力的通用工具。为加快物理 AI 的研究与部署，我们按照 NVIDIA Open Model License 在 https://github.com/nvidia-cosmos/cosmos-predict2.5 和 https://github.com/nvidia-cosmos/cosmos-transfer2.5 发布源代码、预训练检查点与精选基准。我们希望这些开放资源能够降低采用门槛，并促进下一代具身智能的创新。

2504.08685.en: This technical report presents a cost-efficient strategy for training a video generation foundation model. We present a mid-sized research model with approximately 7 billion parameters (7B) called Seaweed-7B trained from scratch using 665,000 H100 GPU hours. Despite being trained with moderate computational resources, Seaweed-7B demonstrates highly competitive performance compared to contemporary video generation models of much larger size. Design choices are especially crucial in a resource-constrained setting. This technical report highlights the key design decisions that enhance the performance of the medium-sized diffusion model. Empirically, we make two observations: (1) Seaweed-7B achieves performance comparable to, or even surpasses, larger models trained on substantially greater GPU resources, and (2) our model, which exhibits strong generalization ability, can be effectively adapted across a wide range of downstream applications either by lightweight fine-tuning or continue training. See the project page at https://seaweed.video/
2504.08685.zh: 本技术报告提出一种成本高效的视频生成基础模型训练策略。我们提出约 70 亿参数（7B）的中等规模研究模型 Seaweed-7B，使用 665,000 个 H100 GPU 小时从头训练。尽管训练所用计算资源适中，Seaweed-7B 与当时规模大得多的视频生成模型相比，仍表现出很强的竞争力。在资源受限的条件下，设计选择尤其关键。本技术报告重点介绍提升这一中等规模扩散模型性能的关键设计决策。实验中，我们得到两点观察：（1）Seaweed-7B 的表现能够媲美甚至超过使用明显更多 GPU 资源训练的大模型；（2）该模型具有较强的泛化能力，可通过轻量微调或继续训练，有效适配广泛的下游应用。项目主页：https://seaweed.video/。
2504.08685.extraction: Complete abstract blockquote from official arXiv abstract page; hyperlink labels expanded to their destination URLs; whitespace normalized.

2506.09113.en: Notable breakthroughs in diffusion modeling have propelled rapid improvements in video generation, yet current foundational model still face critical challenges in simultaneously balancing prompt following, motion plausibility, and visual quality. In this report, we introduce Seedance 1.0, a high-performance and inference-efficient video foundation generation model that integrates several core technical improvements: (i) multi-source data curation augmented with precision and meaningful video captioning, enabling comprehensive learning across diverse scenarios; (ii) an efficient architecture design with proposed training paradigm, which allows for natively supporting multi-shot generation and jointly learning of both text-to-video and image-to-video tasks. (iii) carefully-optimized post-training approaches leveraging fine-grained supervised fine-tuning, and video-specific RLHF with multi-dimensional reward mechanisms for comprehensive performance improvements; (iv) excellent model acceleration achieving ~10x inference speedup through multi-stage distillation strategies and system-level optimizations. Seedance 1.0 can generate a 5-second video at 1080p resolution only with 41.4 seconds (NVIDIA-L20). Compared to state-of-the-art video generation models, Seedance 1.0 stands out with high-quality and fast video generation having superior spatiotemporal fluidity with structural stability, precise instruction adherence in complex multi-subject contexts, native multi-shot narrative coherence with consistent subject representation.
2506.09113.zh: 扩散建模的重要突破推动了视频生成的快速进展，但现有基础模型在同时平衡提示遵循、运动合理性和视觉质量方面仍面临关键挑战。本报告介绍 Seedance 1.0，一种高性能、推理高效的视频生成基础模型，整合了以下核心技术改进：（i）结合准确且有意义的视频描述，对多来源数据进行筛选整理，使模型全面学习多种场景；（ii）高效的架构设计与所提出的训练范式，原生支持多镜头生成，并联合学习文本到视频和图像到视频任务；（iii）通过精细化监督微调，以及具有多维奖励机制的视频专用 RLHF，对后训练流程进行优化，从而全面提升性能；（iv）利用多阶段蒸馏策略与系统级优化，实现约 10 倍的推理加速。Seedance 1.0 在 NVIDIA L20 上仅需 41.4 秒即可生成一段 1080p 分辨率、时长 5 秒的视频。与当时先进的视频生成模型相比，Seedance 1.0 在高质量与快速生成方面表现突出，具有流畅的时空变化与稳定结构，能够精确遵循复杂多主体情境下的指令，并原生支持主体表达一致、叙事连贯的多镜头生成。

2510.10620.en: Context parallelism has emerged as a key technique to support long-context training, a growing trend in generative AI for modern large models. However, existing context parallel methods rely on static parallelization configurations that overlook the dynamic nature of training data, specifically, the variability in sequence lengths and token relationships (i.e., attention patterns) across samples. As a result, these methods often suffer from unnecessary communication overhead and imbalanced computation. In this paper, we present DCP, a dynamic context parallel training framework that introduces fine-grained blockwise partitioning of both data and computation. By enabling flexible mapping of data and computation blocks to devices, DCP can adapt to varying sequence characteristics, effectively reducing communication and improving memory and computation balance. Micro-benchmarks demonstrate that DCP accelerates attention by 1.19x~2.45x under causal masks and 2.15x~3.77x under sparse attention patterns. Additionally, we observe up to 0.94x~1.16x end-to-end training speed-up for causal masks, and 1.00x~1.46x for sparse masks.
2510.10620.zh: 上下文并行已成为支持长上下文训练的关键技术，而长上下文训练正成为现代大模型生成式人工智能中的一个发展趋势。然而，现有上下文并行方法依赖静态并行化配置，忽略了训练数据的动态特性，具体而言，就是不同样本之间序列长度与 token 关系（即注意力模式）的差异。因此，这些方法往往存在不必要的通信开销和计算不均衡。本文提出 DCP，一种动态上下文并行训练框架，对数据和计算都进行细粒度的分块划分。通过将数据块和计算块灵活映射到设备，DCP 能够适应不同序列的特征，有效减少通信，并改善显存与计算的均衡性。微基准测试表明，在因果掩码下，DCP 可将注意力计算加速 1.19–2.45 倍；在稀疏注意力模式下可加速 2.15–3.77 倍。此外，我们观察到，因果掩码下的端到端训练加速比为 0.94–1.16 倍，稀疏掩码下为 1.00–1.46 倍。

2605.17923.en: In video generation models, particularly world models, training large-scale video diffusion Transformers (such as DiT and MMDiT) poses significant computational challenges due to the extreme variance in sequence lengths within mixed-mode datasets. Existing bucket-based data loading strategies typically rely on "equal token length" constraints. This approach fails to account for the quadratic complexity of self-attention mechanisms, leading to severe load imbalance and underutilization of GPU resources. This paper proposes \textit{AdaptiveLoad}, an integrated optimization framework consisting of two core components: (1) A dual-constraint adaptive load balancing system, which eliminates long-sequence bottlenecks by simultaneously limiting memory consumption and computational load ($B \times S^p \le M_{\text{comp}}$); (2) A fused LayerNorm-Modulate CUDA kernel, which utilizes a D-tile coalesced reduction strategy to increase throughput and alleviate memory pressure. Experimental results on the Wan 2.1 world model demonstrate that our method reduces the computational imbalance rate from 39\% to 18.9\%, improves peak VRAM utilization efficiency by 22.7\%, and achieves an overall training throughput increase of 27.2\%.
2605.17923.zh: 在视频生成模型，尤其是世界模型中，混合模态数据集内部的序列长度差异极大，因此训练 DiT 和 MMDiT 等大规模视频扩散 Transformer 面临显著的计算挑战。现有基于分桶的数据加载策略通常依赖“相同 token 长度”约束。这种方法未考虑自注意力机制的二次计算复杂度，导致严重的负载不均衡和 GPU 资源利用不足。本文提出 AdaptiveLoad，一个包含两个核心组件的一体化优化框架：（1）双重约束的自适应负载均衡系统，同时限制显存消耗和计算负载（B × S^p ≤ M_comp），以消除长序列瓶颈；（2）融合的 LayerNorm–Modulate CUDA 算子，采用 D-tile 合并归约策略提高吞吐量并缓解显存压力。在 Wan 2.1 世界模型上的实验结果表明，我们的方法将计算不均衡率从 39% 降低到 18.9%，将峰值显存利用效率提高 22.7%，并使整体训练吞吐量提高 27.2%。

2609.34318.en: Long-context training runs on sequences whose lengths span orders of magnitude, and dynamic context parallelism (DCP) gives each sequence its own CP degree. Existing DCP systems either do not scale or perform poorly on mainstream models, leaving Megatron-Core (Mcore) DCP as the only option at production scale. Mcore DCP, however, sizes each degree to fit memory, which grows linearly with length while attention grows quadratically, so comparable token counts hide unequal computation. In our production 256K-context training job on more than 11K GPUs under Mcore DCP, per-rank microbatch times differ by up to 5x at similar token counts. The skew leads to a 46% pipeline bubble and a 13% data-parallel bubble. We present HyDra, a scalable load-driven DCP system. Its scheduler balances computation by pulling every rank toward one load target, and balance in turn makes that target solvable in closed form. It places sequences with lazy heaps rather than whole-pool scans. That balance asks for CP degrees larger than memory requires, so its CP engine nests an inner Ulysses group in a shallow outer ring, letting a higher degree lower computation and communication together. Evaluation at both scales shows consistent gains. On a 512-GPU testbed, HyDra raises throughput over Mcore DCP by 1.18x on average at 32K context and 2.48x at 256K. On a 2,048-GPU production job, it shrinks the pipeline bubble from 36% to 14%, cuts scheduling time by 2.3x, and raises throughput by 1.10-1.43x (avg. 1.25x) over Mcore DCP and 1.33-1.90x (avg. 1.59x) over static CP.
2609.34318.zh: 长上下文训练所处理的序列长度可能跨越多个数量级，动态上下文并行（DCP）为每个序列分配独立的 CP 度。现有 DCP 系统要么难以扩展，要么在主流模型上性能不佳，使 Megatron-Core（Mcore）DCP 成为生产规模下唯一可用的选择。然而，Mcore DCP 依据显存容量确定并行度，而显存随长度线性增长、注意力计算量却呈二次增长，因此相近的 token 数可能掩盖不均衡的计算量。在我们使用 Mcore DCP、超过 11,000 张 GPU 的 256K 上下文生产训练任务中，即使 token 数相近，不同 rank 的微批用时仍可相差 5 倍。这种偏斜造成 46% 的流水线空泡和 13% 的数据并行空泡。我们提出 HyDra，一种可扩展的负载驱动 DCP 系统。其调度器通过让每个 rank 接近统一的负载目标来均衡计算，而这种均衡反过来使该目标能够以闭式形式求解。它使用惰性堆放置序列，而不是扫描整个资源池。为实现这种均衡，所需的 CP 度可能高于仅满足显存要求的 CP 度，因此其 CP 引擎在浅层外环中嵌套内层 Ulysses 组，使提高并行度能够同时降低计算和通信成本。两个规模上的评测均显示出一致收益。在 512 GPU 测试平台上，相对 Mcore DCP，HyDra 在 32K 上下文下的平均吞吐量达到 1.18 倍，在 256K 上下文下达到 2.48 倍。在 2,048 GPU 生产任务上，它将流水线空泡从 36% 降至 14%，使调度时间缩短 2.3 倍；相对 Mcore DCP，吞吐量达到 1.10–1.43 倍（平均 1.25 倍），相对静态 CP 则达到 1.33–1.90 倍（平均 1.59 倍）。

2510.18121.en: We present core attention disaggregation (CAD), a technique that improves long-context large language model training by decoupling the core attention computation, softmax(QK^T)V, from the rest of the model and executing it on a separate pool of devices. In existing systems, core attention is colocated with other layers; at long context lengths, its quadratic compute growth compared to the near-linear growth of other components causes load imbalance and stragglers across data and pipeline parallel groups. CAD is enabled by two observations. First, core attention is stateless: it has no trainable parameters and only minimal transient data, so balancing reduces to scheduling compute-bound tasks. Second, it is composable: modern attention kernels retain high efficiency when processing fused batches of token-level shards with arbitrary lengths. CAD partitions core attention into token-level tasks and dispatches them to dedicated attention servers, which dynamically rebatch tasks to equalize compute without sacrificing kernel efficiency. We implement CAD in a system called DistCA, which uses a ping-pong execution scheme to fully overlap communication with computation and in-place execution on attention servers to reduce memory use. On 512 H200 GPUs and context lengths up to 512k tokens, DistCA improves end-to-end training throughput by up to 1.35x, eliminates data and pipeline parallel stragglers, and achieves near-perfect compute and memory balance.
2510.18121.zh: 我们提出核心注意力分离执行（core attention disaggregation，CAD），通过将核心注意力计算 softmax(QK^T)V 与模型其余部分解耦，并在单独的设备池上执行，改善长上下文大语言模型的训练效率。在现有系统中，核心注意力与其他层共置；当上下文较长时，核心注意力的计算量呈二次增长，而其他组件的计算量近似线性增长，这一差异会造成负载不均衡，并在数据并行和流水线并行组中产生慢任务。CAD 基于两个观察。首先，核心注意力是无状态的：它没有可训练参数，只有极少的临时数据，因此均衡问题可以转化为计算密集型任务的调度。其次，它具有可组合性：现代注意力算子在处理由任意长度的 token 级分片融合成的批次时，仍能保持较高效率。CAD 将核心注意力划分为 token 级任务，并将任务分发到专门的注意力服务器；服务器动态地重新组批，在不牺牲算子效率的前提下均衡计算。我们将 CAD 实现为 DistCA 系统，使用乒乓执行方案让通信与计算完全重叠，并在注意力服务器上原地执行以减少显存占用。在 512 张 H200 GPU、上下文长度最高为 512K token 的实验中，DistCA 将端到端训练吞吐量最高提高至 1.35 倍，消除了数据并行和流水线并行的慢任务，并实现了近乎完美的计算与显存均衡。

2412.01523.en: Extending the context length (i.e., the maximum supported sequence length) of LLMs is of paramount significance. To facilitate long context training of LLMs, sequence parallelism has emerged as an essential technique, which scatters each input sequence across multiple devices and necessitates communication to process the sequence. In essence, existing sequence parallelism methods assume homogeneous sequence lengths (i.e., all input sequences are equal in length) and therefore leverages a single, static scattering strategy for all input sequences. However, in reality, the sequence lengths in LLM training corpora exhibit substantial variability, often following a long-tail distribution, which leads to workload heterogeneity. In this paper, we show that employing a single, static strategy results in inefficiency and resource under-utilization, highlighting the need for adaptive approaches to handle the heterogeneous workloads across sequences. To address this, we propose a heterogeneity-adaptive sequence parallelism method. For each training step, our approach captures the variability in sequence lengths and assigns the optimal combination of scattering strategies based on workload characteristics. We model this problem as a linear programming optimization and design an efficient and effective solver to find the optimal solution. Furthermore, we implement our method in a high-performance system that supports adaptive parallelization in distributed LLM training. Experimental results demonstrate that our system outperforms state-of-the-art training frameworks by up to 1.98x.
2412.01523.zh: 扩展大语言模型的上下文长度（即支持的最大序列长度）至关重要。为了支持大语言模型的长上下文训练，序列并行已成为一项关键技术：它将每个输入序列分散到多个设备上，并通过通信完成序列处理。现有序列并行方法本质上假设序列长度一致，即所有输入序列都具有相同长度，因此对所有输入序列采用单一、静态的分散策略。然而，实际 LLM 训练语料中的序列长度差异显著，通常呈长尾分布，从而带来工作负载的异质性。本文表明，使用单一静态策略会造成低效率和资源利用不足，因此需要自适应方法来处理不同序列之间的异质负载。为此，我们提出一种适应异质性的序列并行方法。在每个训练步中，该方法捕获序列长度的变化，并依据工作负载特征分配最优的分散策略组合。我们将该问题建模为线性规划优化问题，并设计高效且有效的求解器来寻找最优解。此外，我们将该方法实现为一个高性能系统，支持分布式 LLM 训练中的自适应并行化。实验结果表明，我们的系统相对最先进训练框架的性能最高提高至 1.98 倍。

2412.07894.en: To optimize large Transformer model training, both efficient parallel computing and advanced data management are indispensable. However, current methods often assume a stable and uniform training workload, neglecting data-induced imbalances-arising from both sampling and packing processes-which can impede training performance. Specifically, data sampling imbalance arises from uneven sequence length distribution of the training data, while data packing imbalance stems from the discrepancy between the linear memory complexity and quadratic time complexity of the attention mechanism. To address these imbalance issues, we develop Hydraulis, which jointly optimizes the parallel strategies and data assignment. For one thing, we introduce large model training with dynamic heterogeneous parallel strategies in response to the sequence length variations within and across training iterations. For another, we devise a two-stage data assignment approach, which strikes a good balance in terms of the training workloads both within and across model replicas. Empirical results demonstrate that Hydraulis outperforms existing systems by 1.32-2.66 times.
2412.07894.zh: 为了优化大型 Transformer 模型训练，高效的并行计算和先进的数据管理都不可或缺。然而，现有方法往往假设训练负载稳定且均匀，忽略了采样和打包过程所引入的数据不均衡，而这种不均衡会阻碍训练性能。具体而言，数据采样不均衡源于训练数据中序列长度分布的不均匀；数据打包不均衡则来自注意力机制线性显存复杂度与二次时间复杂度之间的差异。为解决这些不均衡问题，我们开发了 Hydraulis，联合优化并行策略和数据分配。一方面，我们引入动态异构并行策略，以响应训练迭代内部以及不同迭代之间的序列长度变化。另一方面，我们设计两阶段数据分配方法，使模型副本内部和副本之间的训练工作负载都获得较好的均衡。实验结果表明，Hydraulis 相对现有系统的性能达到 1.32–2.66 倍。

2502.21231.en: Scaling long-context ability is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs). To amortize the memory consumption across multiple devices in long-context training, inter-data partitioning (a.k.a. Data Parallelism) and intra-data partitioning (a.k.a. Context Parallelism) are commonly used. Current training frameworks predominantly treat the two techniques as orthogonal, and establish static communication groups to organize the devices as a static mesh (e.g., a 2D mesh). However, the sequences for LLM training typically vary in lengths, no matter for texts, multi-modalities or reinforcement learning. The mismatch between data heterogeneity and static mesh causes redundant communication and imbalanced computation, degrading the training efficiency. In this work, we introduce ByteScale, an efficient, flexible, and scalable LLM training framework for large-scale mixed training of long and short sequences. The core of ByteScale is a novel parallelism strategy, namely Hybrid Data Parallelism (HDP), which unifies the inter- and intra-data partitioning with a dynamic mesh design. In particular, we build a communication optimizer, which eliminates the redundant communication for short sequences by data-aware sharding and dynamic communication, and further compresses the communication cost for long sequences by selective offloading. Besides, we also develop a balance scheduler to mitigate the imbalanced computation by parallelism-aware data assignment. We evaluate ByteScale with the model sizes ranging from 7B to 141B, context lengths from 256K to 2048K, on a production cluster with more than 12,000 GPUs. Experiment results show that ByteScale outperforms the state-of-the-art training system by up to 7.89x.
2502.21231.zh: 扩展长上下文能力对大语言模型至关重要。为了在长上下文训练中将显存消耗分摊到多个设备，通常会使用数据间划分（即数据并行）和数据内划分（即上下文并行）。当前训练框架主要将这两项技术视为彼此正交，并建立静态通信组，将设备组织成静态网格，例如二维网格。然而，无论是文本、多模态还是强化学习，LLM 训练中的序列长度通常都不相同。数据异质性与静态网格之间的不匹配会引发冗余通信和计算不均衡，降低训练效率。本文提出 ByteScale，一个高效、灵活且可扩展的 LLM 训练框架，用于大规模长短序列混合训练。ByteScale 的核心是一种新的并行策略——混合数据并行（Hybrid Data Parallelism，HDP），通过动态网格设计统一数据间和数据内划分。具体而言，我们构建了通信优化器，利用数据感知分片和动态通信消除短序列的冗余通信，并通过选择性卸载进一步降低长序列的通信成本。此外，我们还开发了均衡调度器，通过并行感知的数据分配缓解计算不均衡。我们在超过 12,000 张 GPU 的生产集群上，使用 7B–141B 规模的模型和 256K–2048K 的上下文长度评测 ByteScale。实验结果表明，ByteScale 相对最先进训练系统的性能最高提高至 7.89 倍。

2309.14509.en: Computation in a typical Transformer-based large language model (LLM) can be characterized by batch size, hidden dimension, number of layers, and sequence length. Until now, system works for accelerating LLM training have focused on the first three dimensions: data parallelism for batch size, tensor parallelism for hidden size and pipeline parallelism for model depth or layers. These widely studied forms of parallelism are not targeted or optimized for long sequence Transformer models. Given practical application needs for long sequence LLM, renewed attentions are being drawn to sequence parallelism. However, existing works in sequence parallelism are constrained by memory-communication inefficiency, limiting their scalability to long sequence large models. In this work, we introduce DeepSpeed-Ulysses, a novel, portable and effective methodology for enabling highly efficient and scalable LLM training with extremely long sequence length. DeepSpeed-Ulysses at its core partitions input data along the sequence dimension and employs an efficient all-to-all collective communication for attention computation. Theoretical communication analysis shows that whereas other methods incur communication overhead as sequence length increases, DeepSpeed-Ulysses maintains constant communication volume when sequence length and compute devices are increased proportionally. Furthermore, experimental evaluations show that DeepSpeed-Ulysses trains 2.5x faster with 4x longer sequence length than the existing method SOTA baseline.
2309.14509.zh: 典型的基于 Transformer 的大语言模型，其计算可以由批次大小、隐藏维度、层数和序列长度描述。迄今为止，加速 LLM 训练的系统研究主要集中在前三个维度：针对批次大小的数据并行、针对隐藏维度的张量并行，以及针对模型深度或层数的流水线并行。这些得到广泛研究的并行形式并非专门面向长序列 Transformer 模型设计或优化。随着长序列 LLM 的实际应用需求增长，序列并行重新受到关注。然而，现有序列并行工作受到显存与通信低效的限制，难以扩展到长序列大模型。本文提出 DeepSpeed-Ulysses，一种新颖、可移植且有效的方法，用于支持高效、可扩展的超长序列 LLM 训练。DeepSpeed-Ulysses 的核心是沿序列维度划分输入数据，并利用高效的 all-to-all 集合通信完成注意力计算。理论通信分析表明，其他方法的通信开销会随序列长度增加，而当序列长度与计算设备数量同比例增加时，DeepSpeed-Ulysses 能保持通信量不变。此外，实验评测表明，相对现有最先进方法基线，DeepSpeed-Ulysses 的训练速度达到 2.5 倍，并支持 4 倍更长的序列。

scalefusion.en: Recent advancements in training diffusion models have made generating high-quality videos possible. Particularly, the spatial-temporal diffusion transformers (ST-DiTs) emerge as a promising diffusion model architecture for generating videos of high-resolution (1080p) and long duration (20 seconds). However, the quadratic scaling of compute cost with respect to resolution and duration, primarily due to spatial-temporal attention layers processing longer sequences, results in high inference latency of ST-DiTs. This hinders their applicability in time-sensitive scenarios. Existing sequence parallelism techniques, such as DeepSpeed-Ulysses and RingAttention, are not optimally scalable for ST-DiT inference across multiple GPU machines due to cross-machine communication overheads. To address this challenge, we introduce ScaleFusion, a scalable inference engine designed to optimize ST-DiT inference for high-resolution, long video generation. By leveraging the inherent structure of spatial-temporal attention layers, ScaleFusion effectively hides cross-machine communication overhead through novel intra-layer and inter-layer communication scheduling algorithms. This enables strong scaling of 3.60× on 4 Amazon EC2 p4d.24xlarge machines (32 A100 GPUs) against 1 machine (8 A100 GPUs). Our experiments demonstrate that ScaleFusion surpasses state-of-the-art techniques, achieving an average speedup of 1.36× (up to 1.58×).
scalefusion.zh: 扩散模型训练的最新进展使高质量视频生成成为可能。其中，时空扩散 Transformer（ST-DiT）是一种很有潜力的扩散模型架构，可生成高分辨率（1080p）、长时长（20 秒）的视频。然而，计算成本随分辨率和时长呈二次增长，主要原因是时空注意力层需要处理更长的序列，这使 ST-DiT 的推理延迟很高，限制了它在时间敏感场景中的应用。由于跨机通信开销，DeepSpeed-Ulysses 和 RingAttention 等现有序列并行技术，在多台 GPU 服务器上进行 ST-DiT 推理时无法实现理想的可扩展性。为解决这一挑战，我们提出 ScaleFusion，一种旨在优化高分辨率长视频生成中 ST-DiT 推理的可扩展推理引擎。ScaleFusion 利用时空注意力层的固有结构，通过新的层内和层间通信调度算法有效隐藏跨机通信开销。相较于 1 台 Amazon EC2 p4d.24xlarge 服务器（8 张 A100 GPU），该系统在 4 台同型号服务器（32 张 A100 GPU）上实现了 3.60 倍强扩展。实验表明，ScaleFusion 优于现有先进技术，平均加速 1.36 倍，最高加速 1.58 倍。
